en.editorNote: Send to a friend whose landlord is sitting on their deposit—plus a heads-up that the deposit is capped at two months and a formal demand letter is the next step
variations: I used to think a certified letter was a grown-up thing. After renting, I learned it's a renter's rite of passage.
The deposit caps at two months, the landlord's nerve has no cap, and one certified letter is all that's holding the middle together.

items.sourceNote: 申請租補房東漲租6000元、電費一度6.5元 viral case; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
我去申請了租屋補助，
房東就把房租漲了六千，電費調成一度六塊五。
原來補助不是補給我，是補給他。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給正在猶豫要不要申請租補的朋友，順便提醒：申請租補是房客權利，房東不得禁止，若因此漲租可向縣市政府申訴
variations: 政府補我三千，房東漲我六千，這數學我算不贏。
說好幫我省錢的補助，最後省到房東的口袋裡去了。

en.content:
I applied for the rent subsidy,
so my landlord raised the rent by six thousand and bumped electricity to a wild per-unit rate.
Turns out the subsidy wasn't for me—it was for him.
en.editorNote: Send to a friend on the fence about applying for a rent subsidy—remind them it's the tenant's legal right, the landlord can't forbid it, and a rent hike over it can be reported to the local authority
variations: The government gives me three, the landlord takes six—that's math I can't win.
The subsidy was supposed to save me money. It ended up saving up in my landlord's pocket.

items.sourceNote: 頂樓加蓋鐵皮屋定頻冷氣電費爆表 dcard discussion; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
住頂樓加蓋的夏天，是一場冷氣跟太陽的拔河，
而我是那條被扯斷的繩子，也是那張被扯爛的電費單。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個租到鐵皮加蓋、每個月電費比房租還讓人心痛的朋友，提醒他看房先問清楚是不是頂加、電費一度算幾塊
variations: 定頻冷氣開一整夜，我省下的睡眠全被電表吃掉了。
頂加的房租很便宜，便宜的部分夏天會用電費一次跟你討回來。

en.content:
Summer in a rooftop tin-shed unit is a tug-of-war between the AC and the sun,
and I'm the rope that snaps—right along with the electric bill.
en.editorNote: Send to a friend renting a tin rooftop add-on whose power bill hurts more than the rent—remind them to ask the per-unit electricity rate before signing
variations: Run a fixed-speed AC all night and the meter eats every hour of sleep you saved.
The rooftop unit's rent is cheap. Summer collects the difference in one electric bill.

items.sourceNote: 300億租補淪漲租幫凶、高薪單身族租不到房 news; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
房東說：有租補的情侶我優先，醫生我不租。
我一個認真上班的單身高薪族，居然輸給了一張補助單。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個薪水不低卻總是租不到房的單身朋友，一起吐槽補助政策的副作用
variations: 我努力賺錢，努力到房東覺得我不需要被善待。
原來在租屋市場，單身又沒補助，是一種原罪。

en.content:
The landlord said: couples with a subsidy get priority, doctors need not apply.
So a single person with a solid salary and a steady job just lost out to a subsidy form.
en.editorNote: Send to a single friend who earns well but still can't land a lease—commiserate over the side effects of subsidy policy
variations: I worked hard to earn more, hard enough that my landlord decided I didn't deserve a break.
Turns out in the rental market, being single with no subsidy is its own original sin.

items.sourceNote: 房租網路水電全都要賺、租屋雜支氣炸 news; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
房租要賺、水電要賺、網路也要賺，
房東唯一沒跟我收錢的，只有我搬進來時帶的那口氣。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給剛算完租屋雜支、氣到想直接去看房的朋友，提醒他把水電網路怎麼收都先寫進契約
variations: 房東的收費項目比手搖飲的加料選單還多。
我以為租的是房子，帳單來了才發現我租的是一整套收費服務。

en.content:
Rent's a markup, water and power are a markup, even the Wi-Fi is a markup.
The only thing my landlord didn't charge me for was the breath I walked in with.
en.editorNote: Send to a friend who just tallied their rental add-ons and is mad enough to go house-hunting—remind them to get every utility charge written into the lease
variations: My landlord's list of fees is longer than a bubble-tea topping menu.
I thought I was renting an apartment. The bill showed up and I'd rented a whole subscription plan.

items.sourceNote: 申請租屋補助反被房東漲租、新法禁止 news; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
好不容易申請到租屋補助，
房東比政府還早一步，直接把補助的金額加到房租上。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給剛送出租屋補助申請、隔天就收到漲租通知的朋友，提醒他新法已規定房東不得因為申請補助而漲租或拒租
variations: 補助入帳那天我很開心，隔天房東的漲租訊息讓我瞬間清醒。
政府補助我一部分，房東順手把另一部分也補走了。

en.content:
I finally got my rent subsidy approved,
and my landlord beat the government to it—he added the exact same amount straight onto my rent.
en.editorNote: For a friend who just filed for a housing subsidy and got a rent-hike text the next morning—remind them the new law bans landlords from raising rent or refusing renewal over a subsidy claim
variations: The subsidy hit my account, and the rent-increase message hit the next day.
The government helped with one half; my landlord helpfully took the other half too.

items.sourceNote: landlord special white paint 'renovated' meme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
房東說這間「剛重新整理過」，
我看了半天，只有牆壁多刷了一層白漆，租金多刷了三千。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給正在看「新整理」房源、卻覺得跟舊照片長得一模一樣的朋友，提醒他整理過不等於修繕過
variations: 所謂重新裝潢，就是把發霉的地方刷白，把房租刷高。
他說全部翻新，其實只翻新了報價單。

en.content:
The landlord said the place was 'recently renovated.'
After a good look, the only new thing was a coat of white paint—and four hundred bucks on the rent.
en.editorNote: For a friend touring a 'newly renovated' unit that looks identical to the old listing photos—remind them repainted isn't the same as repaired
variations: 'Renovated' just means they painted over the mold and painted a bigger number on the rent.
He said the whole place was updated. The only thing updated was the price.

items.sourceNote: 'saying it's fine while quietly researching tenant rights' meme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
漏水，我說沒關係。
漲租，我說沒關係。
押金被亂扣，我說沒關係。
然後我默默打開手機，開始查租賃專法。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給嘴上一直說沒關係、其實已經偷偷在查內政部定型化契約的朋友，提醒他沒關係也是有上限的
variations: 我對房東的每一句「沒關係」，其實都在幫自己蒐證。
我不是好脾氣，我只是在等契約到期那天一次算清楚。

en.content:
Leak? It's fine.
Rent hike? It's fine.
Random deposit deductions? It's fine.
Then I quietly open my phone and start reading up on tenant rights.
en.editorNote: For a friend who keeps saying 'it's fine' out loud while secretly googling the standard lease rules—remind them 'fine' has a limit too
variations: Every 'it's fine' I say to my landlord is really me gathering evidence.
I'm not easygoing—I'm just waiting for the lease to end so I can settle up all at once.

items.sourceNote: 'landlord special' fresh paint + rent hike meme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
房東把整面牆重新粉刷了一次，
然後告訴我這叫「屋況升級」，下個月加租一千。
那不是油漆，那是他印鈔票的方式。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給收到「已幫您整修、月租微調」通知的租屋族，提醒他那層白牆底下通常藏著房東不想讓你看到的東西
variations: 房東的裝潢邏輯：刷一層白漆，租金漲一個檔次，問題原封不動。
他說幫我換了新窗簾，我說那可以不要漲租嗎，他就當作沒聽到。

en.content:
My landlord repainted one wall,
called it a 'unit upgrade,' and bumped the rent by a hundred a month.
That's not paint. That's how he prints money.
en.editorNote: Send to a renter who just got a 'we've made improvements, slight rent adjustment' notice — remind them what usually hides under that fresh coat of white
variations: Landlord logic: one coat of white paint, one tier of rent increase, zero problems actually fixed.
He said he installed new curtains. I asked if that meant no rent hike. Suddenly he couldn't hear me.

items.sourceNote: 'landlord vanishes for repairs but instant on rent day' meme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
我報修漏水，房東已讀不回三天。
我晚繳房租一小時，他的訊息比外送還快到。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個修東西找不到房東、卻在繳租日準時被關心的朋友，療癒一下他被已讀的委屈
variations: 房東的訊號很奇怪：修繕的時候收不到，收租的時候滿格。
我家的漏水房東看不見，我的房租他倒是算到分秒不差。

en.content:
I reported a leak — landlord left me on read for three days.
I paid rent one hour late — his message beat the food delivery to my door.
en.editorNote: For the friend who can never reach the landlord about repairs but gets a check-in the second rent is due — a little balm for being left on read
variations: My landlord's signal is weird: no bars for repairs, full bars for rent collection.
He can't see the leak in my ceiling, but he can time my rent down to the second.

items.sourceNote: 'paying rent to fund landlord vacation' meme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
我每個月準時繳房租，
房東每個季度準時出國。
我們的分工很清楚：我負責工作，他負責度假。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給看到房東又在限動曬旅遊照的租屋族，提醒他那趟機票某種程度上是自己贊助的
variations: 我不是在繳房租，我是在贊助房東的環遊世界計畫。
房東的旅遊限動我每張都認得，因為那些行程都是我上班換來的。

en.content:
Every month I pay rent on time.
Every quarter my landlord flies abroad on time.
We've got a clear division of labor: I do the working, he does the vacationing.
en.editorNote: Send to a renter watching their landlord post yet another travel story — a reminder that plane ticket was, in a way, crowdfunded by them
variations: I'm not paying rent, I'm sponsoring my landlord's trip around the world.
I recognize every one of his vacation stories, because I clocked in for all of them.

items.sourceNote: 'surprise landlord inspection' meme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
房東說明天要來「看一下屋況」，
於是我今晚把家裡打掃到比入住那天還乾淨。
說好的租金裡，怎麼還包含定期表演一個模範房客。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給接到房東臨時通知要來巡房、開始瘋狂收東西的朋友，順便提醒他房東進門其實要提前合理告知
variations: 房東一句「明天過去看看」，我家的大掃除就自動啟動了。
我付房租是為了住得舒服，不是為了每個月排練一次房屋開箱。

en.content:
Landlord says he's stopping by tomorrow to 'check on the place,'
so tonight I'm cleaning it harder than the day I moved in.
Nobody told me the rent also covered a monthly performance of Model Tenant.
en.editorNote: For the friend who just got a last-minute 'I'll swing by' text and started frantically tidying — also a nudge that landlords owe reasonable notice before entering
variations: One 'I'll come take a look tomorrow' from my landlord auto-launches a full deep clean.
I pay rent to live comfortably, not to rehearse an apartment unboxing every month.

items.sourceNote: 'landlord special' white paint cover-up meme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
房東把牆上的壁癌刷成白色，
說這樣「看起來就好了」。
對啦，看起來是好了，
但那不是修繕，那叫湮滅證據。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給租到房東用一層白漆蓋住漏水霉斑的朋友，提醒他拍照存證比什麼都重要
variations: 房東的萬用修繕法：一桶白漆解決所有問題，反正你退租前不會發現。
牆壁裂了刷白，天花板黃了刷白，我懷疑他家連電費單都是刷白解決的。

en.content:
My landlord painted over the mold on the wall
and said it 'looks fine now.'
Sure, it looks fine —
but that's not a repair, that's tampering with evidence.
en.editorNote: For the friend whose landlord fixed a leak with a single coat of white paint — a nudge to photograph everything before it gets covered up
variations: The landlord special: one bucket of white paint solves everything, because you won't notice until move-out.
Cracked wall? Paint it. Yellow ceiling? Paint it. I'm pretty sure he handles his own bills the same way.

items.sourceNote: 'security deposit never coming back / surprise cleaning fee' meme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
退租那天，房東繞了一圈，
找到一根牆角的頭髮、一道我搬進來就有的刮痕，
然後宣布：押金充當清潔費。
原來我這兩年繳的不是押金，是分期付款的分手費。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給正在準備退租、擔心押金要不回來的朋友，提醒他入住當天就該把每個角落拍好拍滿
variations: 押金的定義：一筆你交出去、房東負責幫你想理由不還的錢。
房東退租驗屋的眼神，比我媽檢查我房間還銳利。

en.content:
On move-out day, the landlord did a lap,
found one hair in the corner and a scratch that was there before I arrived,
and announced: deposit's going toward the cleaning fee.
Turns out those two years weren't a deposit — they were a breakup fee on installments.
en.editorNote: For the friend about to move out and dreading the deposit fight — a reminder to photograph every corner the day you move in
variations: Security deposit: money you hand over so your landlord can spend the lease inventing reasons not to return it.
My landlord inspects the walk-through harder than my mom ever checked my room.

items.sourceNote: rent rising 30k to 45k over a few years / affordability meme; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
同一間房子，
三年前的房租，是我現在薪水的一半；
三年後的房租，是我現在薪水的全部。
唯一沒漲的，是我。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給每年續約都要被漲租的朋友，一起在薪水沒動、房租狂飆的現實裡取暖
variations: 房租每年都在進化，我的薪水還停留在初始版本。
房東說物價都漲了所以要漲租，我也很想物價漲一下我的薪水。

en.content:
Same apartment.
Three years ago the rent was half my paycheck;
three years from now it'll be all of it.
The only thing that never went up is me.
en.editorNote: Send to the friend who gets a rent hike at every lease renewal — solidarity for anyone whose salary froze while the rent kept climbing
variations: The rent levels up every year; my salary is still stuck on the starter version.
Landlord says everything's gotten more expensive, so rent goes up. I'd love for 'everything' to raise my pay too.

items.sourceNote: 2026 租金補貼新制：頂加違建不再符合資格; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
政府說：頂加違建不能申請租屋補貼。
房東說：你要嘛住頂加，要嘛滾。
我：原來我連被補貼的資格都是違建。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給正在研究補貼新制、結果發現自己住的房子根本不合法的租屋族，一起苦笑
variations: 查了半天租屋補貼，最後發現不合格的不是我，是我的房子。
補貼看得到吃不到，因為我住的地方在法律上根本不存在。

en.content:
The government: illegal rooftop units don't qualify for rent subsidies.
My landlord: it's the rooftop unit or the street.
Me: so even my eligibility for help is technically unpermitted.
en.editorNote: For the renter who studied the new subsidy rules only to discover their apartment isn't legal — laugh so you don't cry
variations: Spent all day on the subsidy application and learned the thing that doesn't qualify isn't me, it's my apartment.
The subsidy is right there, and I can't touch it, because where I live doesn't legally exist.

items.sourceNote: 退租押金被亂扣清潔費; deposit deduction disputes; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
退租那天，房東拿著手電筒，
找我住了兩年的『損壞』，
找得比我媽找我房間的髒衣服還認真。
最後結論：押金不退，因為牆壁有一道我從沒看過的刮痕。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給正準備退租、擔心押金拿不回來的朋友，提醒他搬進去那天先把每個角落拍照存證
variations: 押金這種東西，交出去的時候是保證金，拿回來的時候是遺產。
房東退押金的速度，跟他修水管的速度，是同一種速度：永遠在下週。

en.content:
On move-out day, my landlord took out a flashlight
and hunted for 'damage' from my two years there
more thoroughly than my mom hunts for dirty laundry in my room.
Final verdict: no deposit back, because of a scratch on the wall I've never seen in my life.
en.editorNote: Send to a friend about to move out and worried about their deposit — remind them to photograph every corner the day they move in
variations: A deposit is a security payment when you hand it over and an inheritance when you try to get it back.
The speed my landlord returns a deposit and the speed he fixes a pipe are the same speed: always next week.

items.sourceNote: 2026 租屋提前解約：沒住滿一年要賠; early termination penalty; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
工作叫我搬去外縣市，
房東說提前解約要賠一個月租金，
公司說搬家費自己想辦法。
我夾在中間，才發現能自由移動的只有我的焦慮。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給因為工作被迫搬家、卻卡在合約中間動彈不得的租屋族，替他抱一下
variations: 換工作最貴的成本不是勇氣，是提前解約那一個月的違約金。
我以為長大是想搬就搬，長大才知道，搬家要先問過房東、公司和我的存款。

en.content:
Work wants me to relocate to another city.
My landlord says breaking the lease early costs a month's rent.
My company says the moving expenses are my problem.
Stuck in the middle, I realized the only thing that moves freely is my anxiety.
en.editorNote: For the renter forced to move for work but trapped mid-lease — here's a hug
variations: The most expensive part of changing jobs isn't the courage, it's the one-month penalty for breaking the lease.
I thought being an adult meant moving whenever I wanted; turns out it means asking my landlord, my company, and my savings first.

items.sourceNote: 租屋雜支：投幣式洗衣機、烘衣機另計; coin laundry surcharges; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
我家的洗衣機要投幣，烘衣機也要投幣。
洗一次三十、烘一次五十，
一件白襯衫穿到第二年，
洗它的錢已經比買它的錢還多。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給每週抱著一籃衣服在樓下數銅板的租屋朋友，或用在「租屋隱藏成本」的貼文
variations: 住在投幣式洗衣機的樓上，我學會了一件事：襪子可以再撐一天。
房東說洗衣機是附的，他沒說附的是投幣孔，不是洗衣服的功能。

en.content:
My washer takes coins. So does the dryer.
A dollar-something to wash, two more to dry.
By year two, I'd spent more washing my white shirt
than I did buying it.
en.editorNote: For the friend who hauls a laundry basket downstairs every week counting quarters — or for a post about hidden renting costs
variations: Living above a coin laundry taught me one thing: those socks can go one more day.
My landlord said a washer was included. He didn't say what was included was the coin slot, not the washing.

items.sourceNote: 看房建議錄音拍照存證、房仲把定頻說成變頻; viewing-day misrepresentation; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
現在看房，我進門第一件事是按下錄音。
不是我多疑，
是上一間的「變頻冷氣」，
搬進去才發現只是貼了一張變頻的貼紙。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給第一次自己找房的新鮮人，提醒他看房當下就錄音、拍照，口頭承諾要留證據
variations: 看房要帶三樣東西：手電筒、手機錄音、還有一顆不會被『很搶手喔』嚇到的心。
房東說的都是形容詞，你拍的照片才是名詞。

en.content:
These days the first thing I do at a viewing is hit record.
Not because I'm paranoid —
because the last place's "inverter AC"
turned out to be a regular unit with an inverter sticker on it.
en.editorNote: Send to a first-time renter: record and photograph during the viewing, because verbal promises need receipts
variations: Bring three things to a viewing: a flashlight, a voice recorder, and immunity to the phrase "this one's going fast."
What the landlord says is adjectives. What you photograph is nouns.

items.sourceNote: 房東附設冷氣故障的修繕責任; landlord refusing AC repair; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
七月冷氣壞了，我傳訊息給房東。
他回：「先開電風扇撐一下。」
撐到第九天我才懂，
所謂『撐一下』的單位，是他的耐心，不是我的體溫。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給正在等房東修冷氣的朋友，順便提醒他：房東附的設備非人為損壞，修繕責任在房東
variations: 房東的『撐一下』和牙醫的『會有一點痠』，是同一個語言體系。
電風扇不會修好冷氣，它只會把熱空氣攪拌得比較均勻。

en.content:
My AC died in July, so I messaged the landlord.
He said, "Just use a fan for now."
By day nine I understood:
"for now" is measured in his patience, not my body temperature.
en.editorNote: For the friend still waiting on an AC repair — and a reminder that landlord-provided appliances are the landlord's to fix
variations: "Just hang in there" from a landlord and "you'll feel slight pressure" from a dentist come from the same dictionary.
A fan doesn't fix an AC. It just stirs the hot air more evenly.

items.sourceNote: 隔音差入住第一天就想解約; soundproofing regret on day one; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
搬進來第一個晚上，我就想解約。
不是房子不好，
是我躺在床上，聽完了隔壁的分手、樓上的深蹲、
還有樓下那隻不睡覺的狗的完整心路歷程。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給剛簽約就後悔的朋友，或配「租屋看房一定要問隔音」的分享文
variations: 看房那天中午安靜得像圖書館，住進來才知道，這棟樓是晚上才開演。
我的房間沒有隔音，只有轉播。

en.content:
First night in the new place, I already wanted out of the lease.
Nothing wrong with the apartment —
I just lay in bed and got the full arc of next door's breakup,
upstairs' squat routine, and the insomniac dog below.
en.editorNote: For the friend with instant lease regret, or a post about always asking how the soundproofing is
variations: At noon on viewing day the building was library-quiet. Turns out the show only starts at night.
My room doesn't have soundproofing. It has live coverage.

items.sourceNote: 2026 調查：分租套房約七成房東超收電費; renters realizing they're the majority; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
看到調查說，分租套房有七成的人電費被多收，
我原本想生氣，
後來竟然有點被安慰——
原來我不是特別倒楣，我只是統計裡的大多數。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給覺得自己被房東當肥羊的朋友，附上台電單價讓他知道可以申訴
variations: 在台灣租屋，最療癒的一句話是：『我朋友的房東也這樣。』
被坑到成為多數，這種團結我一點都不想要。

en.content:
A survey said seven in ten people in subdivided rentals get overcharged for electricity.
I was ready to be furious,
then weirdly felt comforted —
I'm not unlucky, I'm just the majority.
en.editorNote: For the friend who feels singled out by their landlord — plus a nudge to check the actual utility rate and file a complaint
variations: The most soothing sentence in renting: "my friend's landlord does that too."
Getting ripped off enough to become the majority is a solidarity I never asked for.

items.sourceNote: 買賣不破租賃 landlord-sells-unit case; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
房東說：「我要把房子賣掉，你這個月底前搬走。」
我說法律上買賣不破租賃，我可以住到約滿。
他愣了三秒，改口：「那……我要收回自住。」
原來我懂一條法律，他就多生一個理由。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給突然被房東要求提前搬走的朋友，提醒他租約沒到期、房東片面終止通常要賠償，先別急著答應
variations: 房東要賣房那天，我從房客變成了「請配合的障礙物」。
他說收回自住，結果新住戶是掛在591上的下一個房客。

en.content:
My landlord said, "I'm selling the place, move out by the end of the month."
I said the lease survives the sale — I can stay until it ends.
He froze for three seconds, then: "Well… I need it back to live in myself."
Turns out the moment I learn one law, he grows one more excuse.
en.editorNote: For a friend suddenly told to move early — a reminder that if the lease isn't up, a one-sided termination usually owes compensation, so don't just say yes
variations: The day my landlord decided to sell, I went from tenant to "kindly-cooperate obstacle."
He said he needed it for himself; the next "himself" was already listed for rent online.

items.sourceNote: 仲介費半個月租金 discussion; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
仲介帶我看了三間房，收我半個月租金的服務費。
我算了一下，他開門的那幾秒，時薪比我一整個月還高。
原來我付的不是找房的辛苦費，
是付給一個幫我找到會漲我租的房東的介紹費。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給第一次透過仲介租房的朋友，提醒他服務費是上限、可以談，法規房客最多收半個月
variations: 仲介費的意思是：花錢請人幫我簽下一份接下來會後悔兩年的合約。
他帶看的時間十分鐘，收我的錢夠他喝一個月的咖啡。

en.content:
The agent showed me three places and charged me half a month's rent in fees.
I did the math — for the seconds it took him to unlock the doors, his hourly rate beat my whole month.
Turns out I wasn't paying for the effort of finding a home,
I was paying a finder's fee to be introduced to the landlord who'd raise my rent.
en.editorNote: For anyone renting through an agent for the first time — the service fee is a ceiling, it's negotiable, and by rule a tenant pays at most half a month
variations: An agent fee means: paying someone to help me sign a contract I'll regret for two years.
Ten minutes of showings, and the fee covered his coffee for a month.

items.sourceNote: pet-friendly rental scarcity; rewritten original (distinct from rq-007)

zh-tw.content:
我帶著一隻五公斤的貓找房，
篩選條件打勾「可養寵物」之後，
整個城市的房子從三百間變成八間，
其中五間要加收寵物押金，兩間限體重，剩下一間——
看房那天才發現房東自己養了三隻狗，但就是不租給貓。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給正在帶毛小孩找房的朋友，提醒他把「可養寵物」白紙黑字寫進合約，口頭答應不算數
variations: 在台灣，養寵物找房的難度，跟找到願意讓你報稅的房東差不多。
房東說可以養寵物，補一句『但不能讓牠碰到地板、牆壁跟家具』。

en.content:
I went apartment hunting with a five-kilo cat.
The moment I ticked "pets allowed,"
the whole city dropped from three hundred listings to eight —
five wanted a pet deposit, two had weight limits, and the last one:
viewing day, the landlord had three dogs himself, but just wouldn't rent to a cat.
en.editorNote: For a friend hunting with a furry kid — get "pets allowed" written into the contract in black and white; a verbal yes doesn't count
variations: Finding a pet-friendly rental here is about as hard as finding a landlord who'll let you claim the tax deduction.
"Pets are fine," he said, then added, "as long as it never touches the floor, walls, or furniture."

items.sourceNote: commute vs rent tradeoff; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
住市區，房租吃掉我半薪，但通勤十分鐘。
住郊區，房租省一半，但每天通勤兩小時。
算到最後我才發現：
這不是省錢，是決定要用錢買時間，還是用命換錢。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給正在為了省房租猶豫要不要搬遠一點的朋友，提醒他把通勤時間也換算成成本再決定
variations: 住近一點錢包哭，住遠一點鬧鐘哭，反正總有一個要哭。
省下的房租，剛好等於我多花在捷運上的青春。

en.content:
Live downtown: rent eats half my salary, but the commute is ten minutes.
Live in the suburbs: rent's cut in half, but it's two hours each way.
After all the math I realized:
this isn't saving money — it's choosing whether to buy time with money, or trade life for money.
en.editorNote: For a friend weighing a cheaper place farther out — a nudge to price in the commute hours before deciding
variations: Live close and your wallet cries; live far and your alarm clock cries. Something's crying either way.
The rent I saved is exactly the youth I now spend on the train.

items.sourceNote: landlord-selling forces tenant to allow showings; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
房東決定賣房，每個週末帶不同的買家來看我住的地方。
我付著房租，卻要負責把家整理乾淨，
讓一群陌生人打開我的衣櫃、評論我的採光。
原來合約沒到期之前，我租的不是一個家，是一間隨時要開放參觀的樣品屋。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給房東賣房期間被頻繁要求配合帶看的朋友，提醒他帶看時間點、次數其實可以在合約或協議裡先講好
variations: 房東賣房那個月，我家的門鈴響得比外送還勤。
我繳的是房租，不是門票，憑什麼每週被參觀一次。

en.content:
My landlord decided to sell, so every weekend a different buyer tours the place I live in.
I pay the rent, yet I'm the one tidying up
so strangers can open my closet and critique my natural light.
Until the lease ends, turns out I'm not renting a home — I'm renting a show unit open for viewing anytime.
en.editorNote: For a friend stuck accommodating constant showings while the landlord sells — the timing and frequency of viewings can actually be pinned down in the lease or a side agreement
variations: The month my landlord sold, my doorbell rang more often than my food deliveries.
I pay rent, not admission — why am I on display once a week?

items.sourceNote: landlord requiring a guarantor/co-signer to rent; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
我只是想租一間套房，房東要我找一個連帶保證人。
我打給我爸，我爸問：「你是要租房，還是要跟人家借錢？」
我也答不出來。
因為對房東來說，這兩件事好像真的沒差。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給第一次租屋、被要求找保證人愣住的朋友，順便提醒他保證人的責任範圍其實可以、也應該在合約裡寫清楚
variations: 租個十坪的房間，我動用的人脈比申請信用卡還多。
房東要保證人、要在職證明、要三個月薪轉，我以為我在應徵，結果只是想睡覺。

en.content:
I just wanted to rent a studio, and the landlord asked me to find a co-signing guarantor.
I called my dad, and he asked, 'Are you renting a place, or borrowing money from someone?'
I couldn't answer.
Because to the landlord, those two things apparently aren't that different.
en.editorNote: For a first-time renter frozen by a guarantor demand — a nudge that the guarantor's exact liability can and should be spelled out in the lease
variations: To rent a hundred square feet I had to pull more strings than applying for a credit card.
Guarantor, proof of employment, three months of payroll deposits — I thought I was interviewing for a job, I just wanted somewhere to sleep.

items.sourceNote: landlord banning overnight guests / policing visitors; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
房東規定不能帶朋友過夜。
有一次同學來借住一晚，隔天房東就傳訊息：「昨天那位是誰？」
我付了全額的房租，卻只租到一半的自由。
原來所謂的家，是一個別人有鑰匙、還幫你數人頭的地方。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個被房東管到連朋友都不能留宿的朋友，提醒他這類過度限制其實未必寫得進有效條款，簽約前要問清楚
variations: 我家門口大概裝了台我看不到的計數器，進出幾個人房東都知道。
房東不住這裡，卻比住這裡的我更清楚昨晚幾點有人來。

en.content:
My landlord's rule: no overnight guests.
A classmate crashed for one night, and the next morning came the text: 'Who was that yesterday?'
I pay the full rent but only get to rent half the freedom.
Turns out a home is a place where someone else holds a key and counts your heads for you.
en.editorNote: For a friend whose landlord polices even a single overnight guest — a reminder that such sweeping restrictions aren't always enforceable, so ask before signing
variations: There must be a counter above my door I can't see — the landlord knows exactly how many people come and go.
My landlord doesn't live here, yet knows better than I do what time someone showed up last night.

items.sourceNote: renter life dictated by garbage-truck schedule (垃圾不落地); rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
這棟沒有管理員代收垃圾，所以我每天的行程表最重要的一欄，
是垃圾車晚上七點零八分經過巷口的那三分鐘。
我可以錯過末班捷運，可以錯過訊息，
就是不能錯過那台放著給愛麗絲的車，不然我家會臭一個禮拜。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個為了追垃圾車、下班還得掐著碼表衝下樓的租屋族，一起苦笑這種被垃圾車綁架的生活
variations: 我的生理時鐘現在是跟著給愛麗絲在走的。
談戀愛可以晚一年，垃圾車不能晚三分鐘。

en.content:
This building has no doorman to collect the trash, so the most important slot in my daily schedule
is the three minutes the garbage truck passes my alley at 7:08 p.m.
I can miss the last train, I can miss a text,
but I cannot miss that truck playing Für Elise — or my place reeks for a week.
en.editorNote: For a renter who has to clock-watch and sprint downstairs after work to catch the garbage truck — commiserating over a life held hostage by a schedule you don't control
variations: My body clock now runs on the tune of Für Elise.
Love can wait a year; the garbage truck can't wait three minutes.

items.sourceNote: no-doorman rental package pickup pain point; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
沒管理員的租屋處，收包裹是一場豪賭：
你賭快遞會在你在家的那兩小時來，
他賭你不在，
然後把「已嘗試投遞」五個字，變成一張叫你自己去領的通知單。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個為了收一個包裹，請了半天假在家空等的網購族，一起苦笑租屋族連收貨都要拿假去換
variations: 我不是不在家，我是被上班綁架了。
住套房最奢侈的服務，叫『有人幫你收包裹』。

en.content:
In a rental with no doorman, getting a package is a gamble:
you bet the courier shows up during the two hours you're home,
he bets you're out —
then turns "delivery attempted" into a slip telling you to go pick it up yourself.
en.editorNote: For the online-shopping addict who burned half a vacation day sitting home waiting for one box; commiserate over renters trading time off just to receive a parcel
variations: I'm not dodging you, I'm being held hostage by my job.
The fanciest amenity in a studio is 'someone to sign for your parcels.'

items.sourceNote: no-balcony studio, indoor drying, 24/7 dehumidifier + damp; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
我的套房沒有陽台，
所以衣服晾在房間裡，除濕機二十四小時開著。
電費單來的那天我才懂——
原來我不是在租房間，我是在租一座潮濕的、還要自費烘乾的雨林。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個房間永遠晾著半乾衣服、除濕機水箱倒到手軟的租屋族，一起認領這股『再兩小時應該就乾了』的味道
variations: 我的衣服有兩種狀態：濕的，跟有霉味的。
別人家的味道是柔軟精，我家的味道是『快乾了』。

en.content:
My studio has no balcony,
so the laundry hangs in the room and the dehumidifier runs around the clock.
When the electricity bill showed up, I finally got it —
I'm not renting a room, I'm renting a damp little rainforest I have to dry out at my own expense.
en.editorNote: For the renter whose room always has half-dry clothes on a rack and who empties the dehumidifier tank until their arm aches
variations: My clothes have two states: wet, and faintly moldy.
Other homes smell like fabric softener; mine smells like 'give it two more hours.'

items.sourceNote: landlord/agent no-show at scheduled viewing; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
約好下午三點看房，我提早十分鐘到。
三點半，房東的電話轉語音。
四點，仲介傳來一句「不好意思剛剛在忙」。
我這才知道——
在租屋市場，最先被放鳥的練習，是租房子的人在做的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個為了看房請假、結果被房東或仲介晾在巷口的找房人，提醒他：還沒簽約就爽約的，之後也別抱期待
variations: 還沒簽約就先體驗售後服務，房東的態度很有參考價值。
我等的不是房子，是一個願意準時出現的房東。

en.content:
We set the viewing for 3 p.m.; I got there ten minutes early.
3:30, the landlord's phone goes to voicemail.
4:00, the agent texts "sorry, got tied up."
That's when it hit me —
in the rental market, the first person who gets stood up is the one trying to rent.
en.editorNote: For the house-hunter who took time off to view a place and got left standing in the alley by a no-show landlord or agent
variations: A free preview of the after-sales service before you even sign — very informative.
I wasn't waiting for an apartment, I was waiting for a landlord willing to show up on time.

items.sourceNote: tiny studio, convenience store as de facto living room; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
我的套房小到轉身會撞牆，
所以我把樓下的超商當客廳，桌子當書房、微波爐當廚房、廁所當我家第二間廁所。
我付一萬五租的是睡覺的地方，
真正生活的地方，是那家從沒跟我收過房租的超商。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個把住處當睡覺膠囊、真正的生活都在超商解決的小套房租屋族
variations: 我家的客廳有 ATM，還有 ATM 旁邊那張椅子。
嚴格說起來，養我長大的是那間二十四小時亮著燈的超商。

en.content:
My studio is so small I hit the wall when I turn around,
so the convenience store downstairs is my living room, its counter my study, its microwave my kitchen, its restroom my second bathroom.
The fifteen grand a month rents me a place to sleep;
the place I actually live is the store that's never once charged me rent.
en.editorNote: For the studio renter who treats their unit as a sleep pod and does all their real living at the 24-hour convenience store
variations: My living room comes with an ATM and the chair next to the ATM.
Technically, the thing that raised me is that 24-hour store with the lights always on.

items.sourceNote: 2026 moving-company pricing structure and on-the-day surcharge disputes; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
電話報價八千，搬家當天變成一萬四：
樓層費、距離費、大型家電費，還有一項叫「師傅辛苦費」。
我看著我的床墊已經在車上，
才懂搬家最貴的不是東西，是我當場沒有第二個選擇。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個搬家當天被現場追加費用、東西都上車了只能點頭的租屋族，順便提醒他下次至少問三家、要求到府估價
variations: 搬家公司的報價單是活的，它會隨著我的家當上車一起長大。
東西一上車，議價權就下車了。

en.content:
Quoted eight grand over the phone; on moving day it's fourteen:
stair fee, distance fee, big-appliance fee, and one line item just called "crew effort."
I looked at my mattress, already on the truck,
and understood: the priciest part of moving isn't the stuff, it's having no second option right then.
en.editorNote: For the renter who got hit with surprise add-ons after the truck was already loaded; nudge them to get three quotes and an on-site estimate next time
variations: A mover's quote is a living thing — it grows as your stuff goes on the truck.
The moment your things get on the truck, your bargaining power gets off.

items.sourceNote: summer peak moving/leasing season, multiple viewers per showing; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
七月找房才知道什麼叫旺季：
貼文十分鐘滿約，看房要排時段，房東一次約五組人同一時間到。
我站在客廳裡跟四個陌生人互相打量，
才發現這不是看房，是海選——而且評審是那個全程沒講幾句話的房東。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給暑假搬家旺季擠在同一場帶看、被房東當面比較的找房人，安慰他被刷掉不是他的問題
variations: 暑假的房子不是租來的，是搶來的。
我不是去看房，我是去參加一場不會公布結果的面試。

en.content:
Look for a place in July and you learn what peak season means:
listings fill in ten minutes, viewings run on time slots, and the landlord books five parties for the same hour.
Standing in the living room sizing up four strangers,
I realized this isn't a viewing — it's an audition, judged by a landlord who barely says a word.
en.editorNote: For the house-hunter crammed into a group showing during peak summer moving season and compared to strangers on the spot
variations: In summer you don't rent an apartment, you win one.
I didn't go see a place, I went to an interview with no results announcement.

items.sourceNote: summer vs non-summer electricity tariff rules for landlords; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
六月一號，房東說台電夏月電價漲了，所以每度加一塊。
十月一號，台電回到非夏月，
房東的夏天卻沒有結束。
原來他家只有兩個季節：漲價，跟還沒漲回去。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個夏天被加電費、入秋卻沒被調回來的租屋族，順便提醒他契約規定房東收的電費不能超過電費單當期每度平均電價
variations: 房東的夏天從六月開始，然後就再也沒有結束。
台電分夏月非夏月，我房東只分「這個月」跟「下個月」。

en.content:
June 1st: the landlord says the summer power tariff kicked in, so it's an extra buck per unit.
October 1st: the utility goes back to off-peak rates,
but my landlord's summer never ends.
Turns out his year has exactly two seasons — the raise, and not-lowered-back-yet.
en.editorNote: For the renter whose power rate went up in June and mysteriously never came back down in the fall; remind them the lease rules cap what a landlord may charge per unit
variations: My landlord's summer starts in June and simply never ends.
The power company has summer and off-summer; my landlord only has this month and next month.

items.sourceNote: no scooter parking included with rental unit, daily hunt and tickets; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
房東說：「機車隨便停，巷子很空。」
第一週，我在方圓三百公尺繞了二十分鐘；
第二週，我開始收紅單；
第三週，我把找車位的時間直接算進通勤。
房租一萬二，車位零元，時間無限。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個每天回到家還要先繞三圈找機車位的租屋族，提醒他簽約前務必問清楚停車怎麼算
variations: 我的房租不含車位，但含每天二十分鐘的耐心。
房東說免費的意思是：不用錢，用命。

en.content:
The landlord said, "Park the scooter anywhere, the alley's wide open."
Week one: twenty minutes circling a three-block radius.
Week two: my first ticket.
Week three: I started counting the parking hunt as part of my commute.
Rent, twelve grand. Parking, free. Time, unlimited.
en.editorNote: For the renter who has to lap the block three times every night before they can actually go inside; tell them to pin down parking before signing
variations: My rent doesn't include a parking spot, but it does include twenty minutes of daily patience.
When a landlord says free, he means you pay in something other than money.

items.sourceNote: summer move-out season cash-flow crunch: new deposit due before old one returns; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
搬家最難的不是打包，是現金流：
新房東要兩個月押金加首月房租，舊房東說押金等他驗完屋再說。
那兩個星期，我的錢同時待在兩個人手上，
只有我，站在中間兩手空空地搬箱子。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給暑假換房、同時被兩份押金卡住的租屋族，提醒他退租前先跟舊房東約好驗屋時間，別讓押金無限期擱著
variations: 搬一次家，等於無息借給房東三個月房租。
我不是沒錢，我的錢只是都住在別人家。

en.content:
The hard part of moving isn't packing, it's cash flow:
the new landlord wants two months' deposit plus first month's rent, the old one says the deposit comes after he inspects.
For two weeks my money lives with two different people,
and I'm the one in the middle, carrying boxes with empty hands.
en.editorNote: For the renter changing places over the summer with two deposits in limbo; remind them to lock in a move-out inspection date so the old deposit doesn't drift
variations: Every move is an interest-free loan of three months' rent to a landlord.
I'm not broke — my money just lives at someone else's place.

items.sourceNote: AC technician telling renter to just move out; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
冷氣壞到第五天，我終於自費叫師傅來看。
他拆開機殼看了三秒，抬頭跟我說：「這台比你年紀還大，早該退休了。」
我說我沒辦法換，這是房東的。
他默默收起工具，只留下一句：「那該退休的，可能是這份租約。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個報修好幾天、房東只回「先開電風扇」的租屋族；連來修的師傅都看不下去的時候，或許真的該認真評估搬家
variations: 師傅來看冷氣，第一句不是報價，是問我：「你房租多少？值得為這台撐嗎？」
全世界最誠實的房屋評鑑，是那個被叫來修東西的師傅。

en.content:
Day five with a dead AC, I finally paid out of pocket for a technician.
He popped the casing, looked for three seconds, then said: "This thing's older than you. It should've retired years ago."
I told him I can't replace it — it's the landlord's.
He packed up his tools and left one line behind: "Then maybe it's the lease that should retire."
en.editorNote: For the renter who's reported a broken AC for days and only gets 'just use a fan' back; when even the repair guy can't watch anymore, maybe it really is time to move
variations: The technician's first question wasn't a quote — it was, 'What's your rent? Is this unit worth fighting for?'
The most honest home inspection you'll ever get comes from the guy sent to fix something.

items.sourceNote: notarizing a lease so deposit return is enforceable without a lawsuit; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
簽約前，前輩叫我把租約拿去公證。
我問為什麼，他說：「這樣房東要是不還押金，你不用打官司，直接拿公證書聲請強制執行。」
我這才懂，所謂長大成人，
就是連頭頂這片屋簷，都得先請人蓋章證明對方會守信用。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給第一次自己簽約的租屋新手，提醒他押金金額較大或房東感覺不好談時，公證是省下未來訴訟時間的保險
variations: 以前覺得公證是買房才要的事，現在租個套房也要，才知道成年就是不斷替別人的不守信用買保險。
租約公證那天我在想：如果彼此都會守約，這張紙根本不用存在。

en.content:
Before signing, an old hand told me to get the lease notarized.
I asked why. He said: "So if the landlord won't return your deposit, you skip the lawsuit and go straight to enforcement."
That's when it hit me — growing up
means paying someone to stamp a promise that the roof over your head belongs to someone who'll keep their word.
en.editorNote: For the first-timer signing a lease alone; a reminder that when the deposit is large or the landlord feels hard to deal with, notarizing is insurance against a future court fight
variations: I thought notarizing was a buying-a-house thing — turns out you need it to rent a studio too. Adulthood is just insuring against other people's broken promises.
The day I notarized my lease I thought: if we both meant to keep our word, this paper wouldn't need to exist.

items.sourceNote: landlord refusing free smart meter because overcharging per-kWh is more profitable; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
台電說分租套房可以免費裝智慧電表，裝了就照官方電價算，就算超過七百度也不漲。
我興沖沖印下來拿給房東，他看完笑了笑，把單子還我：
「不用啦，我這邊一度收六塊，比較單純。」
我這才懂，他要的從來不是透明，是那四塊的價差。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給每度電被收五六塊的租屋族，提醒他台電對分租套房有免費智慧電表方案，房東不願意裝，通常不是嫌麻煩，是嫌少賺
variations: 房東最怕的不是繳不出電費的房客，是知道台電一度只要三塊的房客。
他說裝電表很麻煩，其實麻煩的是那份帳算清楚之後，他就沒得多收了。

en.content:
The power company says shared studios can get a free smart meter — install it and you're billed at the official rate, no hike even past 700 kWh.
I printed it out and handed it to my landlord, all excited. He smiled, handed it back:
"Nah, I charge six a unit here. Keeps things simple."
That's when I got it — he was never after transparency. He was after the markup.
en.editorNote: For renters charged five or six per kWh; a reminder that the utility offers free smart meters for shared studios, and a landlord who says no usually isn't dodging hassle — he's protecting the markup
variations: A landlord's real nightmare isn't a tenant who can't pay the power bill — it's a tenant who knows the utility only charges three a unit.
He said installing a meter was too much trouble. The trouble was that once the math is clear, there's nothing left to pad.

items.sourceNote: landlord reclaims unit mid-lease to live in it himself; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
租約還有八個月，房東傳來一則訊息：
「不好意思，我兒子要結婚，房子要收回去自住。」
我看著才鎖好的層架、剛養熟的網路、記了三年的地址，
原來租來的家，隨時可以為了別人的人生大事，被清空。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給被房東以「自住」為由提前收回房子的租屋族，提醒他租約載明的租期本就受保障，對方要提前終止，該談的補償一項都別放過
variations: 房東的家庭大事，都是我搬家的理由：兒子要結婚、女兒要回國、孫子要唸書。
我以為簽了兩年就是兩年，後來才知道，那兩年是他方便的話才算。

en.content:
Eight months left on the lease, and the landlord texts:
"Sorry — my son's getting married, I need the place back to live in."
I look at the shelves I just anchored, the Wi-Fi I finally tuned, the address I've memorized for three years,
and realize a rented home can be cleared out any time, for someone else's big day.
en.editorNote: For the renter pushed out early because the landlord 'needs it back'; a reminder that the term in a signed lease is protected, and if they end it early, don't waive a single item of the compensation you're owed
variations: Every milestone in the landlord's family is a reason for me to move: a son's wedding, a daughter's return, a grandkid's schooling.
I thought a two-year lease meant two years. Turns out it meant two years, if convenient for him.

items.sourceNote: earnest money vs refundable deposit confusion when reserving a rental; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
看中一間房，房東說先付一萬「定金」卡位。
三天後我找到更好的想退，他說：「定金不退喔，這是規矩。」
我這才分清楚：
訂金是誠意，定金是陷阱，兩個字唸起來一模一樣，剛好方便他裝傻。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給正在到處看房、被要求先付錢卡位的租屋族，提醒他付錢前先問清楚是可退的『訂金』還是不可退的『定金』，白紙黑字寫下來
variations: 付錢卡位前一定要問：這筆錢反悔拿得回來嗎？拿不回來的，通常不叫誠意，叫學費。
房東最愛用同音字：定金跟訂金，退租跟退場，一字之差，差的都是你的錢。

en.content:
I liked a place, and the landlord said to wire ten grand as a "deposit" to hold it.
Three days later I found something better and asked for it back. He said: "Deposits are non-refundable — house rules."
That's when I learned the difference:
earnest money is a trap, a holding fee is good faith, and they sound close enough for him to play dumb.
en.editorNote: For the renter shopping around who's asked to pay to reserve a place; before wiring anything, pin down whether it's a refundable holding fee or non-refundable earnest money — and get it in writing
variations: Before you pay to hold a place, ask the one question that matters: if I back out, do I get this back? If not, that's not good faith — that's tuition.
Landlords love a near-homonym: hold vs forfeit, refundable vs not. One small word apart, and the difference is always your money.

items.sourceNote: rental subsidy blamed for driving up rent; landlords refusing tenants who apply; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
政府發租金補貼，本來是要幫我省錢。
結果房東說：「你要申請補貼？那我租金報實價，剛好也漲一點。」
補貼三千，租金漲兩千五。
原來這筆錢繞了一大圈，最後大半還是進了他口袋。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給正在猶豫要不要申請租金補貼、卻怕被房東漲租或趕走的租屋族，提醒他申請前先把租約和報稅問題談清楚
variations: 房東最怕的不是我沒錢，是我去申請補貼讓他要報稅。
補貼是政府給我的，漲租是房東拿走的，中間那個空手道，表演得剛剛好。

en.content:
The government rolled out a rent subsidy to help me save money.
So my landlord said: "Oh, you're applying? Then I'll report the real rent — and bump it up a little while I'm at it."
Subsidy: three grand. Rent hike: twenty-five hundred.
Turns out that money took a long detour and most of it landed right back in his pocket.
en.editorNote: For the renter weighing whether to apply for a rent subsidy but scared the landlord will hike the rent or push them out; sort out the lease and tax reporting before you file
variations: My landlord isn't scared that I'm broke — he's scared I'll apply for the subsidy and he'll have to report the income.
The subsidy comes from the government, the hike goes to the landlord, and the sleight of hand in between is flawless.

items.sourceNote: rooftop addition (頂樓加蓋) greenhouse heat and leak drawbacks; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
頂樓加蓋，房東說「視野好、離天空最近」。
夏天我才懂什麼叫離天空最近——
太陽先烤屋頂，屋頂再烤我，冷氣開整天也只是把烤箱溫度調低一格。
我不是租了一間房，是租了一個附鑰匙的鐵板燒。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給正在考慮頂加、只看到房租便宜的朋友，提醒他把夏天的電費和西曬一起算進去
variations: 頂加省下來的房租，七、八月會用電費原封不動還給你。
房東說頂加冬暖夏涼，我住了一個夏天，只驗證了前面兩個字是騙人的。

en.content:
A rooftop unit — the landlord called it "great views, closest to the sky."
Came summer, I learned what "closest to the sky" means:
the sun bakes the roof, the roof bakes me, and running the AC all day just knocks the oven down one notch.
I didn't rent a room. I rented a hot plate that came with keys.
en.editorNote: For the friend eyeing a cheap rooftop unit who only sees the low rent; factor the summer power bill and the afternoon sun into the math
variations: Whatever you save on rent in a rooftop unit, July and August hand right back to you as an electric bill.
The landlord swore the rooftop was warm in winter, cool in summer. One summer in, I've confirmed exactly half of that.

items.sourceNote: renters frustrated everything is an extra fee — internet, water, cleaning, management; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
房租一萬二，看起來還行。
簽約才知道：網路要錢、公共電費要錢、垃圾清運要錢、還有一項叫「管理費」，但這棟根本沒有管理員。
加一加破一萬五。
原來標價從來不是我要付的價，只是他吸引我進門的餌。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給看房只比房租數字的朋友，提醒他把水電網路、清潔、管理費全部問清楚再比較，別被標價騙進去
variations: 房東最厲害的不是漲房租，是把房租拆成十個名目，讓你怎麼算都覺得是自己貪心。
比房租要連雜費一起比，不然便宜的那間，只是把差價藏在你還沒看到的欄位裡。

en.content:
Rent's twelve hundred a month — not bad, I thought.
Then I signed: internet's extra, shared electricity's extra, trash pickup's extra, and there's a "management fee" for a building with no manager.
All in, it clears fifteen hundred.
Turns out the listed price was never what I'd pay — just the bait to get me through the door.
en.editorNote: For the friend who compares apartments by rent alone; ask about utilities, internet, cleaning and management fees before you compare, so the sticker price doesn't fool you in
variations: A landlord's real talent isn't raising the rent — it's splitting it into ten line items so every total feels like your own greed.
Compare the rent with all the fees attached, or the "cheap" place is just hiding the difference in a column you haven't seen yet.

items.sourceNote: thin partition walls in subdivided units, no soundproofing; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
分租套房的隔間牆薄到，隔壁講電話我全程聽得懂內容。
久了我甚至能跟上進度：他上禮拜被劈腿，這禮拜在找新工作，昨天面試沒過。
我沒付錢看實境秀，
卻連廣告都沒得跳過。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給正在看分租套房的朋友，提醒他看房時敲一敲隔間牆、晚上再來聽一次，隔音是簽約前最容易忽略、住進去最難忍受的一項
variations: 分租套房教會我的第一件事，是隔壁的作息；第二件事，是我的作息從此不由我決定。
看房時記得敲牆，空心的那種，你租的不是一個房間，是一場二十四小時不關的直播。

en.content:
The partition wall in my shared unit is so thin I can follow every phone call next door, word for word.
By now I'm caught up on the story: he got cheated on last week, he's job-hunting this week, and yesterday's interview didn't go through.
I never paid for a reality show,
but I don't even get to skip the ads.
en.editorNote: For the friend touring subdivided units; knock on the partition walls and come back at night to listen — soundproofing is the easiest thing to overlook at signing and the hardest to live with after
variations: The first thing a shared unit taught me was my neighbor's schedule; the second was that mine is no longer up to me.
Knock on the walls when you tour a place. If they sound hollow, you're not renting a room — you're renting a 24-hour livestream nobody turns off.

items.sourceNote: landlord installing cameras aimed at tenant's door / 妨害秘密 privacy expectation; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
房東在公共走道裝了監視器，說是為了大家安全。
可是鏡頭剛好對著我家門，我幾點回家、提幾袋東西、帶誰回來，他比我媽還清楚。
我付的是房租，不是報名費。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給發現房東把鏡頭對準自家門口的朋友，提醒他臥室、浴廁、房門口這種有合理隱私期待的地方被偷拍，可能構成妨害秘密，先拍照存證再談
variations: 房東說裝監視器讓我更安全，結果安全的好像是他，緊張的是我。
監視器對著公共出入口沒問題，對著我家門口就是另一回事了。

en.content:
The landlord put a camera in the hallway "for everyone's safety."
Except it's aimed right at my door — what time I get home, how many bags I'm carrying, who I bring back. He knows more than my own mother.
I'm paying rent, not an entry fee for a surveillance show.
en.editorNote: For the friend who just noticed a camera pointed at their own door; a lens covering a bedroom, bathroom, or doorway where you have a reasonable expectation of privacy can cross a legal line — photograph it as evidence before you raise it
variations: The landlord says the camera keeps me safer. Funny how he's the one who looks relaxed and I'm the one who feels watched.
A camera on the shared entrance is fine. A camera on my front door is a whole different conversation.

items.sourceNote: roommate never washing dishes, sink permanently piled; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
合租的水槽，是我室友的當代藝術裝置。
一個碗放三天叫「泡水」，放一週叫「發酵」，放到長毛他說那是「生態」。
我不是他室友，我是策展人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個水槽永遠堆滿室友碗盤的朋友，苦中作樂一下；真要解決，白紙黑字排個輪值表、講好期限，比在群組裡陰陽怪氣有用
variations: 室友的碗有兩種狀態：正在髒，和即將要我洗。
合租最公平的一件事，是水槽的碗大家都看得到，只有我看得到之後會動手。

en.content:
The shared sink is my roommate's contemporary art installation.
A bowl left one day is "soaking," a week is "fermenting," and once it grows fuzz he calls it "an ecosystem."
I'm not his roommate. I'm the curator.
en.editorNote: For the friend whose sink is permanently stacked with someone else's dishes; laugh first, then fix it — a written chore rota with actual deadlines beats passive-aggressive group-chat sighs
variations: My roommate's dishes come in two states: getting dirty, and about to become my problem.
The fairest thing about sharing a place is that everyone can see the sink. I'm just the only one who does anything about it.

items.sourceNote: sublandlord absconds with rent, real owner evicts tenant; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
我準時繳了半年房租給二房東，某天他手機關機、LINE封鎖、人間蒸發。
後來大房東來敲門，說他一毛都沒收到，叫我搬走。
原來我繳的不是房租，是給一個陌生人的資遣費。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給遇到二房東落跑、被真正屋主要求搬離的朋友，提醒他簽約前確認對方是不是屋主本人或有轉租授權，租金匯款紀錄跟合約全部留著才有申訴籌碼
variations: 二房東跑路那天我才發現，我跟房子之間，隔著一個我從沒見過的人。
房租照繳、押金照付，最後連房子是誰的都不是我以為的那個人。

en.content:
I paid the sublandlord six months' rent right on time — then one day his phone's off, LINE's blocked, and he's vanished.
The actual owner shows up, says he never got a cent, and tells me to move out.
Turns out I wasn't paying rent. I was funding a stranger's exit.
en.editorNote: For the friend whose sublandlord skipped town and got them evicted by the real owner; before signing, confirm you're dealing with the owner or someone with written permission to sublet, and keep every payment record and contract — that's your only leverage later
variations: The day the sublandlord ran, I realized there was a person I'd never met standing between me and the place I lived in.
Rent paid on time, deposit handed over, and in the end the apartment didn't even belong to who I thought it did.

items.sourceNote: signal dead zone in rented room, only reception by the window; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
看房那天訊號滿格，搬進去才發現滿格的是房仲的手機。
我房間唯一收得到訊號的地方，是窗邊那塊三十公分的磁磚。
每次接電話，我都得站到那裡，像在跟外面的世界求救。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給租到房間死角沒收訊的朋友，提醒他看房時把手機調飛航再開、實際在房間各角落測一次訊號跟網速，別只信客廳那一格
variations: 我房間有兩種空間：能收訊的窗邊，和其他所有地方。
在這間套房講電話得靠窗站，久了鄰居以為我在跟誰告別。

en.content:
Full signal on the day I toured — turns out the full bars were on the agent's phone.
The only spot in my room that gets reception is a one-foot tile by the window.
Every call, I have to go stand there, like I'm signaling the outside world for rescue.
en.editorNote: For the friend stuck in a room with a signal dead zone; when you tour, flip your phone into airplane mode and back, then actually test reception and data speed in every corner — don't trust the one bar in the living room
variations: My room has two kinds of space: the windowsill that gets signal, and everywhere else.
Taking a call in this studio means standing by the window. Long enough that the neighbors think I'm saying goodbye to someone.

items.sourceNote: roommate's partner practically moves in, bills still split by original headcount; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
我們合租是兩個人分房租，但實際上住了三個。
室友的男友幾乎天天過夜，用我們的水電、洗我們的碗（開玩笑的，他不洗），冰箱多一個人在吃。
他沒付一毛錢，卻比房東還常出現在我家。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給那個室友另一半根本住進來、水電卻還是照原本人數分的朋友；同居前先把「常住客」怎麼算講清楚，別讓一段不是你的感情，吃掉你的荷包
variations: 我室友談戀愛，我的水電費先談成了。
合租最貴的一筆隱形開銷，叫做室友的另一半。

en.content:
Two of us split the rent, but three of us live here.
My roommate's boyfriend stays over almost every night — our water, our electricity, our dishes (kidding, he doesn't do dishes), one more mouth at the fridge.
He's never paid a cent, yet he's here more often than the landlord.
en.editorNote: For the friend whose roommate's partner has basically moved in while the bills are still split by the original headcount; settle how a "regular guest" counts before it starts, so a relationship that isn't yours doesn't eat your wallet
variations: My roommate fell in love, and my utility bill felt it first.
The most expensive hidden cost of sharing a place is called your roommate's significant other.

items.sourceNote: students paying summer rent on an empty room, tempted to sublet without consent; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
暑假兩個月我回老家打工，台北的套房空著，房租照繳。
我算了一下，那兩個月我付了三萬六，租給了空氣。
學姊說可以偷偷轉租給學弟，我翻開合約才發現——
沒經過房東同意就轉租，他可以直接把約終止，押金還不見得拿得回來。
所以我只好繼續，用三萬六養一個沒有人住的房間。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給暑假回鄉打工、房間空著卻還在繳租的學生；真的想轉租一定要先拿到房東的書面同意，定型化契約裡未經同意轉租是可以直接終止的，省下兩個月房租卻賠掉押金並不划算
variations: 我暑假最大的一筆開銷，是一個沒有人住的房間。
空著也要繳租，原來需要我的從來不是房子，是那張合約。

en.content:
I spent two months of summer back home working, while my city studio sat empty and the rent kept coming.
I did the math: I paid about twelve hundred bucks to rent air.
A friend said just sublet it to some underclassman quietly. Then I actually read my lease —
subletting without the landlord's okay lets him end the whole thing, and my deposit goes with it.
So I keep paying. Twelve hundred dollars to keep a room nobody sleeps in.
en.editorNote: For the student paying summer rent on an empty room; if you really want to sublet, get written landlord approval first — most standard leases let them terminate on the spot for an unapproved sublet, and saving two months of rent isn't worth losing the deposit
variations: My biggest expense this summer was a room nobody lived in.
Empty rooms still charge rent. Turns out the lease needs me more than the apartment does.

items.sourceNote: shared-flat living-room AC split evenly while one flatmate never turns it off; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
我們四個人合租，客廳的冷氣電費四個人均分。
但其中一個人出門不關、睡覺開整夜，連陽台的門都開著讓它一起涼。
七月的帳單來，我看著上面的數字才懂——
我付的不是我的涼快，是他的習慣。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給合租客廳冷氣均分、卻永遠有人不關的朋友；入住前就把公共空調怎麼算寫進分帳規則，設一個月上限或乾脆各房獨立電表，夏天的帳單才不會變成室友關係的引爆點
variations: 均分的是電費，沒辦法均分的是良心。
合租最公平的分帳方式，是讓最不公平的那個人先搬走。

en.content:
Four of us share the place, and we split the living room AC four ways.
One of us leaves it running when he goes out, keeps it on all night, and props the balcony door open so the outside can chill too.
July's bill showed up, and staring at the number I finally got it —
I'm not paying for my comfort. I'm paying for his habit.
en.editorNote: For anyone splitting a shared AC bill with someone who never turns it off; write the common-area cooling rule into your bill-splitting agreement before move-in — a monthly cap, or separate meters per room — so the summer bill doesn't become the thing that ends the friendship
variations: We split the electricity evenly. The conscience, not so much.
The fairest way to split a shared bill is for the least fair person to move out first.

items.sourceNote: August peak moving season, listings gone within days, renters forced to decide on the spot; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
八月找房，我約了六間，實際看到三間。
另外三間的仲介都回同一句：「不好意思，昨天已經下訂了。」
後來我學會看到還可以的就先付訂金——
不是我變果斷，是這個月的房子比工作機會還難搶。
zh-tw.editorNote: 提醒八月搬家潮找房的人：熱門地段的房源三天內就會消失，先把預算、通勤範圍、能接受的底線想清楚，看房當天帶證件；但付訂金前一定要看過合約、確認押金不超過兩個月，別讓「怕搶不到」變成別人的談判籌碼
variations: 八月找房的真相是：你不是在挑房子，是在跟三十個人搶同一間。
「這間我再想想」——這句話在八月，等於「這間我不要了」。

en.content:
August apartment hunting: I booked six viewings and actually saw three.
The other three agents all sent the same text — "Sorry, someone put a deposit down yesterday."
Eventually I learned to put money down on anything halfway decent.
Not because I got decisive. Because this month, apartments are harder to land than jobs.
en.editorNote: For anyone hunting during peak moving season: good listings vanish in days, so lock in your budget, commute limit, and dealbreakers ahead of time and bring your ID to viewings — but read the lease and check the deposit cap before you hand over money, or your fear of losing it becomes their leverage
variations: Apartment hunting in August isn't picking a place. It's racing thirty people to the same one.
"Let me think about it" in peak season translates to "I don't want it."

items.sourceNote: group of students turned away by landlord on sight; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
我們四個人約好一起去看一間家庭式的房子。
房東開門，看了我們一眼，問：「你們都學生喔？」
然後就沒有然後了。
我到現在還記得那個眼神——
那不是在看房客，那是在看風險。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給找房時被貼標籤的學生；被打槍時可以主動提供在學證明、保證人跟穩定的匯款紀錄，把自己從一個「身分」變回一個具體的人，但也記得願意好好講規則的房東本來就不多，遇到就珍惜
variations: 看房被拒絕最快的一次，我們連話都還沒說完。
「你們是學生喔」——這句話後面，從來不會接好消息。

en.content:
Four of us lined up to tour a family-sized place together.
The landlord opened the door, looked us over, and asked, "You're all students?"
And that was the end of that.
I still remember the look on his face —
he wasn't sizing up tenants. He was sizing up risk.
en.editorNote: For the student who keeps getting judged before saying a word; offer enrollment proof, a guarantor, and a clean payment history so you turn from a category back into a person — and when you find a landlord who'll actually talk terms, hang onto that place
variations: Fastest rejection I've had — we hadn't even finished a sentence.
Nothing good has ever followed the words "Oh, you're all students?"

items.sourceNote: free legal aid for rental disputes exists, but taking leave to attend mediation is the real cost; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
看到新聞說租屋糾紛可以申請法律扶助，我的第一個念頭是太好了。
第二個念頭是：那我要請假去調處。
房東有的是時間，我有的是打卡紀錄。
原來爭一口氣最貴的成本，從來不是律師費，是我的特休。
zh-tw.editorNote: 傳給正在跟房東卡在押金或修繕的朋友；各縣市都有租賃住宅糾紛調處，也可以找法律扶助基金會，但真正該做的是從第一天就留好對話紀錄、匯款證明跟屋況照片，別讓「懶得吵」變成對方的籌碼
variations: 跟房東吵架真正的對手不是他，是我的請假額度。
免費的法律扶助，配上一天不免費的班。

en.content:
I read that renters can get free legal aid for disputes now, and my first thought was: finally.
My second thought was: so I'd have to take a day off for the hearing.
The landlord has time. I have a timecard.
Turns out the priciest part of standing your ground was never the lawyer. It's my PTO.
en.editorNote: For the friend stuck arguing over a deposit or a repair; mediation boards and legal aid exist, but the real move is documenting from day one — save the messages, the payment records, and dated photos of the unit, so "not worth the fight" never becomes their leverage
variations: My real opponent in a landlord fight isn't the landlord. It's my vacation balance.
Free legal aid, paid for with one very much not-free day off.

items.sourceNote: renters in shared-unit buildings complain about one water heater serving several units — pressure drops and the shower goes cold when neighbors use water; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
這棟五間套房，共用一台熱水器。
我洗到一半突然變冷水，就知道隔壁下班回來了；
隔壁洗到一半哀一聲，就知道我開了洗衣機。
我跟他們從來沒講過話，
卻靠水溫互相通報了兩年的作息。
zh-tw.editorNote: 貼給同樣住分租套房的朋友；下次看房記得問熱水器是不是全棟共用、幾間共用一台，並當場開蓮蓬頭放個一分鐘感受水量和水溫，這種事簽約之後幾乎改不了
variations: 洗澡前先聽走廊有沒有腳步聲，是我在這棟學到的第一個生存技能。
我家的水溫是一種即時通訊，只是內容永遠都是壞消息。

en.content:
Five units in this building share one water heater.
When my shower goes cold halfway through, I know the guy next door just got home.
When I hear a yelp through the wall, I know I just started the washing machine.
We have never once spoken,
and yet we've been reporting our schedules to each other by water temperature for two years.
en.editorNote: For anyone stuck in a shared-unit building; on your next tour, ask whether the water heater serves the whole place and how many units are on it, then actually run the shower for a minute to feel the pressure and the temperature — this is not something you can renegotiate after you sign
variations: Listening for footsteps in the hallway before I shower is the first survival skill this building taught me.
The water temperature here works like a messaging app. Every notification is bad news.

items.sourceNote: threads about tiny rented studios note there is nowhere for a visitor to sit; reframed as a parent's first visit; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
我媽第一次來看我租的地方，
進門站了三秒，只說了一句：「怎麼這麼小。」
然後她坐床上、我坐地板，喝完一罐飲料就出門吃飯。
飯後她說可以搭晚一點的車，結果還是搭了原本那班。
不是我不想讓她多留，
是這個房間一次只放得下一個人的生活。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合一個人在外租屋、家人來看過一次就沒再來的人；如果爸媽下次要來，先想好附近哪裡可以坐著慢慢聊——房間裝不下的那部分，不是你不孝
variations: 我房間只有一張床能坐，所以我媽來的那天，我坐了三個小時的地板。
家人來看我的行程表上，我家永遠只排得到三十分鐘。

en.content:
First time my mom came to see the place I rent,
she stood in the doorway for three seconds and said, "It's so small."
Then she sat on the bed, I sat on the floor, we finished one drink each and went out to eat.
After dinner she said she could catch a later bus home. She took the one she'd already booked.
It's not that I didn't want her to stay.
This room only fits one person's life at a time.
en.editorNote: For anyone renting alone whose family has visited exactly once; if your parents are coming again, pick a spot nearby where you can actually sit and talk for a while — the part your room can't hold isn't a failure on your side
variations: There's one seat in my room and it's the bed, so the day my mom visited I sat on the floor for three hours.
On my family's itinerary, my apartment never gets more than thirty minutes.

items.sourceNote: long forum threads listing everything that needs an address change after a move — bank, telecom, insurance, shopping sites, e-receipt carrier; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
最後一箱搬上車那天，我以為搬家結束了。
接下來三個星期，我改了銀行、電信、保險、兩個購物網站、發票載具，
還有兩個我早就想退訂、結果又被扣一次錢的東西。
第二個月，前房客的帳單還是寄到我這裡，
我的掛號還是躺在上一個地址的信箱。
搬家真正的工程從來不是箱子，
是把自己的名字從一個地址撕下來，再貼到下一個。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合已經搬完、卻覺得事情還沒完的人；下次搬之前先列一張清單（銀行、電信、保險、購物網站、發票載具、公司人事），搬完那週一次改掉，比之後被退件三次省事
variations: 箱子三天就搬完了，我的地址搬了三個月。
搬家的最後一個步驟，是等前房客的信終於不再來找我。

en.content:
The day the last box went into the truck, I thought the move was over.
The next three weeks I updated the bank, the phone plan, the insurance, two shopping sites, the receipt account,
plus two subscriptions I'd been meaning to cancel and instead got charged for one more time.
Second month in, the last tenant's bills still land in my mailbox,
and my certified mail is still sitting in a box at my old place.
The real work of moving was never the boxes.
It's peeling your own name off one address and sticking it onto the next.
en.editorNote: For anyone who finished moving and somehow isn't done; before the next one, write the list first — bank, phone, insurance, shopping sites, receipt account, HR — and clear it all in the same week, which beats getting three things returned to sender later
variations: The boxes took three days. My address took three months.
The last step of moving is the week the previous tenant's mail finally stops finding me.

items.sourceNote: landlords misapply the top residential tier to every kWh; legally only the portion above 1,001 kWh sits in the highest bracket, and summer pricing runs Jun 1 to Sep 30; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
房東拿台電帳單給我看，說整棟七月用超過一千度，
所以「大家的每一度都要照最高那一階算」。
我回去查才知道，超過的那一段才進最高級距，前面照舊。
他不是不會算，他是只在對他有利的時候才會算。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合夏天收到離譜電費單的人；記得夏月電價是六月到九月，而且級距是分段計算，只有超出的那一段才適用高價，全棟總度數不能整包套在你頭上——先跟房東要台電正本帳單和自己房間的電表度數，算不攏就打 1996 或找地方政府租賃專線
variations: 級距是分段的，房東的算法是整包的。
同一張台電帳單，他看到的是最高價，我看到的是我付不起的那一段。

en.content:
My landlord showed me the utility bill and said the building went over 1,000 kWh in July,
so "everyone's electricity gets charged at the top rate."
I looked it up: only the usage above that line lands in the top bracket. Everything under it stays where it was.
He knows how to do the math. He just only does it when the math is on his side.
en.editorNote: For anyone staring at an insane summer bill; summer pricing runs June through September and the rate tiers are charged in slices, so only the portion above the threshold gets the top rate and the whole building's total can't be dumped onto you — ask for the original utility bill and your own meter reading, and call the local rental hotline if the numbers still don't add up
variations: The rate tiers come in slices. My landlord serves them whole.
Same utility bill: he sees the top rate, I see the part I can't afford.

items.sourceNote: peak-season threads about leases ending July 31 while the new place isn't available until early August, forcing overlapping rent or a few homeless days; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
舊約七月三十一號到期，新家八月五號才能進去。
中間那四天，我的家當在朋友的車庫，我睡在另一個朋友的沙發。
為了不流落街頭，我多付了半個月的舊房租，
等於同時養兩間房子，自己卻一間都住不到。
八月最貴的不是新家的押金，是那條沒有人願意接起來的縫。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合正在排搬家日期的人；簽新約時直接把「起租日」往前談個三到五天當緩衝，比事後兩邊各付一個月划算，舊房東那邊也可以問能不能按日計租——談日期的時機只有簽名前那一次
variations: 八月一號到五號，我在自己的人生裡處於待機狀態。
同時付兩間房租的那幾天，我一間都沒真的住到。

en.content:
Old lease ended July 31. New place wasn't ready until August 5.
For those four days my stuff lived in a friend's garage and I lived on another friend's couch.
To avoid sleeping outside I paid half a month of extra rent on the old place,
which means I was funding two apartments and sleeping in neither.
The most expensive thing about August isn't the new deposit. It's the gap nobody wants to cover.
en.editorNote: For anyone lining up move dates right now; negotiate a start date three to five days earlier as a buffer when you sign, which is cheaper than paying two full months, and ask the old landlord about prorating the last stretch — the only moment you can set those dates is before you sign
variations: August 1 through 5, my own life put me on standby.
I paid two rents that week and slept in neither one of them.

items.sourceNote: building committees restrict moving to weekday hours, require advance elevator booking and a refundable protection-pad deposit; slots fill up in peak season; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
新家的管委會規定：搬家只能週一到週五上午九點到十二點，
要先三天登記電梯、押五千塊保護墊保證金、家具不能碰到牆。
我打電話去約，八月的上午時段排到了第三週。
所以我請了一天特休，站在別人規定好的三個小時裡，
用最快的速度把我全部的生活搬進去。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合要搬進電梯大樓的人；簽約前先問管委會的搬遷規定、可用時段跟保證金金額，再去跟搬家公司敲日期，順序反過來就會變成搬家師傅在樓下等、你在樓上求警衛通融
variations: 我不是選搬家的日子，是管委會選了我。
五千塊保證金，換三個小時的電梯使用權——這大概是我住過最貴的三小時。

en.content:
The new building's rules: you may only move in on weekdays between nine and noon,
book the elevator three days ahead, leave a refundable deposit for the padding, and don't let furniture touch a wall.
I called to reserve a slot and the first morning available was the third week of August.
So I burned a vacation day and stood inside somebody else's three-hour window,
shoving my entire life through it as fast as I could.
en.editorNote: For anyone moving into a managed building; before you sign, ask the building office about move-in hours, booking lead time, and the deposit, then book the movers around that — do it in the other order and you'll have a truck downstairs while you beg the front desk for an exception
variations: I didn't pick my moving day. The building committee picked it for me.
A deposit for three hours of elevator access — the priciest three hours I've ever rented.

items.sourceNote: landlords hold deposits until the final shared-meter electricity bill arrives, which in summer can be two billing cycles later; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
八月退租，鑰匙交出去那天我問押金什麼時候退。
房東說要等最後一期電費結算，台電兩個月才寄一次。
我算了一下：夏天走的人，押金要等到秋天才會回來。
他扣的是三千塊的電，押的是我兩萬塊的下一步。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合正在退租的人；交屋當天就跟房東一起抄下電表度數、拍照留存，並在合約或交屋單上寫明「電費結清後幾日內退還餘額」，別讓「等帳單」變成無限期——押金本來就該在交還房屋後儘速返還
variations: 夏天退租的押金，是一種秋天才會到貨的東西。
他要結算的是三千塊電費，卡住的是我兩萬塊的搬家預算。

en.content:
I moved out in August, and the day I handed over the keys I asked when I'd get the deposit back.
He said we had to wait for the final electricity bill, and those only come every two months.
So: leave in summer, get your deposit back in autumn.
He's holding back thirty bucks of power usage and sitting on the money for my next move.
en.editorNote: For anyone moving out right now; photograph the meter reading together on handover day and get it in writing that the balance comes back within a set number of days after the bill settles, so "waiting on the utility" doesn't turn open-ended — the deposit is supposed to come back promptly once the unit is returned
variations: A summer deposit is something that ships in autumn.
He's settling a small power bill. He's holding my entire moving budget.

items.sourceNote: August turnover in shared flats: the remaining tenant must find a replacement or absorb the whole rent, doing landlord work without landlord authority; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
室友八月要回南部，走之前拍拍我肩膀說：「我幫你留意有沒有人接。」
然後就沒有然後了。
這個月是我在回訊息、我在帶看、我在解釋熱水器怎麼開、我在判斷這個人會不會半夜打鼓。
合約上我跟房東是同一邊的名字，
實際上我做著房東的工作，卻沒有房東的權力，也沒有房東的收入。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合暑假被留下來找人接手的合租族；先翻合約看是誰對房東負連帶責任、房東同不同意換人，再決定要不要自己找——把該由房東處理的招租變成你的責任前，至少讓他把新室友的約直接簽在他名下
variations: 室友走的時候留下一句「我幫你留意」，跟一整個月的空房。
帶看是我、面試是我、承擔空租的也是我，房東只負責收錢。

en.content:
My flatmate is heading home in August. On the way out she patted my shoulder: "I'll keep an eye out for someone to take my room."
That was the last I heard of it.
So this month I'm the one answering messages, running tours, explaining the water heater, and judging whether a stranger seems likely to practice drums at midnight.
On paper the landlord and I are on the same lease.
In practice I'm doing the landlord's job with none of the landlord's authority and none of the landlord's income.
en.editorNote: For anyone left holding a shared flat over the summer; check the lease for who's jointly liable and whether the landlord has to approve a swap before you start recruiting — and if filling the room becomes your job, at least make him sign the new person onto his own paperwork
variations: She left me an "I'll keep an eye out" and a full month of empty room.
I run the tours, I vet the strangers, I eat the empty month. He just collects.

items.sourceNote: peak-season house-hunting threads: renters cramming five or six viewings into one weekend day and watching their own criteria collapse by the last one; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
八月第一個週末，我一天看了六間房。
第一間嫌沒有對外窗，第二間嫌房東太熱情，第三間嫌走到捷運要十五分鐘。
看到第六間，天已經黑了，我站在一個比第一間還小的房間裡，
心裡只剩下一句：有窗就好。
旺季不會讓房子變多，
它只是慢慢地、有禮貌地，把你的標準拿走。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合週末排滿看房行程的人；一天最多看三間，每間拍一段影片、當場記下租金、水電計價方式和一個最不能接受的缺點，晚上再一起比——不然看到第六間，你比較的已經不是房子，是自己還剩多少力氣
variations: 看到第五間的時候，我的條件從「理想」改成「可以睡」。
旺季沒有讓房子變多，只是把我的標準看薄了。

en.content:
First weekend of August, I toured six places in one day.
The first had no exterior window. The second had a landlord who was too friendly. The third was fifteen minutes from the station.
By the sixth it was dark out, and I was standing in a room smaller than the first one,
thinking only: there's a window, that'll do.
Peak season doesn't create more apartments.
It just politely, gradually, takes your standards away.
en.editorNote: For anyone with a weekend packed with viewings; cap it at three a day, shoot a short video of each and write down the rent, how utilities are billed, and the one dealbreaker while you're standing there, then compare at night — otherwise by the sixth place you're not comparing apartments, you're comparing how much energy you have left
variations: By the fifth viewing my requirements had gone from "ideal" to "sleepable."
Peak season didn't add apartments. It just wore my standards thin.

items.sourceNote: walk-up moves: per-floor stair charges and the classic problem of oversized furniture that cannot clear a stairwell turn; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
新家在老公寓五樓，沒有電梯。
搬家師傅看了一眼樓梯間就說：「這個轉角，沙發上不去。」
我們試了三次，抬高、側轉、拆腳，
最後那張我存了半年才買的沙發，停在三樓半，卡成一個問號。
它後來留給了三樓的阿姨，她很開心。
搬進新家的第一晚，我坐在地板上吃便當，
才發現搬家丟掉的從來不只是東西，
還有一點點「我可以擁有大件家具」的錯覺。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合要搬進無電梯老公寓的人；簽約前先量樓梯轉角的淨寬跟上方高度，回頭對照沙發、床墊、冰箱的尺寸，順便問清楚搬家公司的樓層費怎麼算——大型家具上不去這件事，現場才知道是最貴的知道法
variations: 我的沙發沒有搬進新家，它在三樓半就退休了。
看房的時候我量了房間，忘了量樓梯。

en.content:
New place: fifth floor of an old walk-up. No elevator.
The mover took one look at the stairwell and said, "That turn. The couch isn't going up."
We tried three times — tilted it, spun it, took the legs off —
and the couch I'd saved six months for came to a stop on the landing, wedged into a question mark.
It went to the neighbor downstairs instead. She was thrilled.
First night in the new place I ate takeout sitting on the floor,
and figured out that moving doesn't just cost you things.
It costs you the small illusion that you get to own big ones.
en.editorNote: For anyone moving into a walk-up; before you sign, measure the narrowest point of the stairwell and the clearance above the turn, check it against your couch, mattress, and fridge, and ask exactly how the movers' per-floor charge works — finding out on the day that the furniture won't fit is the most expensive way to find out
variations: My couch never made it to the new place. It retired on the third-floor landing.
I measured the room. I forgot to measure the stairs.

items.sourceNote: tenants may rekey their own door but not the building entrance, must not damage the door, and should keep the original lock to restore at move-out; once the lease starts they owe no copy of the new key; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
交屋那天房東給我三把鑰匙，說：「以前的房客都還了，你放心。」
我沒問「還了幾把」，因為問了他也只會再說一次同一句。
隔週我自己找了鎖匠，換掉我房間那道門的鎖，
舊鎖跟舊鑰匙收進箱子，等退租再裝回去。花了一千二。
那不是防他，也不是防誰，
是我想在這一年裡，至少有一道門，是我自己決定誰能打開的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合剛入住的人；分租套房只能換自己房間的鎖、不要動大門，也不要鑽孔或破壞門體，舊鎖務必留著退租時裝回原狀。租約開始後房屋的使用權在你這邊，換了鎖不必再交一把新的給房東——但事前先跟他說一聲，通常能省掉後面很多爭執
variations: 三把鑰匙，不代表世界上只有三把鑰匙。
一千二買不到安全感，但買得到一道我說了算的門。

en.content:
On handover day the landlord handed me three keys and said, "All the old tenants gave theirs back, don't worry."
I didn't ask how many they'd been given in the first place, because he'd just say the same sentence again.
The next week I called a locksmith and rekeyed my own door.
Old lock and old keys into a box until I move out. Forty bucks.
It wasn't about him, and it wasn't about anyone in particular.
I just wanted one door this year where I'm the one deciding who gets to open it.
en.editorNote: For anyone who just moved in; in a shared unit you can only rekey your own door, never the building entrance, don't drill or damage the door itself, and keep the original lock so you can put it back at move-out. Once the lease starts the unit is yours to use, so you don't owe the landlord a copy of the new key — but telling him beforehand saves a lot of arguing later
variations: Three keys doesn't mean there are only three keys.
The lock didn't buy me safety. It bought me one door that answers to me.

items.sourceNote: August first-time signers; the official standard residential lease template, the two-month deposit cap, repair liability and early-termination terms are the clauses landlords gloss over; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
二十三歲，第一次自己簽租約。
房東把單子推過來，說：「大家都嘛這樣簽，很單純。」
我拿出手機，把內政部的定型化契約調出來，一條一條對，
對到第七條，他的表情就變了。
我媽在電話那頭只說「你自己看著辦」。
那一刻我才懂那句話的意思：
成年不是有人放手讓你飛，
是從今以後，沒有人會幫你檢查合約。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合八月第一次自己簽約的人；先把內政部版的房屋租賃定型化契約調出來當對照，重點看押金金額（不得超過兩個月租金）、修繕責任歸誰、提前終止要付多少、水電怎麼計價。對方越是輕描淡寫說「大家都這樣簽」的地方，就越是該逐字看完的地方
variations: 「大家都嘛這樣簽」是一句話，不是一個條款。
成年的實感不是生日蛋糕，是簽名前那三十秒的猶豫。

en.content:
Twenty-three, signing my own lease for the first time.
The landlord slid the paper across and said, "Everyone signs it like this, it's simple."
I pulled the official standard lease up on my phone and went line by line.
Around clause seven his face changed.
My mom had said "you'll figure it out" on the phone,
and that was the moment I understood what she meant.
Being an adult isn't someone letting go so you can fly.
It's that from now on, nobody checks your contract for you.
en.editorNote: For anyone signing a first lease this month; open the official standard residential lease as a reference and read specifically for the deposit cap, who pays for repairs, what breaking the lease costs, and how utilities are priced. Whatever the other person waves off as "everyone signs it like this" is exactly the part to read word for word
variations: "Everyone signs it like this" is a sentence, not a clause.
Adulthood didn't show up with a cake. It showed up in the thirty seconds before I signed.

items.sourceNote: shared-partition unit threads: tenants describing how they self-censor their own noise once they realize the thin wall works both ways; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
搬進分租套房的第三個月，我發現我開始小聲地活著。
講電話走到樓梯間，看影片戴耳機，半夜難過要先把臉埋進枕頭。
沒有人抗議過。
是我聽了兩個月隔壁的咳嗽、鍵盤聲和七點的鬧鐘，
才明白我的每一聲，他也收得一乾二淨。
這裡的隔音從來不是牆做的，
是五個房客各自吞回去的那一半聲音。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合住輕隔間套房的人；看房時敲一敲隔間牆，聽起來空空的通常就是輕隔間，晚上八點到十點再回來站個五分鐘最準。已經住進去了就務實一點：床頭不要靠隔間牆、把書櫃或衣櫃推過去當緩衝、地上鋪厚一點的地墊，比買吸音棉有感很多
variations: 薄牆最公平的地方是：你聽得到他，他也聽得到你。
我沒有變安靜，我只是把音量調到房租買得起的大小。

en.content:
Third month in the shared unit, I noticed I'd started living quietly.
Phone calls out in the stairwell, headphones for everything, face in the pillow if I need to fall apart at 2 a.m.
Nobody ever complained.
It's that after two months of the guy next door coughing, typing, and hitting snooze at seven,
I understood he was getting all of me too.
The soundproofing here isn't made of walls.
It's five tenants each swallowing half of their own noise.
en.editorNote: For anyone in a thin-partition unit; knock on the divider when you tour — a hollow sound means lightweight drywall — and come back between 8 and 10 p.m. to actually listen. If you already live there, be practical: keep the bed off the shared wall, push a bookcase or wardrobe against it as a buffer, and put down a thick rug. All of that beats any foam panel you can buy
variations: The fair thing about thin walls: he hears you exactly as much as you hear him.
I didn't get quieter. I just turned myself down to a volume my rent could afford.

items.sourceNote: sublet rules: a master tenant needs the owner's consent to sublet, and listings marked owner-direct are often master tenants living on site who control the shared spaces; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
廣告寫「屋主直租」，看房那天他也真的很像屋主。
住進來才知道，他是二房東，而且就住走廊最底那間。
客廳是他的、洗衣機是他的、冰箱第二層以上是他的，
晚上十一點以後不能開伙，也是他的。
我以為我租到一間房，
其實我是搬進了別人的家，每個月付錢，當那個最有禮貌的客人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在看分租套房的人；簽約前直接要求看原始租約或建物權狀，確認對方有沒有轉租的權利，公共空間怎麼用、有沒有時段限制也要白紙黑字寫進合約。當二房東本身不違法，違法的是沒經過屋主同意就轉租——那份約隨時可能被大房東終止，你的押金也會跟著卡在中間
variations: 「屋主直租」四個字，是租屋廣告裡最便宜的一句話。
我租的不是套房，是一個房東住在裡面的家。

en.content:
The listing said "direct from owner," and on the tour he really did seem like the owner.
After I moved in I found out he's the master tenant — and he lives in the room at the end of the hall.
The living room is his. The washer is his. Everything above the second fridge shelf is his.
So is the rule about no cooking after eleven.
I thought I'd rented a room.
What I did was move into somebody's home and pay monthly to be the politest guest in it.
en.editorNote: For anyone touring a shared unit; before signing, ask to see the original lease or the property deed and confirm the person actually has the right to sublet, then get the shared-space rules and any time restrictions written into your contract. Being a master tenant isn't illegal — subletting without the owner's consent is, and that lease can be terminated out from under you with your deposit stuck inside it
variations: "Direct from owner" is the cheapest sentence in any rental listing.
I didn't rent a studio. I rented a room in a house where the landlord sleeps.

items.sourceNote: peak-season viewing tips: during July–August the outgoing tenant often shows the room, and is the only honest source on repairs and defects; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
八月看房，開門的是現任房客，房東說他今天走不開。
我照著網路上教的問了一句：「請問你為什麼要搬？」
他說工作調動，笑得很標準。
看完要走的時候，他跟到門口，把聲音壓低補了一句：
「浴室排水很慢，我跟房東講過三次了。」
那天我學到，房子最真的資訊不在租屋網，
在一個正要離開的人，站在門邊、停頓兩秒才說出口的那句話。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合旺季排滿看房的人；如果開門的是現任房客，把握他還在的那十分鐘，問三題就好——你為什麼要搬、報修房東大概多久處理、夏天的水電大約多少。同樣的問題，房東答的是行銷版，房客答的是實測版。要走的時候別急著走，多數人的真話都留在門口那一句
variations: 房東給的是簡介，現任房客給的是評論。
「工作調動」通常是真的，但它很少是唯一的原因。

en.content:
August viewing, and the person who opened the door was the current tenant — the landlord couldn't make it.
I asked the question the internet told me to ask: "Why are you moving out?"
Work relocation, he said, with a very standard smile.
On my way out he followed me to the door, dropped his voice, and added:
"The bathroom drains slow. I've told him three times."
That's when I learned the truest thing about a place isn't in the listing.
It's whatever the person on their way out says at the door, after a two-second pause.
en.editorNote: For anyone with viewings stacked up this month; if the current tenant is showing you around, use those ten minutes and ask three things — why they're leaving, how long repairs actually take, and what utilities run in summer. The landlord answers those in marketing copy; a tenant answers from experience. And don't rush out the door, because that's where most people save the honest sentence
variations: The landlord hands you the brochure. The current tenant hands you the review.
"Work relocation" is usually true. It's rarely the whole reason.

items.sourceNote: move-in threads about belongings the previous tenant left behind, and the standard advice to document and hold them rather than bin them; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
新房間交到我手上的時候不是空的。
衣櫃深處掛著一件別人的黑外套，抽屜裡有半包藥和一支沒水的筆，
冰箱門上還貼著一張便條，寫著「記得繳」，後面那個字被撕掉了。
房東只說：「上一個住得很急，走得也急。」
我把那些東西裝進紙箱塞到床底，一放就是一年。
退租那天才拿出來，順手發現自己也留了一把傘在門後。
租來的房間大概就是這樣，
我們都以為自己只是路過，卻各自留下一點證據。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合八月剛入住的人；前房客留下的東西先別直接丟，拍照存證後告知房東、放個三個月再處理，證件或看起來貴重的請房東幫忙聯絡。同時也提醒自己：退租點交前，衣櫃最上層、床底、陽台角落和門後這四個地方最常漏掉，交鑰匙前先繞一圈
variations: 我搬進來的第一件事，是幫一個不認識的人收東西。
房間是空的，但沒有人真的把自己全部帶走。

en.content:
The room wasn't empty when they handed it to me.
A stranger's black jacket at the back of the closet. Half a box of pills and a dead pen in the drawer.
A note still stuck to the fridge that said "remember to pay" — the next word torn off.
The landlord just said, "The last one moved in fast and left faster."
I boxed it all up, shoved it under the bed, and left it there a full year.
I pulled it out the day I moved out, and that's when I noticed the umbrella I'd left behind the door.
That's what a rented room is.
We all think we're just passing through, and we all leave a little evidence.
en.editorNote: For anyone who just moved in this month; don't bin what the last tenant left — photograph it, tell the landlord, hold it a few months, and ask him to pass along anything that looks like ID or valuables. Then take the hint for yourself: the top closet shelf, under the bed, the balcony corner, and behind the door are where your own things hide. Walk the room once before you hand back the keys
variations: First thing I did in my new place was pack up a stranger's things.
The room was empty. Nobody ever really takes all of themselves with them.

items.sourceNote: 2026 news about a major rental-management (包租代管) operator's financial trouble and tenants whose rent never reached the property owner; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
