我的房租是繳給一家公司的，公司再轉給屋主。
上個月屋主突然傳訊息問我：「你這三個月怎麼都沒繳？」
我把三張匯款截圖傳過去，他回：「那你的錢跑去哪了？」
我也很想知道。
新聞說那家公司正在清查，我們兩個就一起等清查。
我第一次發現，房東跟房客原來可以站在同一邊，
只是要先有第三個人，把中間那筆錢弄不見。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合把租金繳給租賃住宅服務業者的人；先確認自己簽的是「包租」（你的對象是業者）還是「代管」（你的對象仍是屋主），這決定出事時該找誰。所有匯款紀錄與對話截圖留著，主動跟屋主建立直接聯繫並書面說明已繳，別讓自己變成雙方都不承認的那一段；業者有異常可向當地政府地政局或消保官申訴
variations: 我繳了三個月房租，屋主說他一毛都沒收到。
房東跟房客會變成隊友，只要中間有人把錢弄丟。

en.content:
I pay my rent to a management company, and the company forwards it to the owner.
Last month the owner messaged me: "Why haven't you paid in three months?"
I sent him three transfer screenshots. He wrote back, "So where did your money go?"
Great question.
The news says the company is under review, so now the two of us are waiting on the same review.
That's when I learned a landlord and a tenant can end up on the same side —
it just takes a third party losing the money in between.
en.editorNote: For anyone paying rent to a rental management company; first check whether your contract is with the company itself or with the owner, because that decides who you chase when things go wrong. Keep every transfer record and chat log, open a direct line to the owner, and put in writing that you already paid — don't become the gap neither side will claim
variations: I paid three months of rent. The owner says he never saw a cent of it.
Landlord and tenant become teammates the moment someone in the middle loses the money.

items.sourceNote: 2026 rent subsidy rules: existing recipients keep the old eligibility only if they stay at the same rental address; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
續領租金補貼有一條但書：地址要跟去年同一個。
所以我認真算了一次——
搬去離公司近二十分鐘的那間，一年能換回多少個晚上，
再扣掉可能領不到的那筆錢。
算完，我留在原地。
房東還是那個房東，牆角那塊壁癌還是那塊壁癌，
只是現在多了一個聽起來很成熟的理由。
補貼沒有綁住我，
是我自己拿它，把自己綁得很牢。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在猶豫要不要搬家的補貼戶；舊戶同一地址續領可沿用原本認定，換了地址就得符合新規（要有房屋稅籍、用途登記住家用）。決定前先查清楚看中的新房子過不過得了關，別讓每月幾千塊，替你決定接下來三年住在哪裡
variations: 我沒有搬家，理由聽起來很像理財，其實是不敢。
領補貼的條件之一，是不要改變。

en.content:
There's a catch to renewing the rent subsidy: the address has to match last year's.
So I actually ran the numbers —
how many evenings I'd win back by moving twenty minutes closer to work,
minus the money I might stop qualifying for.
I stayed.
Same landlord, same patch of mold in the corner,
just with a reason that now sounds financially responsible.
The subsidy didn't tie me down.
I picked it up and tied the knot myself.
en.editorNote: For subsidy recipients weighing a move; renewing at the same address keeps your old eligibility, while a new address has to meet the current rules. Check whether the place you're eyeing actually qualifies before you decide — don't let a few thousand a month choose where you live for the next three years
variations: I didn't move. It sounded like budgeting. It was fear.
One condition of keeping the subsidy is not changing anything.

items.sourceNote: 2026 policy detail: landlords who cooperate with a tenant's subsidy application can register as 公益出租人 and receive income/house/land tax breaks; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
住了三年，房東第一次主動打給我。
他說：「你上次講的那個補貼，我可以配合簽。」
我愣了兩秒，問他怎麼突然願意。
他很誠實：「朋友算給我看，我配合的話，自己的稅也少一截。」
不是良心發現，是他算完發現我們站同一邊。
我從前一直以為，要房東照規矩來得靠拜託、靠不好意思、靠運氣，
原來有時候只要規則設計得夠聰明，
善意就會自己長出來。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合正要開口跟房東談補貼的人；與其訴諸人情，不如直接講「你也划算」——配合房客申請並簽約的房東可登記為公益出租人，綜所稅、房屋稅、地價稅都有減免。談之前先把內政部的說明頁存好，用一張紙講清楚，比講三次拜託有效
variations: 他不是變好了，他只是算出我們同一邊。
最靠得住的善意，是雙方都划算的那一種。

en.content:
Three years in, my landlord called me first for once.
"That subsidy you mentioned — I'll sign whatever you need."
I froze for a second and asked what changed.
He was honest about it: "A friend did the math for me. If I cooperate, my own taxes drop too."
Not a change of heart. He just ran the numbers and found we were on the same side.
I used to think getting a landlord to play by the rules took pleading, awkwardness, and luck.
Turns out that when a rule is designed well enough,
goodwill grows on its own.
en.editorNote: For anyone about to raise the subsidy with their landlord; skip the appeal to kindness and lead with what he gets — landlords who sign and cooperate can register for meaningful tax relief. Bring the official page with the numbers on it. One printed sheet works better than three rounds of asking nicely
variations: He didn't get nicer. He just found out we were on the same side.
The most reliable goodwill is the kind that pays both people.

items.sourceNote: 2026 requirement that the rented unit carry a house tax record with 住家用 registered use; tenants discovering their unit is registered as an office; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
調了謄本才知道，我住的地方，主要用途登記是「事務所」。
也就是說，這五年我每天下班，都回到一個法律上只能開會的地方。
我在裡面煮飯、洗澡、發燒、哭過兩次、把窗簾換成自己喜歡的顏色。
房子從頭到尾不知道自己被登記成什麼，
知道的是一張紙。
現在的規定要「住家用」才算數，
我這才發現，一個地方能不能叫做家，
還得先經過一份表格點頭。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合簽約前或準備申請補貼的人；花幾十塊到地政事務所或線上調建物登記謄本，看「主要用途」那一欄是不是住家用。登記成事務所、辦公室或工業用的物件，不只補貼可能卡關，火險理賠與後續權益也可能不同。簽約前問一句，比住進去五年才知道省事太多
variations: 我住的地方，在紙上是一間辦公室。
我把它過成家過了五年，表格從頭到尾沒同意過。

en.content:
I pulled the property record and found out my place is registered as an office.
Which means that for five years I've been coming home every night to somewhere you're legally only supposed to hold meetings.
I cooked in it. Showered in it. Ran a fever in it. Cried in it twice. Swapped the curtains for a color I actually liked.
The building never knew what it had been filed as.
Only a piece of paper knew.
The current rules only count a place registered for residential use,
and that's when it hit me: whether somewhere gets to be called home
still has to clear a form first.
en.editorNote: For anyone about to sign or apply for a subsidy; pay the small fee to pull the building registration and check the registered use. A unit filed as an office or industrial space can stall a subsidy, and your insurance and other protections may differ too. One question before signing beats finding out five years in
variations: On paper, the place I live is an office.
I made a home out of it for five years. The paperwork never agreed.

items.sourceNote: Taiwan standard residential lease rules: tenants are entitled to a contract review period of at least three days before signing; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
租約傳過來的那天下午，房東在訊息裡打：「晚上七點來簽，我後面還有兩組在等。」
我說我想先把條款看一遍，明天回覆他。
他回了一個句號。
後來我才知道，法律給我的時間是至少三天，不是四個小時。
那三天不是拿來拖，是拿來把一份要住一年的東西讀完。
最後我還是租了那間，
只是簽名的時候，手沒有抖。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合被催著當場簽約的人；租賃定型化契約明定房客有至少三日的契約審閱期，房東或代管業者不能要求你看完當下就簽。想爭取時間就直接在訊息裡說「依規定我需要三天審閱期」，把對話留著。真的怕被搶走的物件，可以先付定金，並要求白紙黑字寫明用途與退還條件
variations: 他說後面還有兩組在等，法律說我有三天。
我最後還是簽了，只是這次是我自己決定的。

en.content:
The afternoon the lease landed in my inbox, the landlord texted: "Come sign at seven, I've got two other people waiting."
I said I'd like to read it through and get back to him tomorrow.
He replied with a single period.
I found out later that the law gives me at least three days, not four hours.
Those three days aren't for stalling. They're for finishing a document you're about to live inside for a year.
I took the place in the end.
I just didn't sign with a shaky hand.
en.editorNote: For anyone being rushed into signing on the spot; a standard residential lease comes with a mandatory review period of at least three days, and no landlord or property manager can demand you sign the moment you finish reading. Ask for it in writing so the message thread has a record. If you're genuinely worried about losing the unit, put down a holding deposit with the purpose and refund terms spelled out on paper
variations: He said two other people were waiting. The law said I had three days.
I signed it anyway. The difference is that this time I chose to.

items.sourceUrl: https://epaper.land.gov.taipei/Item/Detail/常見之租賃糾紛與教戰守則-1/
items.sourceNote: Taiwan's mandatory and prohibited clauses for residential leases — clauses forfeiting the deposit or waiving repair rights are void even if written in; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
我的租約上有一行字：「押金於退租時不予退還。」
房東說這是他們一直以來的規矩，白紙黑字寫了就算數。
我查了很久才知道，這種條款屬於不得記載事項，寫進去也不生效。
那一行字從頭到尾沒有任何力量，
可是它嚇了我三個月。
最貴的從來不是押金，
是我以為自己沒有選擇的那段日子。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合簽約前想逐條看懂合約的人；內政部公告的租賃契約有「應記載」與「不得記載」事項，像是拋棄押金、拋棄修繕請求權、限制房客申報租金支出或申請補貼、約定房東可任意進入，這些寫了都無效。簽約前把那份公告存成 PDF 放手機裡，看到怪條款當場比對，別自己先吞下去
variations: 那行字沒有任何效力，可是它嚇了我三個月。
合約寫得再兇，也大不過它上面那條法律。

en.content:
There's a line in my lease that reads: "The deposit shall not be returned upon move-out."
My landlord said that's how they've always done it, and it's right there in black and white.
It took me a while to learn that a clause like that is one the law forbids, and writing it in doesn't make it real.
That sentence never had any power at all,
and it still scared me for three months.
The expensive part was never the deposit.
It was the stretch of time I spent believing I had no choice.
en.editorNote: For anyone reading a lease line by line before signing; the official standard lease sets out both required clauses and prohibited ones. Forfeiting your deposit outright, waiving your right to repairs, barring you from claiming rent on your taxes or applying for a subsidy, letting the landlord enter at will — all void, however boldly they're typed. Save the official list to your phone and check odd clauses against it on the spot
variations: That line carried no legal weight, and it still scared me for three months.
A lease can sound as harsh as it likes. It still ranks below the law above it.

items.sourceUrl: https://www.housefeel.com.tw/article/定金-押金-租金-退押金-租屋費用/
items.sourceNote: Deposit deduction disputes and the legal line between normal wear-and-tear and tenant-caused damage at move-out; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
退租那天，房東拿手電筒照牆，說要回復原狀。
我承認那面牆上有三個釘孔。
掛過一個鐘、一面鏡子，還有一張我很喜歡的海報。
他說那是損壞，我說那是我住過的痕跡。
法律的講法比較無聊，叫做正常使用下的自然耗損，不用賠。
那天我沒有講贏他，我只是站在那裡想：
住了兩年，我留在這面牆上的東西，最後只剩三個洞。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合退租前一週開始準備的人；「回復原狀」是回到入住時的狀態，正常使用造成的自然耗損——牆面泛黃、輕微釘孔、家具磨損、燈管老化——依法不用賠，房東能扣的是額外損壞與欠繳費用。入住那天就把每個房間、每面牆各拍一輪存雲端，退租時用同角度再拍一次，兩組照片並排，比講十句都有用
variations: 他說那是損壞，我說那是我住過的痕跡。
住了兩年，我留在那面牆上的東西只剩三個洞。

en.content:
On move-out day my landlord ran a flashlight along the wall and said it had to go back to original condition.
I'll admit there are three nail holes in it.
A clock hung there. Then a mirror. Then a poster I was fond of.
He called it damage. I called it evidence that someone lived here.
The legal wording is duller — ordinary wear and tear from normal use, nothing you owe money for.
I didn't win the argument that day. I just stood there thinking:
two years, and what I left on this wall comes down to three holes.
en.editorNote: For anyone a week out from moving out; "original condition" means the state you moved into, and ordinary wear from normal living — yellowed paint, small nail holes, worn furniture, dimming bulbs — isn't yours to pay for. A landlord can only deduct for real damage and unpaid bills. Photograph every room and every wall the day you move in, back it up, then reshoot the same angles at move-out. Two sets side by side beat any amount of arguing
variations: He called it damage. I called it evidence that someone lived here.
Two years in that room, and what I left on the wall is three holes.

items.sourceUrl: https://epaper.land.gov.taipei/Item/Detail/常見之租賃糾紛與教戰守則-1/
items.sourceNote: Free township/district mediation committees as the standard route for rental deposit disputes; a successful mediation confirmed by the court has the force of a judgment; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
為了兩萬四，我走進區公所的調解委員會。
桌上有紙杯裝的茶，是冷的。
對面坐著我房東，他把外套掛在椅背上，像來開會。
主席問我們要不要各退一步，我說我已經退到門外了。
最後拿回一萬八。簽完字，兩個人一起等電梯，誰都沒說話。
那天我學會的不是怎麼贏，
是原來這種事，我可以不用自己吞下去。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合押金要不回來、又不想直接進法院的人；鄉鎮市區公所的調解委員會不收費，任何人都能聲請，調解成立後送法院核定，效力等同判決。去之前把租約、匯款紀錄、入住與退租照片、對話截圖整理成一份時間序，聲請書上把金額與日期寫清楚，別到現場才開始回想
variations: 那天我學會的不是怎麼贏，是我可以不用自己吞。
簽完字一起等電梯，誰都沒說話。

en.content:
For the equivalent of two months' deposit, I walked into the district mediation office.
There was tea on the table in a paper cup. It was cold.
My landlord sat across from me with his jacket over the chair back, like he'd come for a meeting.
The chair asked if we could each give a little ground. I said I'd already backed out the door.
I got three quarters of it back. After we signed, we waited for the same elevator and neither of us said a word.
What I learned that day wasn't how to win.
It was that this kind of thing isn't something I have to just swallow.
en.editorNote: For anyone stuck on a deposit who doesn't want to go straight to court; local mediation committees are free, open to anyone to file with, and a settlement confirmed by the court carries the same force as a judgment. Before you go, put the lease, transfer records, move-in and move-out photos, and message screenshots into one timeline, and state the exact amount and dates on the application. Don't start reconstructing it in the room
variations: What I learned wasn't how to win. It was that I didn't have to swallow it.
We waited for the same elevator afterward and neither of us said a word.

items.sourceNote: 2026 portable air-conditioner buying guides aimed at renters whose landlords won't replace an old wall unit; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
房東的冷氣修過三次，師傅第四次來，看了三秒就跟我說：「這台不是壞，是老。」
我等不到換新的那天，自己買了一台移動式冷氣。
一萬二，排熱管從窗縫伸出去，縫用泡棉塞住。
它運轉起來像有人在房間裡拖行李，但至少那個聲音是我的。
退租那天我才想起來——它二十七公斤，新家在五樓，沒有電梯。
最後我把它留在原地。
房東看了一眼，說：「這台留著也好。」
我沒接話。我花一萬二買的是那兩個夏天，不是那台機器。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合房東遲遲不換冷氣、又不想再吵下去的人。移動式冷氣是過渡方案不是解方：排熱管一定要真的通到室外、窗縫要封死，否則熱氣回灌等於白吹；耗電比分離式高，機身多半二十五到三十五公斤，買之前先想過搬家那天。另外冷氣是房東提供的設備，非因房客故意或過失而故障，修繕責任在房東——報修全部走文字留紀錄，催告後仍不修，可自行修繕並從租金扣抵
variations: 師傅說：這台不是壞，是老。
我花一萬二買的是那兩個夏天，不是那台機器。

en.content:
The landlord's AC had been repaired three times. On the fourth visit the technician looked at it for three seconds and said, "It isn't broken. It's old."
I gave up waiting for a new one and bought a portable unit myself.
Four hundred bucks, exhaust hose out the window gap, foam stuffed around it.
It sounds like someone dragging a suitcase across the room, but at least the noise is mine.
Move-out day is when it hit me: sixty pounds, and the new place is a fifth-floor walk-up.
I left it where it stood.
The landlord glanced at it and said, "Might as well keep it here."
I didn't answer. What I paid for wasn't the machine. It was those two summers.
en.editorNote: For anyone whose landlord will not replace a dying AC and who is done arguing about it. A portable unit is a stopgap, not a fix: the exhaust hose has to actually vent outside and the window gap has to be sealed, or the heat just cycles back in. They draw more power than a split unit and weigh sixty-plus pounds, so think about moving day before you buy. Also worth knowing: appliances the landlord supplied are the landlord's to repair unless you broke them. Put every repair request in writing, and check your local rules on repair-and-deduct if the deadline passes
variations: The technician said it wasn't broken. It was old.
What I paid for wasn't the machine. It was those two summers.

items.sourceNote: Fire-safety guidance for subdivided rental units — blocked corridors, extinguisher and smoke-alarm requirements, public safety inspection filing; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
我住的那層樓被隔成八間。
走廊兩邊堆著房東的舊冰箱、三箱磁磚，還有一台沒人認領的腳踏車，
中間留下一條剛好一個人側身通過的路。
公共安全檢查的前一天，他找了兩個人來，兩個小時清得乾乾淨淨。
檢查完的隔天下午，冰箱回來了。
後來我養成一個習慣：每次走過那條走廊，都在心裡演練一次「現在起火我往哪邊跑」。
房租一萬三，附的是這個。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合正在看分租套房的人當現場檢查清單：每層樓至少一支滅火器且壓力表指在綠色區、走廊與樓梯全程淨空、有第二條逃生路線而不是只有一道大鐵門、房間內有偵煙器、鐵窗留逃生開口且鑰匙就掛在旁邊。同一層隔成六間以上或十房以上，屬於公共安全檢查申報的對象，簽約前可以直接請房東出示申報紀錄。走廊長期堆放雜物影響逃生，可向當地消防局檢舉，檢舉能匿名
variations: 檢查完的隔天下午，冰箱回來了。
每次走過那條走廊，我都在心裡演練一次往哪邊跑。

en.content:
My floor was chopped into eight units.
Both sides of the corridor held the landlord's old fridge, three boxes of spare tile, and a bike nobody claimed,
leaving a path exactly one person wide if you turned sideways.
The day before the safety inspection he sent two guys over. Two hours and the hallway was spotless.
The afternoon after the inspection, the fridge came back.
I picked up a habit after that: every time I walked down that corridor I rehearsed which way I'd run if it caught fire right now.
Four hundred a month, and this is what it came with.
en.editorNote: Use this as a walkthrough checklist for any subdivided rental: one working extinguisher per floor with the gauge in the green, corridors and stairwells clear end to end, a second way out rather than a single steel door, a smoke alarm inside the unit, and window bars with a release opening and the key hanging beside it. Where a floor is carved into six or more units, buildings usually fall under periodic public safety inspection — ask to see the filing before you sign. A permanently blocked escape route is worth reporting to the fire authority, and reports can be anonymous
variations: The afternoon after the inspection, the fridge came back.
Every walk down that corridor, I rehearsed which way I'd run.

items.sourceNote: 2026 rental dispute guidance on landlord entry rights, retained keys and shared-space arrangements; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
我租的是三房公寓的其中一間，客廳角落有一張神明桌。
仲介說：「你不用管它，房東初一十五自己會來。」
於是每個月有兩天，早上七點會有人用自己的鑰匙開門，
點三炷香，站在客廳唸一段我聽不懂的話，再把桌上的水果換掉。
他不是壞人，離開前還會敲我房門說：「這個橘子拿去吃。」
但我還是慢慢學會了：那兩天不睡到八點、不穿睡褲走出房間、不在客廳吃早餐。
一個月三十天，我實際租到的是二十八天。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合遇到「房東保留部分空間使用權」的租客。重點不是不准他來，而是要把規則寫進契約：進入的事由、固定時段、提前多久通知（建議至少二十四小時並取得同意），以及他手上那把鑰匙能開到哪裡。沒有約定就自己開門進屋，可能構成無故侵入住宅。看房時只要看到神明桌、房東的儲物箱、上鎖的其中一間房，先問清楚誰會來、多久來一次，再決定要不要簽
variations: 一個月三十天，我實際租到的是二十八天。
他不是壞人，只是那間客廳從來就不是我的。

en.content:
I rent one bedroom in a three-bedroom apartment, and there's a family altar in the corner of the living room.
The agent said, "Don't worry about it, the landlord comes twice a month to tend it."
So two mornings a month, at seven, someone lets himself in with his own key,
lights three sticks of incense, stands in the living room saying words I don't follow, and swaps out the fruit on the table.
He isn't a bad guy. On his way out he knocks and says, "Take one of these oranges."
Still, I learned the rules: on those two days I don't sleep till eight, don't walk out in pajamas, don't eat breakfast in the living room.
Thirty days a month, and twenty-eight of them are mine.
en.editorNote: For tenants whose landlord keeps a foothold in the shared space. The goal isn't to bar him — it's to get the terms into the lease: why he can enter, on which fixed days, how much notice (twenty-four hours and your agreement is a fair floor), and exactly what his retained key opens. Letting himself in with no agreed basis can cross into unlawful entry. If a viewing turns up an altar, the landlord's storage boxes, or one locked room, ask who comes and how often before you sign anything
variations: Thirty days a month, and twenty-eight of them are mine.
He isn't a bad guy. That living room was just never mine.

items.sourceNote: Reporting on cash-only rent collection, missing receipts and the payment-proof disputes that follow; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
我的房租是現金，每個月五號，親自送到房東家。
他說：「轉帳要手續費，你走過來十分鐘就到了。」
十分鐘的路，每次花掉我四十分鐘。
他會泡茶，會問我工作順不順、有沒有交女朋友、上個月怎麼那麼晚回家。
我開口要收據，他笑說：「我們這種關係還要收據喔？」
第八個月，他說我三月那次好像沒繳。
我翻遍手機，只找到那天下午的一張自拍，背景是他家的沙發。
從那個月起我改成轉帳，備註打得清清楚楚。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合正在用現金繳租、或房東主動要求付現的人。繳租一定要留下第三方查得到的紀錄：銀行轉帳、備註寫「幾年幾月房租＋地址」最保險。真的只能付現，就請對方在收據本上簽名並註明期間，或當場傳一則訊息「今天付了八月房租一萬三，收到請回覆」，對方的回覆本身就是證據。依民法，付款的人本來就可以要求對方給收據，這不是失禮，是基本手續
variations: 我開口要收據，他說：我們這種關係還要收據喔？
我翻遍手機，只找到那天下午的一張自拍，背景是他家的沙發。

en.content:
My rent is cash, the fifth of every month, hand-delivered to the landlord's place.
He says, "Transfers cost a fee, and it's a ten-minute walk for you."
A ten-minute walk that takes forty minutes every time.
He makes tea. He asks how work is going, whether I've got a girlfriend, why I came home so late last month.
When I asked for a receipt he laughed and said, "After all this, you want a receipt?"
In month eight he told me March looked unpaid.
I went through my whole phone and all I found was a selfie from that afternoon with his couch in the background.
I switched to bank transfers that month, with the memo line spelled out.
en.editorNote: For anyone paying rent in cash, or being pushed toward it. Always leave a record a third party can verify: a bank transfer with a memo naming the month and the address is the cleanest. If cash is genuinely the only option, have them sign and date a receipt book each time, or send a message on the spot — "paid August rent, four hundred, please confirm" — because their reply is itself evidence. Asking for a receipt when you hand over money isn't rude. It's the paperwork doing its job
variations: I asked for a receipt. He said, after all this, you want a receipt?
All I found was a selfie from that afternoon with his couch in the background.

items.sourceNote: forum thread on building-committee notices and how new residents pick up a building's shared-event customs; ghost-month framing is original

zh-tw.content:
搬進來第十一個月，電梯裡貼出一張公告：本棟中元普渡，八月二十七日晚上六點，一樓大廳，一戶請自備一份。
我盯著那張紙看了很久，主要是在想：我算一戶嗎？
我傳訊息問房東，他回三個字：「隨便你。」
那天下班經過大廳，三張長桌併在一起，鄰居把飲料餅乾排得整整齊齊，有位阿姨在分裝小袋子。
我提著超商的晚餐站在門口，既不知道怎麼加入，也不好意思直接上樓。
最後我把手上那包餅乾放上桌，說：「不好意思，我剛搬來，不太懂。」
有人頭也沒抬：「沒關係啦，放著就好。」
那是我住進這棟樓的第十一個月，第一次有人跟我說沒關係。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合剛搬進大樓、看到公告卻不確定自己要不要參加的租屋族。不用先把流程弄懂再出現，問一句「我需要準備什麼嗎」通常就夠了，會辦的人多半很樂意講。真的不想參加也完全沒事——那天在大廳擺桌的人，跟照常出門、照常回家的人，本來就是在同一棟樓裡過同一個八月
variations: 我盯著那張公告看了很久，主要是在想：我算一戶嗎？
住進來十一個月，第一次有人跟我說「沒關係，放著就好」。

en.content:
Eleven months into the lease, a notice went up in the elevator: building offering ceremony, August 27th, six in the evening, lobby, one dish per household.
I stared at it for a while, mostly wondering whether I counted as a household.
I texted the landlord. He wrote back, "Up to you."
Coming home from work that day I found three tables pushed together in the lobby, neighbors lining up drinks and cookies, an auntie sorting things into little bags.
I stood in the doorway holding my convenience-store dinner, with no idea how to join and no nerve to just take the elevator up.
So I set my bag of cookies on the table and said, "Sorry, I just moved in, I don't really know how this works."
Someone answered without looking up: "It's fine, just leave it there."
Eleven months in that building, and that was the first time anybody told me it was fine.
en.editorNote: For the renter who just moved into a managed building and can't tell whether the lobby notice includes them. You don't have to understand the whole thing before you show up — "do I need to bring anything?" is usually enough, and the people organizing it are glad to explain. Skipping it is fine too: the neighbor setting up tables downstairs and the neighbor heading out for a normal Thursday are having the same August in the same building
variations: I stared at the notice a long time, mostly wondering whether I counted as a household.
Eleven months in, and "it's fine, just leave it there" was the first kind thing I heard there.

items.sourceNote: blog piece noting that renters and people working away from home often cannot prepare a full offering table and keep it simple instead; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
六坪套房，沒有陽台，唯一一張桌子身兼書桌、餐桌和燙衣板。
我媽打來，問我今年一個人在外面有沒有要拜。
我環顧一圈，說：「媽，我這裡連放三個杯子，都要先把筆電移開。」
她安靜了兩秒：「那就別勉強，買點東西意思一下就好。」
於是我在巷口超商買了一袋餅乾、兩瓶飲料，擺在桌上拍給她看。
她回了一個讚。
那袋餅乾後來變成我三天的早餐、宵夜跟加班糧。
我不知道這樣算不算數，
只知道那三天每拆一包，我都會想到我媽。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合一個人在外租屋、長輩突然打來問「你那邊有沒有拜」的那通電話。老實說你住的是套房、桌子只有一張，通常對方會比你更快找到台階。真的想做點什麼，就買你自己三天內吃得完的份量——八月底的套房裡，多買的每一樣，最後都是你在處理
variations: 我這裡連放三個杯子，都要先把筆電移開。
那袋餅乾後來變成我三天的早餐、宵夜跟加班糧。

en.content:
Studio apartment, no balcony, and the one table doubles as desk, dining table, and ironing board.
My mom called to ask whether I'd be marking the day out here on my own this year.
I looked around the room and said, "Mom, I'd have to move the laptop just to fit three cups."
Two seconds of silence, then: "Don't force it. Buy something small. The thought is the part that counts."
So I picked up a bag of cookies and two drinks at the corner store, set them on the table, and sent her a photo.
She sent back a thumbs up.
That bag of cookies became my breakfast, my midnight snack, and my overtime fuel for three days.
I have no idea whether any of it counted.
I just know that every time I opened another pack, I thought about my mom.
en.editorNote: For anyone renting alone when a parent calls to ask if they're doing anything for the day. Tell them the truth — one room, one table — and they'll usually find the exit before you do. If you want to do something anyway, buy the amount you can finish in three days: in a studio at the end of August, everything extra ends up being your problem
variations: I'd have to move the laptop just to fit three cups.
It became my breakfast, my midnight snack, and my overtime fuel for three days.

items.sourceNote: renter forum thread complaining that listing photos do not match the actual room; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
網站上那張照片裡，床離窗戶好像很遠。
到現場我才想通，那是因為拍的人整個人退進浴室門口，用廣角把一坪拍成兩坪。
房仲說：「照片本來就是這樣拍的啊。」
我站在床跟牆之間那條二十公分的縫裡，終於懂了什麼叫「圖片僅供參考」。
後來我養成一個習慣：進門先別急著看房，站到房間正中央，張開雙手轉一圈。
轉得完的，才叫房間。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合正在滑租屋照片、每一間都覺得好像還不錯的人。到現場先用自己的手機補拍幾張，別開廣角，再從門口拍一張全景，回家跟刊登照片並排看，落差一眼就出來。另外把行李箱的寬度記在心裡，床邊走道容不容得下它，比任何坪數數字都誠實
variations: 轉得完的，才叫房間。
我站在床跟牆之間那條二十公分的縫裡，終於懂什麼叫圖片僅供參考。

en.content:
Wide-angle lenses are the reason the bed looked so far from the window in the listing photo.
In person I worked out the trick: whoever shot it had backed all the way into the bathroom doorway to turn one room's worth of floor into two.
The agent shrugged. "That's just how listing photos get taken."
Standing in the eight-inch gap between the bed and the wall, I finally understood what "images are for reference only" means.
Now I have a routine. Before I look at anything, I walk to the middle of the room, put both arms out, and turn a full circle.
If I can finish the turn, it's a room.
en.editorNote: For anyone scrolling listings where every place looks fine. On site, retake a few shots on your own phone with the wide lens off, plus one from the doorway, then set them beside the listing photos at home — the gap shows itself immediately. And keep your suitcase's width in mind: whether it fits in the walkway beside the bed is a more honest number than the floor area
variations: If I can finish the turn, it's a room.
Eight inches between bed and wall taught me what "for reference only" means.

items.sourceNote: renter viewing checklist covering defects to log before signing; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
看房那天，我指著天花板那片水漬，房東說：「這個很好修。」
我指著關不緊的紗窗，他說：「這個也很好修。」
我指著馬桶旁邊翹起來的地磚，他點點頭：「很好修。」
我就這樣被三句「很好修」說服，當天把名字簽了下去。
住到第八個月我才聽懂那句話的完整版本：
這個很好修——對一個願意修的人來說。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合正在看房、耳邊一直出現「這個很好修」的人。當場把那句話換成兩個問題：大概什麼時候會修、修好之前這間房算什麼價。回家再用訊息把答案重講一次請他確認，他回的那個「好」，比看房當天講的所有話加起來都有用。缺點也記得每一處都拍一張，日期會自己留在檔案裡
variations: 這個很好修——對一個願意修的人來說。
我是被三句「很好修」說服，才把名字簽下去的。

en.content:
"Easy fix," the landlord said when I pointed at the water stain on the ceiling.
"Also an easy fix," he said about the window screen that wouldn't latch.
The tile lifting up beside the toilet? He nodded. "Easy fix."
Three easy fixes later, I signed my name that same afternoon.
Eight months in, I finally heard the rest of the sentence:
it's an easy fix — for someone who intends to fix it.
en.editorNote: For anyone touring a place and hearing "easy fix" on repeat. Turn the phrase into two questions on the spot: roughly when, and what the place is worth until then. Text him the answers afterward and ask him to confirm — a "yes" you can scroll back to beats everything said out loud during the tour. Photograph every flaw while you're standing there; the file keeps the date for you
variations: It's an easy fix — for someone who intends to fix it.
Three "easy fixes" were all it took to get my name on the lease.

items.sourceNote: guide explaining that tenants may register their household address at the rented place and that lease clauses forbidding it are legally void; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
我在這個城市住了六年。
在這裡上班、在這裡看醫生、認得巷口那隻總是趴在機車坐墊上的貓，房租一期都沒遲過。
但我的戶籍還在老家：投票要坐三小時的客運回去，區公所寄的信永遠躺在我爸的鞋櫃上。
我問房東能不能把戶籍遷進來，他只回三個字：「不方便。」
後來我才查到，那三個字在法律上不算數，租約寫「不得遷入戶籍」也一樣無效。
但我沒有把那頁截圖傳給他。
我只是坐在床邊想——
原來一個人可以在一個地方住滿六年，在紙上，一天都沒來過。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合生活跟戶籍分在兩個地方的人。實務上要遷入只需要身分證、遷出地的戶口名簿，加上一份能證明居住事實的文件（未公證的租約就可以），直接到租屋處的戶政事務所辦；房東不同意也擋不了，必要時可以請戶政或轄區員警到現場確認你真的住在這裡。決定之前先想清楚你需要的是什麼：學區、投票所、還是社區通知寄得到你手上
variations: 原來一個人可以在一個地方住滿六年，在紙上，一天都沒來過。
租約寫「不得遷入戶籍」，跟沒寫是一樣的——只是沒人告訴我。

en.content:
I've lived in this city for six years.
I work here, see my doctor here, know the cat that sleeps on a scooter seat at the end of my street, and I have never once paid rent late.
My registered address is still my parents' house, three hours away by bus — which is where every ballot and every notice from the district office quietly piles up.
When I asked my landlord about registering here, he gave me two words: "Not convenient."
I looked it up later. Those two words carry no legal weight, and neither does a lease clause banning it.
I never sent him the screenshot.
I just sat on the edge of the bed thinking —
you can live somewhere for six full years and, on paper, never have shown up at all.
en.editorNote: For anyone whose life and paperwork sit in two different cities. Registering usually takes nothing more than your ID, your old household record, and one document showing you actually live here — an unnotarized lease counts. A landlord's refusal doesn't block it, and if he stonewalls, the registration office can send someone to confirm you really live there. Decide first what you actually need it for: school district, polling place, or simply having your mail reach you
variations: You can live somewhere for six years and, on paper, never show up once.
A lease clause banning you from registering your address is worth exactly nothing.

items.sourceNote: renter forum thread about life in a subdivided building and one-way landlord announcements; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
這層樓隔成八間，房東拉了一個群組，加上他，九個人。
半年來只有一個人講過話：早安圖、颱風記得關窗、垃圾車改成七點四十、頂樓不要曬棉被。
我在裡面問過一次走廊的燈壞了，訊息沉到最底，隔天早安圖照常出現。
另外七個人，我一次都沒看過他們發言。
在信箱前面遇到，我們也只是各自低頭看手機。
那不是群組，那是他的公告欄——
八個人住在同一條走廊，共用一個回收桶，
唯一的共同點是我們都已讀，也都沒有回。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合被拉進房東群組、卻發現只有房東在發言的人。實用一點的作法：報修不要只丟群組，另外開一對一對話，把日期、位置、照片打成一則完整訊息，之後要舉證比較好翻；也可以趁某次公告下面主動回一句，八個沉默的人裡，通常會有一個接話——共用空間的事，兩個人講比一個人講容易成立
variations: 那不是群組，那是他的公告欄。
八個人住在同一條走廊，唯一的共同點是我們都已讀，也都沒有回。

en.content:
Eight studios on this floor, and a group chat containing all of us plus the landlord. Nine people.
In six months exactly one person has typed anything: good-morning graphics, close your windows for the typhoon, the garbage truck moved to 7:40, don't hang bedding on the roof.
I asked once about the burnt-out hallway light. The message sank to the bottom. The good-morning graphic arrived on schedule the next day.
I have never seen the other seven post a single word.
When we cross paths at the mailboxes, we both look at our phones.
It isn't a group chat, it's his bulletin board —
eight people sharing one hallway and one recycling bin,
and the only thing we have in common is that we all read it and none of us reply.
en.editorNote: For anyone added to a landlord's group chat that turns out to be a broadcast channel. Practical move: don't file repairs in the group. Open a one-on-one thread and send one complete message with the date, the exact spot, and a photo — that's the thread you'll scroll back through later. And try replying under one of his announcements; out of eight silent neighbors, one usually answers, and shared-space problems land better when two people raise them
variations: It isn't a group chat, it's his bulletin board.
Eight of us share a hallway, and all we have in common is that we read everything and answer nothing.

items.sourceNote: article on subdivided suites noting landlords' own belongings and furniture left in rented rooms; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
我房間裡有一個兩公尺寬的舊木櫃，靠著整面牆，而它不是我的。
我問能不能搬走，房東說：「那個很重，而且我以後還要用。」
於是我在剩下的空間裡塞了床、桌子跟一個行李箱，從床尾走到門口要側身。
櫃子裡是他兒子高中的參考書、幾件冬天的外套，還有一台壞掉的按摩椅零件。
兩年來我只打開過兩次。
我一直以為我在租一個房間，
後來認真算了一次才發現：我每個月付的一萬三裡面，大概有兩千，
是在替一個我從沒見過的高中生，保管他的過去。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合房間裡卡著房東私人物品的人。看房時就要問清楚：留下來的家具算不算屋況、能不能移位、退租時要不要負責它的損壞——這三題最好在簽約前用訊息問一次，留個紀錄。真的搬不走，至少把它現在的樣子拍下來存檔，免得退租那天，那道二十年前就有的刮痕變成你的
variations: 我每個月付一萬三，其中兩千是在替一個沒見過的高中生保管他的過去。
我以為我租的是一個房間，其實我租的是一個附倉庫的房間，而倉庫不歸我。

en.content:
There's a two-meter wooden cabinet against the wall of my room, and it isn't mine.
I asked if it could go. "It's heavy," the landlord said, "and I'll want it back someday."
So I fit a bed, a desk, and one suitcase into what's left, and I turn sideways to get from the bed to the door.
Inside it: his son's high-school workbooks, a few winter coats, and parts from a broken massage chair.
In two years I've opened it exactly twice.
I thought I was renting a room.
Then I actually did the math on my rent, and found that a chunk of it every month
goes to storing the past of a teenager I have never met.
en.editorNote: For renters living around furniture that belongs to someone else. Settle three questions before you sign, in writing: does the leftover furniture count as part of the unit, may you move it, and are you liable if it breaks. If it truly can't be removed, photograph its current condition from every angle — otherwise the scratch that's been there for twenty years becomes yours on move-out day
variations: Part of my rent every month goes to storing the past of a teenager I've never met.
I thought I rented a room. I rented a room with a storage unit in it, and the storage unit isn't mine.

items.sourceNote: explainer on lease clauses about wall damage and restoring the unit; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
合約寫牆面不得釘掛，所以我的家是黏上去的。
無痕掛勾掛外套、雙面膠貼鏡子、一根伸縮桿撐起我全部的襯衫，層架用的是頂天立地那種。
最熱的那個禮拜，鏡子在凌晨三點自己滑下來，我從床上彈起來以為是地震。
我把它撿起來，換了一組更貴的膠條，再貼回去。
租久了會養出一種很奇怪的手感：
所有東西都要固定得剛剛好——
牢到撐得過今年，鬆到明年撕下來的那天，牆上什麼都不會留下。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合家裡沒有一顆釘子的租屋族。實用提醒：無痕掛勾撕之前先用吹風機吹熱膠條，順著牆面往下拉，油漆比較不會整片跟著走；重的東西別交給黏的，交給頂天立地的伸縮架，力量壓在地板和天花板上。真的留下痕跡也別先認賠，正常使用下的自然耗損本來就不用回復原狀
variations: 牢到撐得過今年，鬆到明年撕下來的那天，牆上什麼都不會留下。
合約說不能釘，所以我整個家是黏上去的。

en.content:
My lease says nothing may be nailed into the walls, so my entire apartment is stuck on.
Removable hooks for coats, double-sided tape for the mirror, one tension rod holding up every shirt I own, floor-to-ceiling poles where shelves should be.
During the hottest week of the summer the mirror peeled off at three in the morning and I came out of bed convinced it was an earthquake.
I picked it up, bought stronger adhesive strips, and put it back.
Rent long enough and you develop a very specific instinct:
everything has to hold at exactly the right strength —
tight enough to last the year, loose enough that when it comes down next year, the wall keeps no record of it.
en.editorNote: For renters whose homes contain zero nails. Practical notes: warm an adhesive strip with a hairdryer before pulling it, and pull straight down along the wall so the paint stays put. Never trust glue with anything heavy — use tension poles that push against the floor and ceiling instead. And if something does leave a mark, don't immediately offer to pay; ordinary wear from normal use isn't damage you owe
variations: Tight enough to last the year, loose enough that the wall keeps no record of it.
The lease says no nails, so my whole home is held up by tape.

items.sourceNote: rental checklist article advising renters to confirm exactly which facilities are included before signing; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
「一萬一，附機車位。」我看到這行字就打了電話。
搬進來第一天才發現，所謂的機車位是巷子裡那片沒畫線的空地，先到先停。
七點回家有位子，九點回家要停到兩條街外，下雨天全滿。
我問房東，他說：「我沒騙你啊，那裡本來就可以停。」
確實。那裡誰都可以停。
於是加班變成一件有價格的事——
每晚一小時，我就要多走三百公尺，還要在心裡祈禱明天早上車還在原地。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合看到「附機車位」就心動的人。看房時把這幾題問完再走：是專屬車位還是「可以停」、有沒有編號、要不要另外收費、晚上十點的實際狀況長怎樣。最好用訊息問一次留紀錄，順便自己挑一個晚上去現場繞一圈。如果答案是路邊空地，就把每天多走的那段路一起算進房租裡再決定
variations: 所謂附機車位，是那塊空地誰都可以停，包括我。
加班一小時的代價，是多走三百公尺，還要祈禱明天早上車還在。

en.content:
"Eleven thousand a month, scooter parking included." That line is why I called.
Day one, I found out that the parking was an unmarked patch of concrete in the alley. First come, first served.
Home by seven, there's a space. Home by nine, I'm parking two streets away. Raining, and there's nothing at all.
I asked the landlord about it. "I didn't lie," he said. "You can park there."
True enough. Anyone can park there.
Which is how overtime quietly acquired a price:
every extra hour at the office costs me three hundred meters on foot, plus a small prayer that the scooter is still there in the morning.
en.editorNote: For anyone who gets excited by the words "parking included." Ask before you sign: is it an assigned space or just somewhere you're allowed to park, is it numbered, does it cost extra, and what does the lot actually look like at ten at night. Ask by text so there's a record, then go stand there one evening and see for yourself. If the answer is "the alley," price that nightly walk into the rent before you decide
variations: "Parking included" meant a patch of concrete anyone could use, including me.
An hour of overtime costs me three hundred meters on foot and a prayer that the scooter is still there.

items.sourceNote: article on checking the water heater and gas setup when viewing a rental, including ventilation concerns; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
這棟老公寓燒的是桶裝瓦斯，熱水器掛在後陽台。
沒有人告訴我瓦斯會用完，直到某個十一點，我頭上還有泡沫，水就變冷了。
我裹著浴巾蹲在後陽台，學會了搖那顆桶子——晃一晃，聽起來很輕，那就是空的。
第二次，我學會把瓦斯行的電話存進手機。
第三次，我學會在還有一半的時候就先叫。
現在我每次進浴室都會先看它一眼，像確認同住的人還在不在。
沒有人教過我這件事，
是那個十一點的冷水教的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合租到桶裝瓦斯老公寓的人。搬進去第一週就做三件事：把附近瓦斯行的電話存起來、問清楚換桶的錢算誰的、看一眼熱水器裝在哪裡。裝在室內或封起來的陽台特別要注意通風，洗澡時把窗戶留一條縫。冬天叫瓦斯的人多，別等到完全空了才打電話
variations: 沒有人教我瓦斯會用完，是那個十一點的冷水教的。
我進浴室的第一件事是看那顆瓦斯桶，像確認同住的人還在不在。

en.content:
This old building runs on bottled gas, with the water heater bolted to the back balcony.
Nobody mentioned that gas runs out, so I learned it at eleven at night, shampoo still in my hair, when the water went cold.
Wrapped in a towel, crouched on the balcony, I learned to rock the tank — give it a shove, and if it sounds light, it's empty.
The second time, I learned to save the gas shop's number in my phone.
The third time, I learned to call while the tank is still half full.
Now I glance at it every time I step into the bathroom, the way you check whether the person you live with is still home.
Nobody taught me any of this.
The cold water at eleven o'clock did.
en.editorNote: For renters in older buildings on bottled gas. Do three things in your first week: save a local gas supplier's number, settle who pays for tank swaps, and look at where the heater actually sits. Heaters installed indoors or on a balcony that's been sealed in need real airflow — leave a window cracked while you shower. And call for a refill before the tank is fully empty, especially in winter when everyone else is calling too
variations: Nobody told me gas runs out. The cold water at eleven at night did.
I check the gas tank on my way into the bathroom, the way you check if your roommate is home.

items.sourceNote: piece on the things landlords don't mention about a unit, including what living in it is actually like; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
我房間天花板的角落住著一隻壁虎。
第一個禮拜我拿掃把想趕牠，牠不動；第二個禮拜我發現蚊子變少了；第三個禮拜我開始關燈前先跟牠說一聲。
牠不繳房租、不用抄電表、不會在半夜傳訊息說明天要帶人來看房。
這間屋子裡，牠是唯一一個沒問過我什麼時候搬走的。
退租那天，我把最後一個箱子搬出門，回頭看了一眼天花板。
牠還在原來的位置。
我說了聲謝謝，然後把燈關掉。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合一個人租屋、房裡有個不請自來室友的人。壁虎吃的是蚊蟲，不咬人也不弄髒東西，願意的話就當牠是免費的防蚊。真的怕，就把紗窗的破洞補起來、晚上少開沒紗窗的那扇——牠自然會往有蟲的地方去。租來的房子裡能陪你的東西不多，能相處的就先別急著趕
variations: 牠不繳房租、不抄電表，也從來沒問過我什麼時候搬走。
這間租來的房子裡，唯一沒問我何時搬走的，是天花板角落那隻壁虎。

en.content:
A gecko lives in the corner of my ceiling.
Week one I came at it with a broom and it didn't move. Week two I noticed there were fewer mosquitoes. Week three I started saying goodnight before turning off the light.
It pays no rent, reads no meter, and has never texted me at midnight to say someone's coming to view the place tomorrow.
In this apartment, it is the only one who has never asked when I'm moving out.
On my last day I carried the final box to the door and looked back at the ceiling.
Still there, same corner.
I said thanks, and turned off the light.
en.editorNote: For anyone living alone with an uninvited roommate on the ceiling. Geckos eat mosquitoes, don't bite, and make no mess — treat one as free pest control if you can stand it. If you can't, patch the holes in your window screens and stop opening the unscreened window at night; it'll drift toward wherever the bugs are. Not much keeps you company in a rented place, so don't chase off the things that can
variations: It pays no rent, reads no meter, and has never asked when I'm moving out.
The only one in this rented apartment who never asked when I'd leave was the gecko on the ceiling.

items.sourceNote: column on what happens to tenants when the property changes owners; rewritten original, kept non-advisory

zh-tw.content:
八月某天，房東傳來一組新的匯款帳號，說房子過戶了，以後匯給這個人。
就這樣。沒有搬家、沒有換鎖、沒有人上門看我一眼。
租約還在，牆角那塊壁癌還在，陽台上晾的衣服還是我的。
換掉的只有手機裡那筆自動轉帳的收款人姓名。
新的名字我唸不太順，我們到今天沒見過面。
我在這裡住了三年，這個地方在別人手上換過一次，
而它從頭到尾沒有問過我的意見——
因為它從頭到尾，都不是我的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合遇到房子換手的租屋族。這種時候別只靠一則訊息就改匯款：先確認新的收款人是誰、跟你的租約怎麼銜接、押金由誰保管，這幾件事用文字談一次，把回覆留在對話紀錄裡。舊房東那邊的每一期繳款證明也先備份起來，之後真的要對帳，這些截圖比記憶可靠
variations: 房子換了一次主人，我的生活一格都沒動，只有收款人的名字變了。
我住了三年，它換過一次手，而它從頭到尾都不是我的。

en.content:
One day in August my landlord sent a new bank account number and said the place had changed hands. Pay this person from now on.
That was it. No move, no new locks, nobody came by to look at me.
My lease is still my lease. The damp patch in the corner is still there. The laundry on the balcony is still mine.
The only thing that changed was the payee name on a monthly transfer in my phone.
I'm still not sure how to pronounce the new one. We have never met.
I've lived here three years. In that time the place passed from one person to another,
and it never once asked what I thought —
because it was never mine to begin with.
en.editorNote: For renters whose building quietly changed owners. Don't redirect your rent on the strength of one message: confirm who the new payee actually is, how your existing lease carries over, and who is holding your deposit — ask in writing and keep the replies in the thread. Back up every payment record from the old arrangement too. When it's time to reconcile, screenshots beat memory
variations: The building changed owners and nothing in my life moved except the payee name on a bank transfer.
Three years here, one change of owner, and it was never mine at any point.

items.sourceNote: guide to the move-out walkthrough and handing back keys; rewritten original, checklist moved into the editor note

zh-tw.content:
點交那天我交回三把鑰匙：大門、房門、信箱。
交完那一刻鑰匙圈明顯變輕，回程騎車一路都覺得口袋怪怪的。
到了新的地方，我把新的三把掛上去，順手整理，發現最裡面卡著一把黃銅色的舊鑰匙。
我對著它想了很久，想不起來它是哪一間。
不是第一間，第一間那把是圓頭的；也不是那間頂樓，那把上面貼過標籤。
它就這樣跟著我搬過三次家、進出過幾百道門，
現在打不開任何一扇。
我沒有把它拔下來。
那些房子沒有一間是我的，
但這些鑰匙，都真的曾經在我手上。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合剛交完鑰匙、或正在打包下一次搬家的人。點交盡量約房東當面走一遍：鑰匙幾把、家具幾件照合約點清楚，順便問他手上還留幾把備份；水電網路當場結清、押金什麼時候退，都用文字留一份。程序做完了，剩下那點捨不得就留給自己，不用急著整理掉
variations: 搬過三次家，鑰匙圈上還有一把我認不出是哪一間的鑰匙。
那些房子沒有一間是我的，但那些鑰匙真的曾經在我手上。

en.content:
Three keys went back at the final walkthrough: front gate, room door, mailbox.
The ring got lighter that second. I spent the whole ride home patting a pocket for something that wasn't there.
At the new place I clipped on three new ones, tidied the ring, and found an old brass key wedged at the bottom.
I looked at it for a long time and could not place which apartment it went to.
Not the first one — that key had a round head. Not the rooftop unit — that one had a label on it.
It has ridden along through three moves and a few hundred doors,
and it opens nothing now.
I didn't take it off.
Not one of those places was mine.
But every one of these keys was, for a while, actually in my hand.
en.editorNote: For anyone who just handed the keys back, or is taping up boxes for the next place. Do the final walkthrough with your landlord present: count the keys and the furniture against the lease, and ask how many spares he still holds. Settle the utilities on the spot and get the deposit timeline in writing. Once the paperwork is done, the part of you that misses the place can take its time
variations: Three moves later, there's still a key on my ring I can't match to any door.
None of those places were mine. The keys were, for a while.

items.sourceNote: forum roundup on which appliance renters rely on when the unit bans cooking; rewritten original, safety notes kept in the editor note

zh-tw.content:
合約第七條寫「不得開伙」，所以我家沒有爐子，只有一個電鍋。
三年來它煮飯、蒸蛋、燙青菜、把冷凍水餃直接丟進去、加熱昨天沒吃完的便當。
有一次朋友來，我用它做了一鍋湯，我們兩個蹲在地上吃完。
內鍋洗到顏色都變淡了。
房東有次上來拿東西，看到它，停了兩秒，什麼也沒說。
我知道他在判斷這到底算不算開伙，
也知道他最後決定不要知道。
那個電鍋現在在我第二間房間裡。
它是我這幾年唯一一件，搬到哪裡都插得上電的家當。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合住在不能開伙的套房、靠一個鍋活下來的人。房東真正介意的多半是明火跟油煙，電鍋、快煮鍋這種不起煙的通常還過得去，但要不要用先問一句、把回覆留在對話紀錄裡最安全。分租套房的線路負載有限，高瓦數電器別跟冷氣同時開；煮完把蓋子掀開讓水氣散掉，牆角比較不會發霉
variations: 合約說不得開伙，所以我這三年的三餐都是一個電鍋端出來的。
搬到哪裡都插得上電的，只有那個電鍋。

en.content:
Clause seven says no cooking, so my place has no stove. It has a rice cooker.
Three years of it: rice, steamed eggs, blanched greens, frozen dumplings dropped straight in, last night's lunchbox reheated.
A friend came over once and I made soup in it. We ate sitting on the floor.
The inner pot has washed pale.
My landlord came up for something, saw it, paused two seconds, said nothing.
He was working out whether that counted as cooking.
He also worked out that he'd rather not know.
That cooker is in my second apartment now.
It is the one thing I own that plugs in wherever I go.
en.editorNote: For anyone getting by on a single pot in a unit where cooking is banned. What landlords actually object to is open flame and grease smoke, so a rice cooker or a kettle-pot usually passes — but ask once and keep the reply in the message thread. Wiring in a subdivided building is limited, so don't run a high-wattage appliance and the air conditioner at the same time. Lift the lid when you're done and let the steam out, and the corner of the wall stays cleaner
variations: The lease bans cooking, so three years of meals came out of one rice cooker.
One thing I own plugs in anywhere I move. It's the rice cooker.

items.sourceNote: agent's tip about reading a floor's hallway and doorways to judge the neighbours before signing; rewritten original

zh-tw.content:
我住這裡兩年，跟對門講過的話加起來不到十個字。
但我認得他們家門口：星期二晚上會多出兩雙鞋，下雨天地上有一圈傘立過的水痕，
外送袋掛在門把上，通常是兩份。
去年冬天那裡空了兩個禮拜，我還在想他們是不是出國。
上個月我倒完垃圾回來，看到門口堆著紙箱，膠帶已經封好。
隔天早上，那片地板乾乾淨淨。
我到最後都不知道他們姓什麼，
只是有點想跟他們說一聲：你們家的燈亮著的時候，我這邊也沒那麼空。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合住公寓、跟鄰居只有點頭之交的人。看房如果排得到晚上或假日就晚上去，順便看同一層的走廊跟門口——鞋子怎麼擺、雜物多不多、腳踏車停在哪，比任何一句「這邊住戶都很單純」都準。真的想認識，從電梯裡先講一聲早安就夠了，不用一次到位
variations: 我不知道對門姓什麼，但我認得他們門口星期二會多出兩雙鞋。
門口的紙箱封好那天我才知道，對門要搬走了。

en.content:
Two years here and I've said maybe ten words to the people across the hall.
I know their doorway, though. Tuesday nights, two extra pairs of shoes. Rainy days, a ring of water where an umbrella stood.
A delivery bag on the handle, usually two portions.
Last winter it sat bare for two weeks and I wondered if they'd gone abroad.
Last month I came back from the bins and there were boxes outside their door, taped shut.
By the next morning the floor was clean.
I never did learn their family name.
I just wanted to tell them: when your light was on, it was less empty over here.
en.editorNote: For anyone in an apartment building on nodding terms with the neighbours. Book your viewing for an evening or a weekend if you can, and look down the shared hallway while you're there — how the shoes are lined up, how much junk is stacked, where the bikes go. It tells you more than any assurance that the building is quiet. If you do want to know them, start with hello in the elevator; that's enough
variations: I don't know their family name. I know two extra pairs of shoes appear on Tuesdays.
The taped-up boxes outside their door were how I found out they were leaving.

items.sourceNote: report on what counts as proof of rent paid, including transfer records; rewritten original, the documentation tip sits in the editor note

zh-tw.content:
每個月五號，我打開銀行 App，常用帳號的第一個就是他。
金額一樣、帳號一樣，備註欄打「八月房租」，改一個字就送出。
按下確認，兩秒後跳出成功畫面，我截圖，存進一個叫「房租」的相簿。
兩年下來那本相簿有二十四張，長得一模一樣，只有月份不同。
我跟這個人一年講十二句話，每一句都是同一句。
他從來沒有回過。
沒有回就是最好的消息。
那二十四張截圖不是拿來紀念的，
是我唯一能證明自己這兩年好好撐住了的東西——準時、足額、一次都沒有遲。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合每個月固定一天繳房租的人。備註欄把年月寫清楚，別只打「房租」；轉帳明細、銀行截圖、合約上寫的收款帳號要對得起來，退租對帳、申報租金、哪天真的要證明自己繳過，靠的都是這幾樣。付現金的話每次拿收據，不然至少當場拍一張
variations: 我跟房東一年講十二句話，每一句都是「八月房租」那種句子。
相簿裡二十四張轉帳截圖，是我這兩年最完整的一份紀錄。

en.content:
The fifth of every month: open the banking app, and he is the first saved payee.
Same amount, same account. In the memo field I type "August rent" and change one word before I send it.
Confirm, and two seconds later the success screen comes up. I screenshot it and file it in an album called Rent.
Two years in, the album holds twenty-four images that are identical except for the month.
I say twelve things to this man a year and it's the same sentence every time.
He has never replied.
No reply is the good outcome.
Those twenty-four screenshots aren't souvenirs.
They are the only proof I have that I held it together for two years — on time, in full, never once late.
en.editorNote: For anyone who pays rent on the same date every month. Put the year and month in the memo field instead of just "rent," and make sure the transfer records, the screenshots, and the account number written into your lease all line up. That set is what you fall back on at move-out, at tax time, or any day you need to prove you paid. If you pay cash, take a receipt every time, or at minimum photograph it on the spot
variations: Twelve sentences a year to my landlord, and it's the same sentence twelve times.
Twenty-four transfer screenshots in one album: the most complete record of my last two years.

items.sourceNote: guide to building water-tank cleaning shutoffs: store water in advance, and flush every tap once supply returns; rewritten as an original tenant scene, the practical steps live in the editor note

zh-tw.content:
電梯裡貼了一張公告：本棟隔天清洗水塔，白天全棟停水。
我前一晚接了兩鍋水、一個水桶，覺得自己準備得很充分。
結果最先撐不住的不是喝的水，也不是洗臉，
是馬桶。
那一整天我像在露營，只是這個營地要繳一萬二。
水來的時候，龍頭吐出來的第一波是黃的，
我開著水看它慢慢變乾淨，才想起公告最後一行有寫：
復水後請先放水。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合社區貼出洗水塔或臨時停水公告那幾天發。實務上：前一晚就要蓄水，別只算喝的和洗臉的，沖馬桶一次就是一大桶；復水之後每個水龍頭都先開著放一陣子，把管線裡的空氣和雜質排掉再用。公告本來就該寫明停水與復水時間，社區也要留清洗紀錄，租屋族如果發現水質一直不對，拍照留存再跟房東或管委會反映
variations: 洗水塔那天我才知道，家裡最耗水的不是我，是馬桶。
停水一整天的租屋處，跟露營唯一的差別是要繳租金。

en.content:
A notice went up in the elevator: the building's water tank gets cleaned tomorrow, water off for the whole day.
The night before, I filled two pots and a bucket and felt extremely prepared.
It turns out the first thing you run short of isn't drinking water, and it isn't washing your face.
It's the toilet.
All day I was basically camping, except this campsite charges rent.
When the supply came back, the first thing out of the tap was yellow.
I stood there watching it run clear and finally remembered the last line of the notice:
flush your taps before you use the water.
en.editorNote: For the days when your building posts a tank-cleaning or unplanned-shutoff notice. Store water the night before, and count the toilet, not just drinking and washing water, since one flush is a whole bucket. Once supply returns, run every tap for a while to clear the air and sediment out of the pipes. A proper notice states both the shutoff and restoration times, and the building should keep cleaning records, so if the water stays off-colour, photograph it and raise it with your landlord or the management committee
variations: Water-tank cleaning day taught me the biggest water user in my place is the toilet.
A day with no running water turns any rental into camping you pay rent for.

items.sourceNote: explainer on who bears repair duties under Civil Code Art. 429 and the tenant's right to demand repairs, repair it themselves and deduct the cost; original dialogue, the legal route is summarised in the editor note

zh-tw.content:
流理台上出現一整條螞蟻，我拍照傳給房東。
他：「你是不是有東西沒收？」
我：只有一包沒拆封的餅乾，還在櫃子裡。
他：「那你先去買螞蟻藥。」
我：牠們是從牆角那道裂縫爬進來的。
他：「噴一噴就好了啦。」
裂縫是他的，牆是他的，整棟房子都是他的，
只有螞蟻，登記在我名下。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合報修被推回來、對話卡在「先看是不是你的問題」的時候發。租賃物的修繕原則上由房東負擔（民法第 429 條），牆面裂縫、管線這種房屋本體問題引起的蟲害尤其是；簽約前就把蟲害、壁癌、漏水誰處理寫進修繕與附屬設備條款。房東不動，可以用訊息或存證信函定一個合理期限催告，逾期沒修就自行找廠商，費用向房東請求或從租金扣除，對話紀錄和收據都要留
variations: 他的房子、他的裂縫、我的螞蟻。
報修傳出去，回來的第一句永遠是「你是不是有東西沒收」。

en.content:
A whole line of ants turned up on the kitchen counter, so I sent my landlord a photo.
Him: "Did you leave food out?"
Me: One unopened pack of crackers, still in the cupboard.
Him: "Go buy some ant bait."
Me: They're coming in through the crack in the wall.
Him: "Just spray it, it's fine."
The crack is his, the wall is his, the whole building is his.
The ants are the only thing registered in my name.
en.editorNote: For the moment a repair request bounces back as "are you sure it isn't your fault." In Taiwan, repairs to the rental itself fall on the landlord by default under Civil Code Article 429, and that covers pests coming in through structural cracks or pipework. Spell out who handles pests, damp and leaks in the repair clause before you sign. If the landlord stalls, send a dated message or formal letter setting a reasonable deadline; once it passes you can hire someone yourself and either bill the landlord or deduct it from rent. Keep the messages and the receipts
variations: His building, his crack in the wall, my ants.
Every repair request comes back the same way: "Did you leave food out?"

items.sourceNote: coverage of Taiwan's rent index setting another record while annual growth slows to a multi-year low; figures not quoted, rewritten as a personal tally

zh-tw.content:
新聞說房租指數又創新高，只是這次漲得比較慢。
我沒力氣生氣，只是打開計算機，把這幾年繳過的房租一期一期加起來。
那個數字，在我老家可以買一台車。
差別只在於，車開到最後會是我的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合看到房租新聞、或年底盤點開銷的時候發。順手做一件事會有用：把每期房租金額、繳款日、匯款帳號整理成一份表，退租對帳、報稅列舉扣除額的房屋租金支出、申請租金補貼都靠它；算完也順便看得出房租佔收入幾成，再決定是要換地方，還是明年續約時開口談
variations: 把繳過的房租加總起來，是我最不想按下的那個等號。
房租的問題從來不是貴，是繳完什麼都沒留下。

en.content:
The news says the rent index hit another record high — it's just climbing more slowly this time.
I didn't have the energy to be angry, so I opened the calculator and added up every month of rent I've paid.
Back in my hometown, that number buys a car.
The only difference is that the car would eventually be mine.
en.editorNote: For rent-hike headlines, or for the end-of-year spending review. One thing worth doing while you're at it: keep a single sheet of every rent payment, the date, and the account it went to. That sheet is what you use at move-out, when claiming the rent deduction on your taxes, and when applying for a rent subsidy. It also shows you what share of your income rent is eating, which is the number to look at before you decide whether to move or to negotiate at renewal
variations: Adding up all the rent I've paid is the one equals sign I never want to press.
Rent isn't a problem because it's expensive; it's a problem because nothing is left afterwards.

items.sourceNote: guide to landlord-supplied fixtures, handover inventories and who pays when something breaks; original scene, the photograph-the-inventory tip sits in the editor note

zh-tw.content:
這個房間裡，房東的東西有：一張床、一個衣櫃、一台冷氣、一台會自己重開的冰箱、一組桌椅，還有牆角那台我從來沒開過的除濕機。
我的東西有：一盞檯燈、一個電鍋、兩箱書、一床自己買的棉被，跟貼在門後的行事曆。
退租那天，把後面那份清單全部搬上車，
房間就變回我搬進來那天的樣子。
兩年，我在這裡加了很多東西進去，
真正帶得走的，一趟就載完了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合退租打包、或剛搬進新家那幾天發。實務上，搬進去第一天就把房東附的家具家電逐項拍照，型號、既有刮痕、冷氣會不會滴水都拍進去，最好跟房東共用同一份附屬設備清單並各留一份；退租點交時照著同一份對，才不會有東西莫名其妙變成你弄壞的。自己買的家電留好收據，哪些要帶走、哪些要留下也才說得清楚
variations: 退租那天才發現，兩年下來真正屬於我的只有一趟車。
房間恢復原狀的速度，比我以為的快太多了。

en.content:
Things in this room that belong to my landlord: a bed, a wardrobe, an air conditioner, a fridge that restarts itself, a desk and chair, and a dehumidifier in the corner I have never once switched on.
Things that belong to me: a desk lamp, a rice cooker, two boxes of books, a duvet I bought myself, and a calendar taped to the back of the door.
On move-out day the second list went into one car,
and the room turned back into the room I first walked into.
Two years of adding things to this place,
and everything I could actually take fit in a single trip.
en.editorNote: For packing-up week, or your first days in a new place. On day one, photograph every piece of landlord-supplied furniture and every appliance, including model numbers, existing scratches, and whether the air conditioner drips. Build a fixtures inventory with your landlord and keep a copy each, then walk the same list at handover so nothing quietly becomes damage you caused. Keep receipts for anything you bought yourself, so it stays obvious what leaves with you and what stays
variations: Move-out day: two years here, and everything that was mine fit in one car trip.
The room went back to being an empty room much faster than I expected.

items.sourceNote: 2026 guide noting the classic simple offering is a chicken-leg lunchbox; joke is original

zh-tw.content:
聽說地基主愛吃雞腿便當。
我這個月的晚餐也都是雞腿便當。
看來我們口味挺合的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合中元前後一個人在外面吃便當的時候發
variations: 我跟地基主這個月吃得一樣好。

en.content:
They say the house spirit likes a chicken-leg lunchbox.
So was every dinner I've had this month.
Good to know we have the same taste.
en.editorNote: For anyone eating another takeout dinner alone during ghost month
variations: The house spirit and I ate equally well this month.

items.sourceNote: 2026 ghost-month guide with a simplified version for renters and small households; hallway scene is original

zh-tw.content:
農曆七月，鄰居在走廊擺了一桌。
我出門側身，回家借過。
這層樓今年最熱鬧的一個月。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合大樓走廊突然多出一張供桌的那幾天
variations: 我家門口這個月比我還忙。

en.content:
Seventh month. My neighbor set a table in the hallway.
I leave sideways, I come home saying excuse me.
Busiest this floor's been all year.
en.editorNote: For the days a folding table appears in your building's hallway
variations: My doorway has a busier month than I do.

items.sourceNote: explainer on why renters are often the ones who tend the house spirit; long-tenancy joke is original

zh-tw.content:
這間房子我住第三年。
房東換過一個，仲介換過兩個，樓下的早餐店收掉了。
只有地基主從我搬進來那天就在，而且從來沒說要漲。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合住得夠久、看著周圍全部換過一輪的租客
variations: 我這三年換掉的東西，比這間房子還多。

en.content:
Third year in this apartment.
One landlord replaced, two agents replaced, and the breakfast shop downstairs closed for good.
Only the house spirit has been here since the day I moved in, and he has never once asked for more.
en.editorNote: For renters who've outlasted the landlord, the agent, and the shop downstairs
variations: In three years I've replaced more things than this apartment has.

items.sourceNote: first-year-student renting checklist from a housing site; elevator scene is original

zh-tw.content:
開學前一週，電梯裡永遠有一個紙箱跟一床棉被。
有個媽媽在旁邊交代：「水打開，看它多久會熱。」
我住四年了，第一次知道要看這個。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合開學搬家季，看著新生跟家長進出的時候
variations: 新生的媽媽比我還會看房。

en.content:
The week before term starts, the elevator always has a cardboard box and a rolled-up duvet in it.
A mom was coaching her kid: "Run the tap. See how long it takes to get hot."
Four years in this building and that had never occurred to me.
en.editorNote: For move-in week, watching new students and their parents haul boxes
variations: That kid's mom is a better apartment inspector than I am.

items.sourceNote: tenant forum threads about pre-existing damage at move-out; dialogue is original

zh-tw.content:
「這道刮痕不是我弄的。」
「也不是我弄的。」
我們一起看著上一個房客留下的紀念。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合退租驗屋當下，兩邊都指著同一道刮痕的時候
variations: 那道刮痕比我們兩個都資深。
房子裡最有歷史的東西，是沒人承認的那一道。

en.content:
"That scratch wasn't me."
"Wasn't me either."
So we both stood there admiring the last tenant's work.
en.editorNote: For the walkthrough moment when nobody will claim the damage
variations: That scratch has been here longer than either of us.
The oldest thing in this apartment is a scratch with no owner.

items.sourceNote: DIY wall-patching guides for renters; ending is original

zh-tw.content:
我用補土把三個釘孔填平，白漆補一補。
牆變回新的，我住過的兩年也一起被抹掉。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合退租前一晚自己補牆的時候
variations: 補完牆才發現，最容易被抹掉的是我。
三個釘孔，掛過我兩年的生活。

en.content:
I filled the three nail holes with putty and touched up the paint.
The wall looks new. So do my two years here.
en.editorNote: For the night before move-out, patching walls by yourself
variations: Patched the wall and erased myself with it.
Three nail holes held up two years of my life.

items.sourceNote: consumer complaints about undocumented cleaning charges; punchline is original

zh-tw.content:
清潔費三千，我問有沒有收據。
他說是他自己掃的。
那應該是他這輩子時薪最高的兩小時。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合被扣清潔費卻拿不到任何憑證的時候
variations: 沒有收據的費用，通常也沒有清潔。
三千塊掃兩小時，難怪他那麼堅持。

en.content:
Three grand for cleaning. I asked for a receipt.
He said he did it himself.
Best two hours he'll ever bill.
en.editorNote: For a cleaning fee charged with no paperwork behind it
variations: A fee with no receipt usually comes with no cleaning either.
No wonder he insisted on doing it himself.

items.sourceNote: tenancy dispute mediation accounts; bargaining framing is original

zh-tw.content:
他開口扣八千，我說一毛都不行，最後成交三千。
原來押金不是退的，是喊的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合押金談到一半，發現這根本是在市場買菜的時候
variations: 押金退多少，看誰比較敢沉默。
早知道是喊價，我就從負的開始喊。

en.content:
He opened at eight thousand. I said zero.
We closed at three.
A deposit isn't returned, it's haggled over.
en.editorNote: For the moment your deposit turns into a market negotiation
variations: Whoever stays quiet longer keeps the money.
If I'd known it was an auction I'd have started below zero.

items.sourceNote: tenant threads about quirky old-apartment door locks; the wrist detail and landlord reply are original

zh-tw.content:
這個鎖要把門往上提一點才轉得動。
前三個月我每次都卡在門口，後來不用想了，手腕自己會抓那個角度。
我報修過一次，房東來試，一開就開，跟他說的一樣：「你看，沒壞啊。」
他也是提著開的。
同一個動作他做了十年，做到不覺得那是學來的。
我現在最熟練的一件事，是開別人家的門。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合住到身體比腦袋還熟這間房子、卻還是覺得它不是自己家的時候
variations: 住久了不是變習慣，是身體先投降。
這間房子沒教我修東西，只教我怎麼配合它。

en.content:
The lock only turns if you lift the door a little.
For three months I fought it every time I came home. After that, my wrist just knew the angle.
I reported it once. The landlord tried it, opened it first try, and said exactly what I expected: 'See? Nothing wrong with it.'
He was lifting too.
Ten years of the same motion, long enough to forget he ever learned it.
The thing I'm best at now is opening someone else's door.
en.editorNote: For when your body knows the apartment better than you do, and it still isn't yours
variations: You don't get used to a place. Your body gives in first.
This apartment never taught me to fix anything, only to accommodate it.

items.sourceNote: restore-to-original-condition clauses in standard lease templates; the borrowing analogy is original

zh-tw.content:
租房子比較像借書，不像買書。
整本你都能看，每天翻也行，但不能畫線、不能折角，時間到要原樣還回去。
後面還有人在排隊，館方也隨時可以說這本不外借了。
我在這本書裡住了兩年。
歸還那天，它得看起來像從來沒被翻開過。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合退租前把牆補平、把生活痕跡一項一項抹掉的那幾天
variations: 借來的東西，用得越小心，越不像自己的。
還書的規矩很簡單：讀過，但不能留下讀過的證據。

en.content:
Renting is less like buying a book than borrowing one.
Read the whole thing, every day if you want, but no underlining, no folded corners, and it goes back exactly as it came.
Someone's already on the hold list, and the library can pull it from circulation whenever it likes.
I lived inside this one for two years.
On return day, it had to look like it had never been opened.
en.editorNote: For the days before move-out, when you're erasing every trace that you lived there
variations: The more carefully you treat a borrowed thing, the less it feels like yours.
The rule is simple: read it, just don't leave proof that you did.

items.sourceNote: renter threads about how to word a repair request so the landlord actually replies; the four-rewrite detail is original

zh-tw.content:
你住久了會發現，租屋要學的第一件事不是修東西，是傳訊息。
你會先打「不好意思打擾了」，把「壞了」改成「好像怪怪的」，把驚嘆號刪掉，
最後補一句「再麻煩您有空看一下，謝謝」。
一句話改四次，只因為你怕被當成難搞的房客。
房子是他的，錢是你付的，
低頭的卻是每個月準時匯款的那個人。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個又在草稿裡反覆刪字、怕麻煩房東的朋友
variations: 我不是客氣，我是在保護我的押金。
同一則訊息，收租的人五分鐘回，修東西的人五天回。

en.content:
The first thing renting teaches you isn't how to fix things. It's how to text.
You open with 'sorry to bother you,' downgrade 'it's broken' to 'it seems a little off,' delete the exclamation mark,
and close with 'whenever you have a chance, thank you so much.'
Four rewrites for one sentence, because you don't want to be the difficult tenant.
It's his building. It's your money.
And the one softening their voice is the person who pays on time every month.
en.editorNote: Send it to the friend still editing a repair text in the draft box
variations: I'm not being polite, I'm protecting my deposit.
Same message: five minutes when it's rent, five days when it's a repair.

items.sourceNote: the standard residential lease form's Party A / Party B wording; the two-second pause is original

zh-tw.content:
簽約那天，筆遞過來，我在「甲方」跟「乙方」中間停了兩秒。
不是分不出來，
是那兩秒我才發現：這張紙上，他有一間房子，我有一個代號。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合第一次簽租約、突然被合約用語冷到的那一刻
variations: 簽名的地方留給我，房子的名字留給他。
兩秒鐘，我把自己歸檔成乙方。

en.content:
Signing day. The pen slid across the table and I froze for two seconds between 'Party A' and 'Party B.'
Not because I couldn't tell them apart.
Because in those two seconds it landed: on this page he has a property, and I have a label.
en.editorNote: For the chill of signing your first lease and reading what the contract calls you
variations: He gets the address. I get the signature line.
Two seconds, and I filed myself under Party B.

items.sourceNote: shared-entrance keypad codes never being rotated in old walk-ups; scene written original

zh-tw.content:
房東把大門換成電子鎖，說這樣比較安全，也不用再配鑰匙。
密碼是門牌號碼，四碼，還用鉛筆寫在配電箱旁邊，怕住戶忘記。
我住了兩年，那組數字一次都沒改過，也就是說這兩年搬走的每一個人，現在都還進得來。
睡前我會多推一次門，確認它真的鎖上了——雖然我很清楚，會出事的不是那道門。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給剛搬進「全棟共用一組密碼」公寓的朋友，順便提醒他問房東多久改一次
variations: 房東說電子鎖比較安全，安全的是他從此不用再配鑰匙。
全棟共用一組四碼密碼，用了兩年，連前房客都還背得出來。

en.content:
The landlord swapped the front door for a keypad lock — safer, he said, and no more cutting keys.
The code is the street number, four digits, penciled on the wall by the breaker box so nobody forgets.
I've lived here two years and it has never once been changed, which means everyone who moved out in those two years can still walk right in.
Before bed I push the door one extra time to make sure it latched, knowing perfectly well the door isn't the part that's open.
en.editorNote: For anyone who just moved into a building where the whole stairwell shares one entry code
variations: He says the keypad is safer. What it is, is cheaper than cutting keys.
Four digits, two years, and a guest list nobody has ever pruned.

items.sourceNote: 2026 rental act amendment draft reportedly dropping the 3-year minimum lease and renewal rent-cap clauses; reaction written original

zh-tw.content:
新聞說修法原本要保障最短三年租期，後來草案裡那一條不見了。
我把手機拿給室友看，他頭也沒抬：「本來就沒有過啊。」
我們這間租約寫一年，每年七月重簽，重簽前一個禮拜我會開始睡不好。
三年到底安不安穩我不知道，我只知道自己每年七月，都要重賭一次房東今年的心情。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在租賃修法上新聞、而你剛好也快要續約的那幾天轉發
variations: 我的居住穩定，寫在一張每年七月會過期的紙上。
三年很長，長到連草案都覺得不好意思寫進去。

en.content:
The news said the bill was supposed to guarantee a three-year minimum lease, and then that clause quietly vanished from the draft.
I held my phone out to my roommate. He didn't even look up: 'It was never going to happen.'
Our lease runs twelve months, we re-sign every July, and the week before I stop sleeping properly.
I don't know what three years of stability feels like — I only know I re-bet on my landlord's mood every July.
en.editorNote: Send it during a rental-law news cycle, especially if your own renewal is coming up
variations: My housing stability is printed on a page that expires every July.
Three years was too long to promise, so nobody promised anything.

items.sourceNote: post-move-out mail forwarding hassles; the address-list punchline is original

zh-tw.content:
我搬走三個月後，前一間的信箱還在收我的信。
新房客傳訊息來：「你的健檢報告在我這裡，還有兩張罰單跟一本銀行月結單。」
我約了一個下午回去拿，順便把地址一個一個改掉：銀行、電信、監理站，還有那家我早就不去的健身房。
改到最後我才發現，我在這座城市搬過四次家，真正記得我住哪裡的，只有這些寄信給我的機構。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合退租一陣子之後才想起「地址都還沒改」的人，也可以當搬家待辦清單的提醒
variations: 搬家搬走的是家具，改地址改掉的是整個人生。
我搬過四次家，郵局比我媽更清楚我住在哪。

en.content:
Three months after I moved out, my old mailbox was still collecting my mail.
The new tenant texted me: 'I've got your health screening results, two parking tickets, and a bank statement.'
I went back one afternoon to pick it all up and spent the evening changing my address one account at a time — bank, phone carrier, DMV, and a gym I stopped going to years ago.
By the last form it hit me: I've moved four times in this city, and the only things that reliably know where I live are the institutions that mail me things.
en.editorNote: For anyone who realizes weeks after moving that half their mail is still going to the old place
variations: Moving is furniture. Changing your address is your whole paper life.
Four apartments in, and the post office knows my life better than my mother does.

items.sourceNote: west-facing rooms and landlord-supplied sheer curtains in Taiwanese summers; framing written original

zh-tw.content:
這個房間朝西，下午四點以後，牆壁摸起來是溫的。
房東給的窗簾薄到能看見對面大樓的輪廓，他把那叫做採光好。
我自己補上遮光簾、隔熱紙，還在窗邊靠了一片瓦楞紙板，像在幫這間房子遮它自己的缺點。
一個夏天過完我大概算得出來：他每個月收我一萬四，其中有一部分，是我自己花錢買回來的陰影。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給正在考慮西曬房、或已經在房間裡跟太陽長期抗戰的朋友
variations: 仲介說採光極佳，翻譯過來是：下午四點以後這裡是烤箱。
我在租來的房間裡，花錢買了三坪的影子。

en.content:
My room faces west, and after four in the afternoon the wall is warm to the touch.
The curtain the landlord provided is sheer enough to see the outline of the building across the street; he calls that great natural light.
So I added blackout panels, window film, and a sheet of cardboard propped against the glass — patching the apartment's flaws on the apartment's behalf.
By the end of the summer I could do the math: of the rent I hand him every month, a slice is me buying back my own shade.
en.editorNote: For friends touring a west-facing unit, or already at war with the afternoon sun
variations: 'Excellent natural light' translates to: after 4pm this is an oven.
In a rented room, shade is something you have to purchase.

items.sourceNote: upfront move-in costs (deposit, agent fee, pest control, appliances) in Taiwan; the first-night image is original

zh-tw.content:
押二付一、仲介服務費半個月、除蟲一千二、一台二手洗衣機三千五。
搬進去的那個月我一次付掉五萬八，房間裡連一張椅子都還沒有。
第一晚我坐在地板上吃便當，背後是一面白牆，前面是一個還沒拆的紙箱。
那天我算清楚了一件事：在這座城市，光是把「住進來」辦完，就要先交出一個半月的薪水。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給正在存搬家基金的人，提醒他預算不能只算月租
variations: 月租一萬四聽起來還行，直到你把第一個月的收據攤開來看。
搬家最貴的一天，是你還沒睡過任何一晚的那一天。

en.content:
Two months' deposit plus the first month, half a month to the agent, twelve hundred for pest control, thirty-five hundred for a secondhand washer.
The month I moved in I paid out fifty-eight thousand, and the room still didn't have a single chair.
My first night I ate takeout sitting on the floor, a blank wall behind me and an unopened box in front of me.
That was the night the math landed: in this city, simply arriving costs you a month and a half of salary before you've slept there once.
en.editorNote: Send it to someone saving up a moving fund — the monthly rent is the smallest part of the bill
variations: Fourteen thousand a month sounds fine until you lay out the first month's receipts.
The most expensive day of renting is the one before you've spent a single night there.

items.sourceNote: old-apartment circuit capacity and shared breakers in subdivided units; the appliance-shift scene is original

zh-tw.content:
如果我要吹頭髮，就得先把房間的冷氣關掉。
如果忘了關，總開關會跳，整層樓一起黑掉，我得拿手電筒下樓，在房東的鞋櫃後面把它扳回去。
這間房只有兩個插座，一個在床頭，一個在門邊，其他全靠一條五公尺的延長線串起來。
如果哪天我搬去可以同時開冷氣跟微波爐的地方，我大概會站在中間發呆五分鐘，什麼都不做。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個房間只有兩個插座、每天在心裡排電器班表的朋友
variations: 我家的電器有班表，一次只能上工一台。
跳電三秒之後，我的腳已經知道要往樓下哪個鞋櫃走。

en.content:
If I want to blow-dry my hair, I have to switch off the AC first.
If I forget, the breaker trips and the whole floor goes dark, so I take a flashlight downstairs and flip it back behind my landlord's shoe cabinet.
This room has two outlets, one by the bed and one by the door, and everything else runs off a single very long extension cord.
If I ever move somewhere I can run the AC and the microwave at once, I'll probably just stand in the middle of it for five minutes doing nothing.
en.editorNote: For the friend whose room has two outlets and who mentally schedules which appliance gets to run
variations: My appliances work in shifts, one on the clock at a time.
Three seconds into a blackout, my feet already know which shoe cabinet to walk to.

items.sourceNote: being sick alone in a rented room, a recurring thread among solo renters; the scene here is written from scratch

zh-tw.content:
星期天早上，體溫計顯示三十八度五。
我把棉被從床上拖下來鋪在地板，那裡離冷氣出風口遠一點。
巷口超商來回七分鐘，我買了退熱貼、一瓶電解質水和一盒白粥。
回到房間，粥放在桌上等它涼，我躺著看天花板那盞燈亮著，沒有人會來敲門。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給第一次自己在外面生病、隔壁房沒有人可以喊的那個朋友
variations: 一個人住最現實的一課，是發燒那天要自己走去超商。
從床到門只有三步，生病那天剛好是三步太遠。

en.content:
Sunday morning, the thermometer read a hundred and one.
I dragged the comforter off the bed onto the floor, farther from the AC vent.
Seven minutes round trip to the convenience store for cooling patches, an electrolyte drink, and a container of rice porridge.
Back in the room the porridge sat cooling on the desk while I lay there watching the ceiling light, and nobody knocked.
en.editorNote: For anyone getting sick alone in a rented room for the first time, with nobody in the next room to call
variations: Living alone gets real the day you walk to the store with a fever.
Three steps from the bed to the door, and on a sick day that is three steps too far.

items.sourceNote: renters living above street-food stalls and the smell that never leaves their clothes; the garment-narrator device is original

zh-tw.content:
在這扇門後面掛了兩年，我是那件黑外套。
樓下那攤鹽酥雞晚上六點開火，油煙順著氣窗爬上來，我每天吸滿八個小時。
主人洗過我三次，換過兩種柔軟精，還把我掛到窗邊吹了一整個週末。
他今天早上把我拿下來聞了一下，嘆一口氣，然後還是穿著我出門了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給住在小吃街樓上、衣櫃裡每件衣服都是同一種味道的朋友
variations: 便宜的房租，有時候是用鼻子在付的。
我的衣服全部同一種味道，房仲當初說那叫『生活機能好』。

en.content:
Two years on the hook behind this door, and I'm still the black jacket.
The fried chicken stand downstairs fires up at six, the smoke climbs in through the vent window, and I take in eight hours of it a night.
My owner has washed me three times, tried two kinds of fabric softener, and hung me by the window for an entire weekend.
This morning he lifted me down, sniffed me, sighed, and wore me out the door anyway.
en.editorNote: For the friend living above a row of food stalls whose entire closet smells like someone else's dinner
variations: Cheap rent sometimes gets paid with your nose.
Every shirt I own smells the same, and the listing called that great access to food.

items.sourceNote: windowless rental bathrooms with dead or unwired exhaust fans; the switch-plate reveal is written fresh

zh-tw.content:
搬進來半年，我一直以為浴室的抽風機年紀大了，轉不太動。
毛巾三天不乾，鏡子從早霧到晚，天花板角落慢慢長出一片黑點。
上個月換燈泡，我順手把牆上的開關面板拆下來，那顆按鈕後面兩條線斷在半空中，什麼都沒接。
我拍照傳給房東，他回我一句『那顆本來就是裝好看的』，然後就沒有下文了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給浴室沒有窗、也從來沒聽過抽風機轉起來的那位朋友
variations: 我家的抽風機開關按下去只有一個功能：讓我覺得自己有在處理。
那面牆從來沒有通過風，我擦掉一次，它兩個禮拜後長回來。

en.content:
For six months I figured the bathroom fan was just old and tired.
Towels took three days to dry, the mirror stayed fogged from morning to night, and black spots crept across one corner of the ceiling.
Last month I changed a bulb, pulled the switch plate off the wall, and found two wires dangling behind that button, connected to nothing.
I sent my landlord a photo, he replied that the switch had always been decorative, and that was the end of it.
en.editorNote: For the friend with a windowless bathroom whose fan switch has never once made a sound
variations: My bathroom fan switch does exactly one thing: it makes me feel like I'm handling it.
That wall has never had airflow, so I wipe the mold off and it grows back in two weeks.

items.sourceNote: 2026 租屋電費上限與超收申訴資料；分租套房一度 5-6 元的普遍現象，情境與句子自寫

zh-tw.content:
有人問我，一度電收六塊到底合不合法。
答案是不合法，台電那張單子攤開來，我這間房間夏天一度是三塊多。
他以為我接下來要說我準備去申訴。
我沒有，因為房東手上還有我兩個月的押金，還有明年要不要跟我續約的決定權。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給夏天帳單一來就開始算數學、算完還是默默轉帳的租屋朋友
variations: 我算得出自己被多收多少，也算得出開口的代價。
電表是房東裝的，帳單是我在付的，這兩張紙從來沒有對過。

en.content:
Somebody asked me whether charging six a unit for electricity is even legal.
It isn't, and if you pull up the actual utility bill my summer rate runs a little over three.
He assumed the next thing out of my mouth would be that I'm filing a complaint.
I'm not, because my landlord is still sitting on two months of my deposit and the call on next year's lease.
en.editorNote: For the friend who does the math on every summer power bill and then quietly pays it anyway
variations: I can work out how much I'm being overcharged, and I can work out what speaking up would cost me.
The meter is his and the bill is mine, and those two numbers have never once been compared.

items.sourceNote: 租屋族雜支討論（房租外的網路、水電、公共設備分攤）；自助洗衣店店員視角為原創寫法

zh-tw.content:
在自助洗衣店上夜班久了，幾張常客的臉大概都記得住。
有個女生每個禮拜三晚上十點多來，帶一本書，洗完加烘完剛好一小時四十分。
她跟我說她住的地方有洗衣機，可是三個人共用，而且不能烘。
後來我看懂了，她是來借一個有冷氣、有燈、沒有別人的地方，衣服算是順手一起帶下來的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那位寧可多花六十塊，也要換一段安靜時間的合租朋友
variations: 投幣洗衣店是我這個月待過最舒服的空間。
我租到的是一個房間，冷氣跟安靜要另外算錢。

en.content:
Work enough night shifts at a laundromat and you start knowing the regulars by face.
One girl shows up every Wednesday around ten with a paperback, and a wash plus a dry runs her exactly an hour forty.
She told me her building has a machine, but it's shared three ways and there's no dryer attached.
Took me a few months to catch on: she's buying a lit, cool room with nobody else in it, and the laundry is what she carries down to justify it.
en.editorNote: For the roommate-having friend who'll pay two bucks for one quiet hour that belongs to her
variations: The coin laundry is the nicest room I've spent time in all month.
I rented a room, and the air conditioning and the quiet are billed separately.

items.sourceNote: 獨立套房與分租套房差異說明；『暫時』的定義句寫法為原創

zh-tw.content:
「廚房 易碎 勿壓」——這箱從新竹搬到板橋，再搬到現在這裡。
「冬天衣服 先不用拆」——旁邊用另一支筆補了「真的不用拆」。
「雜物」——只有兩個字，寫的時候大概已經放棄分類了。
最底下那箱沒有標籤，上面壓著一張便條：先放著，之後再說。
我搬過四次，每次都重寫一輪標籤，只有那箱從來沒被拆開過。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個牆角永遠堆著幾箱沒拆的朋友
variations: 「先放著，之後再說」是我家最長壽的一張便條。
搬了四次，最底下那箱一次都沒拆過。

en.content:
"KITCHEN — FRAGILE, DON'T STACK" — this one went Hsinchu, then Banqiao, then here.
"WINTER CLOTHES — DON'T OPEN YET" — with "seriously, don't" added later in a different pen.
"STUFF" — one word, written by someone who had given up sorting.
The bottom box has no label at all, just a sticky note: leave it, deal with it later.
Four moves, four rounds of relabeling, and that box has never once been opened.
en.editorNote: For the friend with a corner of boxes that never got unpacked
variations: "Deal with it later" is the longest-running note in my apartment.
Four moves in, the bottom box still hasn't been opened.

items.sourceNote: 租屋糾紛 QA（房東收回自住、租約終止與提前解約）；未來場景寫法為原創

zh-tw.content:
那則訊息還沒出現，可是我大概知道它長什麼樣子。
某個很普通的晚上，房東先傳一句不好意思跟你說一件事，接著是兒子要結婚、房子要收回自住。
我會回一個好，然後打開租屋網，把預算往上調三千。
我住在這裡的每一天，都是在幫別人看著一個房間。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給住得很安穩、卻不敢買太大件家具的那位朋友
variations: 租約是一段還沒公布日期的倒數。
決定我什麼時候搬家的，常常是別人家的喜事。

en.content:
The message hasn't landed yet, but I already know how it's going to read.
Some perfectly ordinary weeknight my landlord opens with sorry to spring this on you, and then it's the son getting married and the place being taken back.
I'll type back no problem, open the listings app, and push my budget up another few thousand.
Every day I live here, I'm keeping a room warm for someone else.
en.editorNote: For the friend who's settled in beautifully and still won't buy a couch
variations: A lease is a countdown that hasn't announced its date yet.
The thing that decides when I move is usually good news in somebody else's family.

items.sourceNote: PTT 討論租屋補助與戶籍／居住證明落差；改寫為原創情境

zh-tw.content:
里民活動中心門口擺了免費量血壓的攤位，志工翻著名冊問我是哪一里的。
我報了門牌，他說這條巷子屬隔壁里，要我到那邊的活動中心去量。
過年回老家經過同一種攤位，志工沒問我任何事，直接把我的名字寫上去，還順口問我媽的藥吃完沒。
我在這裡住滿五年，在那裡一年待不到七天，能證明我住哪裡的，始終是那張沒改過的戶籍。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在被要求提供居住證明、或跨年度重辦各種地址相關手續時發的貼文
variations: 我在這座城市付了五年房租，能證明我住哪裡的文件，全都指向一個我一年只回去三天的地方。
戶籍在老家，生活在這裡，兩邊都覺得我是隔壁的人。

en.content:
The community center out front had a free blood-pressure booth, and the volunteer flipped through her roster asking which precinct I belonged to.
I gave my street number; she said that lane belongs to the next precinct over and I should go to their center instead.
Back home over the holidays, the same kind of booth, and nobody asked me anything — she wrote my name down and asked whether my mom had finished her prescription.
I've lived here five years and spend under a week a year there, yet the only paper that says where I live still points home.
en.editorNote: For when you're asked for proof of residence, or re-doing address paperwork for the nth year
variations: Five years of rent in this city, and every document that proves where I live points somewhere I visit for three days a year.
Registered there, living here, and treated as an outsider in both places.

items.sourceNote: PTT 討論小套房生活忍耐度；改寫為原創情境

zh-tw.content:
19:40　下班，背包裡是毛巾、分裝的洗髮精，還有明天要穿的襯衫。
20:05　在跑步機上走完二十分鐘，這是我月費裡唯一真的用到的器材。
20:30　更衣室的熱水一開就是熱的，不用先放三分鐘，也不用怕它中途變冷。
20:50　這裡有一整面鏡子，我房間那面只照得到肩膀以上。
