21:15　走回租屋處，路上算過一次：月費一千二，跟叫一次熱水器師傅差不多。
21:35　進門，浴室的燈亮著，室友在裡面，我把毛巾掛回門後就好。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合傳給那個辦了健身房會員卻從來沒認真運動過的室友或朋友
variations: 我辦健身房不是為了練，是為了那二十分鐘不用等的熱水。
月費一千二換一間不用排隊的浴室，我覺得這筆帳算得很清楚。

en.content:
7:40 pm — Off work, backpack holding a towel, travel-size shampoo, and tomorrow's shirt.
8:05 pm — Twenty minutes on the treadmill, the only equipment in my membership I actually use.
8:30 pm — Hot water is hot the second you turn it on, no three-minute wait, no going cold halfway.
8:50 pm — Full-length mirror here; mine at home shows me from the shoulders up.
9:15 pm — Walking back, I run the math again: twelve hundred a month, about what one water-heater repair call costs.
9:35 pm — Home. Bathroom light is on, roommate's inside, and I just hang the towel back on the door.
en.editorNote: Send to the roommate or friend who pays for a gym and never really works out
variations: I didn't join a gym to get fit. I joined for twenty minutes of hot water I don't have to wait for.
Twelve hundred a month for a bathroom with no queue is, honestly, a reasonable trade.

items.sourceNote: 旭時報談租屋族缺乏公共／可使用空間；改寫為原創情境

zh-tw.content:
車牌號碼：沒有車，帶來的是一張撿回來的雙人沙發。
使用時段：星期日早上七點，整場只有我跟一台在打蠟的休旅車。
使用項目：高壓沖洗，五十元三分鐘，我投了兩次還是不夠。
申請原因：房間裡唯一的水龍頭在洗手台，沖不到一張沙發的一半。
乾燥方式：靠在圍牆邊等太陽，先跟老闆說一聲。
備註：洗完我才想到，這是我搬進來半年，唯一一件真正整理過的東西。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合搬家後撿到二手家具、卻發現租屋處沒地方清洗時發的動態
variations: 租屋族的家事現場不一定在家裡，有時候在投幣式的高壓水槍前面。
五十元三分鐘，我洗的是沙發，順便洗掉一點搬家的狼狽。

en.content:
Plate number: No car. I brought a two-seater couch I found on the curb.
Time slot: Sunday, 7 am, just me and one SUV getting waxed.
Service used: Pressure wash, fifty bucks for three minutes, and two rounds still weren't enough.
Reason for request: The only tap in my place is the bathroom sink, which can't reach half a couch.
Drying method: Propped against the wall in the sun, after asking the owner.
Notes: Halfway through I realized this is the first thing I've actually cleaned since I moved in six months ago.
en.editorNote: For the post after you rescue secondhand furniture and realize your rental has nowhere to wash it
variations: Renter chores don't always happen at home. Sometimes they happen at a coin-op pressure washer.
Fifty bucks, three minutes. I was washing a couch and rinsing off a little of the move with it.

items.sourceNote: 果仁家整理租屋修繕責任歸屬案例；改寫為原創情境

zh-tw.content:
我坐在候診區，第三十二號，手上捏著一張寫到一半的初診單。
護理師喊到二十七號，一個阿伯站起來，我順手把掉在椅子底下的一張衛生紙撿去丟掉。
表格上「過敏原」那一欄我空著，因為我不知道該填塵蟎、黴菌，還是那間關起窗會悶、打開窗就對著隔壁排風口的房間。
等一下輪到我，我大概還是會說最近比較累。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在看完醫生、卻沒把住處問題講出口的那天發，或傳給忍很久才去掛號的朋友
variations: 醫生問我家裡通風好不好，我說還可以，然後付錢領藥回那間還可以的房間。
初診單上最難填的不是病史，是那格要我描述自己每天住在什麼樣的空氣裡。

en.content:
I'm in the waiting room, number thirty-two, holding a half-filled new-patient form.
The nurse calls twenty-seven, an older man stands up, and I pick up a tissue from under the chair and toss it.
I leave the allergens box blank, because I don't know whether to write dust mites, mold, or the room that gets stuffy with the window shut and faces the restaurant's exhaust vent with it open.
When my number comes up, I'll probably just say I've been a little tired lately.
en.editorNote: For the day you see a doctor and still don't mention the apartment, or for the friend who waited far too long to go
variations: The doctor asked if my place is well ventilated. I said it's fine, then took my prescription back to the place that's fine.
The hardest line on the intake form isn't medical history. It's the one asking what kind of air I live in.

items.sourceNote: 台灣高鐵「搭高鐵・返校去」大學生 5 折列車加開 28 班、8/6 起開放購票；改寫為原創情境

zh-tw.content:
這幾個禮拜，站在我身上的行李箱明顯變多了，二十九吋的、租來的、用膠帶補過角的都有。
高鐵的返校五折車次一放票就被搶光，他們會提早四十分鐘上月台，蹲在我這條黃線後面滑手機。
我聽得出兩種語氣：一種說我要回家，一種說我要回房間。
同一班車、同一條線，下車以後就變成兩件事了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合開學前一週搭車返校那天發，或傳給每年這個時候都要拖著行李跨縣市的朋友
variations: 月台上大家看起來都是要回家，只有我知道我要回去的地方每個月都要付錢。
五折車次搶不到就改坐客運，行李一樣重，只是排的隊比較長、到的時間比較晚。

en.content:
These past few weeks the suitcases parked on top of me have multiplied — 29-inchers, rentals, corners patched with tape.
The half-price back-to-school high-speed rail seats sell out the minute they open, so people reach the platform forty minutes early and crouch behind my yellow line, scrolling.
I can hear two versions of the same sentence: I'm going home, and I'm going back to my room.
Same train, same line, and the moment they step off it turns into two different things.
en.editorNote: For the day you head back to school before the semester starts, or for the friend who drags a suitcase across the island every August
variations: Everyone on this platform looks like they're heading home. I'm the only one who knows the place I'm heading to charges me monthly.
Miss the discounted train and you take the bus. Same luggage, longer line, later arrival.

items.sourceNote: 商周整理 2026 夏季電價 6/1–9/30 實施期間與級距計算方式；改寫為原創情境

zh-tw.content:
掛在走廊盡頭那排箱子裡，我從六月開始一格都沒停過。
沒有人特地來看我，只有月底房東拿手機拍一張，回去乘上他自己訂的那個數字。
九月底夏月電價就結束了，台電的級距會回到原價，我這裡的價目大概不會跟著回去。
這層樓有七個房間，只有我完整記得他們今年夏天是怎麼撐過來的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在收到八月電費那天發，或傳給整個夏天都在跟冷氣拔河的室友
variations: 夏月電價只算到九月底，房東那個一度五塊倒是全年無休。
我只負責轉，轉出來的數字後來被解讀成什麼，從來輪不到我說話。

en.content:
Down at the end of the hallway, in that row of boxes, I haven't stopped ticking since June.
Nobody comes to look at me. The landlord just photographs my face at month's end and multiplies it by a rate he invented himself.
Summer pricing stops on September 30 and the utility's tiers go back to normal. The rate in this building probably won't follow.
There are seven rooms on this floor, and I'm the only one keeping a full record of how they got through this summer.
en.editorNote: For the day the August power bill lands, or for the roommate who spent all summer arguing with the AC
variations: Summer rates end September 30. My landlord's flat rate per unit runs all year round.
All I do is spin. What the number means by the time it reaches you was never mine to decide.

items.sourceNote: Lalamove 2026 學生搬家攻略整理的交屋與搬遷流程；改寫為原創情境

zh-tw.content:
留給下一位：
熱水要等大概四十秒，先開再去刷牙剛好
第二扇窗要往左推到底才鎖得起來，別硬拉
Wi-Fi 密碼寫在書桌抽屜內側，房東不知道有這串
對門的阿姨會幫你收衣服，記得回她一聲
牆上那塊顏色不太一樣的地方是我補的，跟漏水無關
押金他退了八成，剩下的兩成就當我留給你的入場費
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合退租收拾完那天發，或傳給正要接手你舊房間的朋友
variations: 搬走前我留了一張紙條，上面全是這間房子不會寫進合約的事。
接手的人傳訊息問我熱水怎麼那麼慢，我回他：紙條第一行。

en.content:
For whoever's next:
hot water takes about forty seconds — turn it on, then go brush your teeth
the second window only locks if you push it all the way left, don't yank it
Wi-Fi password is taped inside the desk drawer, the landlord has no idea it exists
the auntie across the hall will bring your laundry in, say thanks when she does
that slightly off-color patch on the wall is mine, nothing to do with leaks
he returned eighty percent of my deposit, so call the other twenty your cover charge
en.editorNote: For move-out day, or for the friend taking over your old room
variations: I left a note behind with everything about this place that never made it into the lease.
The new tenant messaged asking why the hot water is so slow. Line one of the note, I said.

items.sourceNote: 法律百科整理租屋修繕責任歸屬、房東不修繕時房客可自行修繕並抵扣的做法；改寫為原創情境

zh-tw.content:
案件編號 R-0812　房間網路每晚十點後斷線
08/12　已受理，住戶描述：影片轉圈、通話斷線
08/14　屋主回覆：其他樓層無人反映，請先重開機
08/19　屋主建議住戶自行加裝分享器，費用自理
08/22　住戶自費裝好，狀態更新為「已解決」
備註：這張單子上真正被處理掉的，是住戶的耐心
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合報修等到自己動手的那一天發，或傳給正在跟房東來回訊息的朋友
variations: 報修單最後一欄叫「已解決」，欄位裡沒寫是誰付的錢。
從來訊到結案總共十天，其中九天我在等，第十天我在刷卡。

en.content:
Ticket R-0812 — room Wi-Fi drops every night after ten
08/12 Received. Tenant reports: video buffering, calls cutting out
08/14 Owner replies: no complaints from other floors, please reboot the router first
08/19 Owner suggests the tenant install their own repeater, at tenant's expense
08/22 Tenant installed one out of pocket; status updated to Resolved
Note: what actually got resolved on this ticket was the tenant's patience
en.editorNote: For the day you give up on the repair request and fix it yourself, or for the friend still trading messages with their landlord
variations: The last field on the ticket says Resolved. There's no field for who paid.
Ten days from report to close: nine of them waiting, one of them paying.

items.sourceNote: 2026 租金補貼新制報導（申請須附租約與金融帳戶資料、房東配合簽名）；改寫為原創情境

zh-tw.content:
我伸手去接那張號碼牌，紙還帶著機器吐出來的溫度，B048。
坐下來，我把牛皮紙袋放到大腿上，動作慢得像怕吵醒誰——裡面是存摺、印章，還有一份要拿來約定自動轉帳的租約影本，房東肯在上面簽名，我等了十九天。
螢幕跳到 B046，我轉頭看了一眼，又低頭把袋口的摺線壓平，壓了兩次。
從今天起每個月五號，這筆錢會自己走出去，我不用再按一次確認；我還在想，這到底算輕鬆，還是算它終於連問都不問我了。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合辦完房租自動轉帳、或跑完一趟銀行手續那天發；也適合傳給正在等房東簽名的朋友
variations: 牛皮紙袋裡最重的一張紙，是房東花了十九天才簽下名字的那一張。
設定成自動轉帳的第一個月，我還是在五號那天打開 App 確認了一次。

en.content:
I reach for the queue ticket and the paper is still warm from the machine. B048.
I sit down and lower the envelope onto my lap slowly, like I'm afraid of waking someone — inside are my passbook, my seal, and the copy of the lease I need to set up the standing transfer, the one my landlord took nineteen days to sign.
The screen flips to B046, I turn my head to look, then press the fold at the top of the envelope flat, twice.
Starting this month the rent leaves on the fifth without me confirming anything, and I still can't tell whether that's relief, or whether it just stopped asking me.
en.editorNote: For the day you finally set up automatic rent payments, or for a friend still waiting on a landlord's signature
variations: The heaviest sheet in that envelope was the one it took nineteen days to get signed.
First month on autopay, and I still opened the app on the fifth to check.

items.sourceNote: 報導指出熱門校區與市區周邊租金持續走高，租屋族被迫往外圈找房；改寫為原創情境

zh-tw.content:
一個地方要住到第幾年，才能算是回家？
司機問我去哪，我報了那條路的名字，他從後照鏡看我一眼，說這麼晚還跑這麼遠喔；我說對啊，遠一點，一個月省三千。
後座的窗把整排招牌拉成一條發亮的線，我看著計費表換了兩次數字，順便數自己這幾年換過幾個地址。
到了，他說「好，到家囉」，我道謝、關門、站在路邊看著車尾燈開走，只想問他一句：你怎麼那麼確定？
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合加班到很晚、坐車回租屋處的路上發；也適合剛搬到更遠一站的人
variations: 「到家囉」這三個字，是那趟車上最貴的一句話。
為了一個月省三千，我把回家的路加長了二十分鐘。

en.content:
How many years do you have to live somewhere before it counts as going home?
The driver asks where to, I give him the street name, and he catches my eye in the mirror: "That's pretty far out for this hour." Yeah, I say. Far out saves me three thousand a month.
From the back seat the window smears the storefronts into one bright line, and I watch the meter tick over twice while I count how many addresses I've had.
He pulls in and says, "Alright, you're home." I thank him, shut the door, and stand at the curb watching the taillights, wanting to ask: how are you so sure?
en.editorNote: For the late ride back to your rental after overtime, or for anyone who just moved one stop further out
variations: "You're home" was the most expensive thing said on that ride.
To save three thousand a month I added twenty minutes to the way back.

items.sourceNote: 2026 大學生校外賃居與住宿補助相關報導，提及校外套房空間與負擔；改寫為原創情境

zh-tw.content:
每天晚上九點多，操場最外圈固定會出現一個人在走路，不跑，走得很慢。
他不戴耳機，也不看手錶，走到第四圈才停下來，坐在跑道旁邊的看台上抬頭看很久。
附近運動的人大概都以為他在減重，或者在等誰。
沒有人問過他為什麼要拖到九點多才出門，也沒有人知道他租的那間六坪套房沒有窗，燈一開就只剩四面牆。
我知道，因為紅色跑道上那雙鞋是我的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合住在小套房、晚上總要出門走一走的人；也適合開學季搬進校外套房的新生
variations: 走那四圈的時候我沒在運動，我只是需要一個天花板夠高的地方。
九點以後的操場沒有人收費，這是我住這一區最划算的一件事。

en.content:
Every night around nine, someone shows up on the outer lane of the school track, walking, never running, always slow.
No earbuds, no watch. He stops after the fourth lap and sits on the bleachers looking up for a long time.
The regulars probably assume he's losing weight, or waiting for somebody.
Nobody has asked why he only comes out after nine, and nobody knows the studio he rents has no window, so switching on the light just gives him four walls.
I know, because those are my shoes on the red track.
en.editorNote: For anyone in a tiny rental who has to go out walking at night, or a student moving into off-campus housing this term
variations: Those four laps aren't exercise. It's the only part of my day with real ceiling height.
Nobody charges admission to a track after nine, which makes it the best deal in my neighborhood.

items.sourceNote: 2026 房貸利率與租買成本比較報導，租屋族常做單位成本試算；改寫為原創情境

zh-tw.content:
片尾曲整首放完我才站起來，那兩分四十秒，是我今天最後一段不用自己付錢的冷氣。
出去那條斜斜的走道不到二十公尺，我大概走了三十秒，這三十秒裡我把一筆帳算完：一張票三百三，片長兩小時十分，一小時一百五；我那間套房月租一萬四，一天四百六，扣掉上班的九小時和睡著的七小時，真正醒著待在裡面的時間，一小時要一百五十七塊。
比電影貴，而且沒有字幕，冷氣還要我自己開。
走道盡頭的門推開就是三十四度的夜風，我在那邊站了五秒，才想起來我還是得回去。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合看完電影不想回家的那個晚上發；也適合喜歡算生活單位成本的人
variations: 一張電影票一小時一百五，我的房間一小時一百五十七，難怪我坐到片尾曲放完。
把房租除到每個醒著的小時，那個數字會讓你重新考慮加班的意義。

en.content:
When the house lights came up I didn't move. I sat through the last line of credits and squeezed out two more minutes and forty seconds of air conditioning.
The sloped aisle to the exit isn't twenty meters and I walked it in about thirty seconds, and in those thirty seconds I finished the math: the ticket was 330 for a two-hour-ten-minute film, so 150 an hour; my studio is 14,000 a month, about 460 a day, and once you take out nine hours at work and seven hours asleep, every hour I'm actually awake in there costs 157.
More expensive than the movie, with no subtitles, and I have to run the AC myself.
The door at the end of the aisle opened onto a 34-degree night, and I stood there five seconds before remembering I still had to go back.
en.editorNote: For the night you sit through the credits because you don't want to go back, or for anyone who runs cost-per-hour math on their own life
variations: The movie ran 150 an hour. My room runs 157. No wonder I stayed for the credits.
Divide your rent by the hours you're actually awake in there and overtime starts looking different.

items.sourceNote: Yahoo奇摩轉載租屋隔音技巧文，談輕隔間牆薄、半夜被鄰居吵醒與低成本改善做法；改寫為原創情境

zh-tw.content:
一份睡眠，兩坪內可完成，成本零元。
材料：耳塞一副、電風扇轉到二段、房東留下來那件只遮七成光的窗簾、明天要匯出去的一筆錢
步驟一　十一點半躺平，把隔壁的電視聲當成背景配樂，別跟它硬碰硬
步驟二　牆那頭拖椅子的聲音通常響三下就停，數到三，不要坐起來
步驟三　想到房租，就把手機翻面壓進枕頭底下，看不到的數字先當作還沒發生
步驟四　四點還醒著就起來喝口水，回來重新數那三下
小訣竅　這一道做不壞，最糟也不過就是天亮了
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合住輕隔間分租套房、半夜被吵醒睡不回去的那種晚上發；也適合傳給剛搬進薄牆房間的朋友
variations: 住久了才發現，我沒有變得比較好睡，只是學會把別人的聲音排進自己的睡前流程。
薄牆的房間有一個好處：你永遠知道隔壁幾點睡，代價是他也知道你幾點哭。

en.content:
One night's sleep. Serves one, fits in a 70-square-foot room, costs nothing.
Ingredients: one pair of earplugs, a fan on setting two, the curtain the landlord left behind that blocks maybe seventy percent of the light, and one payment due tomorrow
Step 1 — Lie down at eleven thirty. Treat the TV next door as background music. Do not fight it.
Step 2 — The chair being dragged on the other side of the wall usually scrapes three times and stops. Count to three and stay down.
Step 3 — If the rent comes to mind, flip your phone face down under the pillow. A number you can't see hasn't happened yet.
Step 4 — Still awake at four? Get water, come back, start the three-count over.
Tip: this one can't be ruined. Worst case, it just turns into morning.
en.editorNote: For the night the thin partition wall wakes you up and won't let you back to sleep, or for a friend who just moved into a room with paper walls
variations: I never got better at sleeping. I just folded someone else's noise into my bedtime routine.
Thin walls have one upside: you always know when your neighbor goes to bed. The cost is that he knows when you cry.

items.sourceNote: 聯合新聞網報導鹹酥雞熱議與業者跟風推套餐，反映外食單價成為日常話題；改寫為原創情境

zh-tw.content:
搬來這一區的第一年，我跟室友合點三百塊，甜不辣、四季豆、雞皮全都要，老闆問要不要辣，我們兩個同時說要。
那天回去把紙袋撕開攤在地板上分完，油味在門把上留到隔天早上。
今年八月我一個人回到同一個攤子，開口就是一百二，甜不辣減半，其他不用。
老闆一邊下鍋一邊問我朋友怎麼好久沒來，我說他搬去桃園了，那邊租金談得動。
紙袋還燙著，我抱回去的路上想起我們當年說要一起住到誰先結婚，先寄到的卻是續約通知。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合室友搬走後第一次自己去買宵夜的晚上發；也適合傳給正在跟你分攤房租的那個人
variations: 以前點三百塊要兩個人吃，現在點一百二還會剩，剩下的那部分叫做他搬走了。
同一個攤子，同一份甜不辣，價錢沒變多少，變的是袋子要提回去給幾個人。

en.content:
Our first year in this neighborhood, my roommate and I would order three hundred worth — tempura, green beans, chicken skin, all of it — and when the owner asked about chili we both said yes at the same time.
We'd tear the bag open on the floor back home and split it, and the smell of fryer oil would still be on the door handle the next morning.
This August I stood at that same fryer alone and asked for a hundred and twenty. Half the tempura. Nothing else.
The owner dropped the basket in and asked where my friend had been. Moved to Taoyuan, I said. Rent's negotiable out there.
The bag was still hot on the way back, and I remembered we once said we'd live together until one of us got married. What showed up first was the lease renewal notice.
en.editorNote: For the first late-night food run you make alone after a roommate moves out, or for the person still splitting rent with you
variations: Three hundred used to feed two of us. A hundred and twenty is now too much for one. That leftover part is called he moved out.
Same stall, same tempura, roughly the same price. What changed is how many people the bag has to feed.

items.sourceNote: Money101 整理 2026 租金補貼線上申請須備租賃契約影本、金融帳戶證明等文件；改寫為原創情境

zh-tw.content:
午休把租約攤在公司那台影印機上，六頁，加上存摺封面一張。
印到第四頁卡紙，我蹲下去把那張皺掉的抽出來壓平，重放一次。
一個平常不太講話的同事路過，說了句「你這疊看起來跟我上個月簽的那份一樣厚」。
他那份換到的是三十年，我這疊換到的是一年，明年八月我還得再跑一趟。
同一台機器，同樣六頁紙，吐出來的東西差了二十九年。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合申請租金補貼、印一堆文件的那個午休發；也適合傳給身邊剛買房的同事看
variations: 六頁租約印完只花我三分鐘，讓房東肯簽名那一頁我花了兩個星期。
他印的那疊叫貸款文件，我印的這疊叫補貼資料，紙的重量一樣，年份不一樣。

en.content:
Lunch break, lease spread out on the office copier. Six pages, plus the cover of my bank passbook.
Page four jams. I crouch down, pull the crumpled sheet out, smooth it flat, feed it again.
A coworker who barely talks to anyone walks past and says, "That stack looks about as thick as the one I signed last month."
His stack bought him thirty years. Mine buys me one, and next August I'll be back here running the same six pages.
Same machine, same six sheets, and what comes out the other end is twenty-nine years apart.
en.editorNote: For the lunch break you spend copying documents for a rent subsidy application, or for the coworker who just closed on a mortgage
variations: Copying six pages of a lease took three minutes. Getting my landlord to sign one of them took two weeks.
His pile is called loan paperwork, mine is called subsidy paperwork. Same weight of paper, very different number of years.

items.sourceNote: 天下未來城市整理 2026 租屋補助與租屋族居住狀況，提及頻繁搬遷與居住穩定性；改寫為原創情境

zh-tw.content:
她滑我的相簿，停在一張空房間的照片，抬頭問：「這間是哪裡啊，我怎麼沒看過。」
我盯著螢幕算了三秒，說：「永和吧，也可能是新莊，那幾年換得比較快。」
螢幕上那面牆的插座在左邊第二格，壁癌長成一隻鳥的形狀，這些我全都記得。
只是我還沒準備好在這種晚上承認，五個地址我閉著眼睛都認得，卻沒有一個地址認得我。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合翻到舊租屋照片的那個晚上發；也適合傳給搬過很多次家、還在租的朋友
variations: 我手機裡有五張空房間的照片，每一張拍的都是我離開的前一天。
她以為我認不出那間房，其實我連牆上那塊霉的形狀都還記得。

en.content:
She's scrolling my photos, stops on a shot of an empty room, and looks up: "Where is this? I've never seen it."
I stare at the screen for three seconds and say, "Yonghe, probably. Could be Xinzhuang. I was moving a lot those years."
The outlet on that wall is second from the left, and the damp patch above it grew into the shape of a bird. I remember all of it.
I'm just not ready, on a night like this, to admit I could name all five addresses with my eyes closed, and not one of them can name me.
en.editorNote: For the night an old photo of a place you used to rent surfaces, or for the friend who has moved a dozen times and is still renting
variations: There are five empty rooms in my camera roll, and every one was taken the day before I left.
She assumed I couldn't tell which apartment it was. I still remember the shape of the mold on that wall.

items.sourceNote: ETtoday房產雲報導網友討論「嫌房價貴怎麼不住貨櫃屋」，內行人試算成本其實不便宜；取其「蓋房子的人住不進去」的落差感，改寫為原創情境

zh-tw.content:
第一次坐在工地貨櫃屋裡吃便當，冷氣的水滴在我腳邊，我還拍照傳給朋友說這裡很克難。
第二次坐進來已經是隔年，同一張塑膠椅，我午休開始滑租屋網，找的是離這個案子三站的套房。
第三次坐進來，這棟樓封頂了，接待中心晚上亮到十點，那組沙發比我整間房間的家具加起來還貴。
我拿計算機按過，在這個案子上做滿一年領到的錢，剛好換得起我親手看著砌起來的一面牆。
便當還是八十塊，樓還是我們蓋的。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合在工地、廠務、外派現場上班，午休滑租屋網的時候發；也適合傳給嘴上說「不然你去住貨櫃屋」的人
variations: 我一年的工錢買得起這棟樓的一面牆，而那面牆是我自己看著它立起來的。
接待中心的沙發比我房間所有家具都貴，而那間接待中心是我們搭的。

en.content:
The first time I ate lunch in the site container office, the air conditioner dripped by my foot and I photographed it for friends like it was an adventure.
By the second time it was a year later, same plastic chair, and I was spending the break scrolling listings for a studio three stops from the job.
The third time, the tower had topped out and the sales gallery stayed lit until ten. That one sofa costs more than every piece of furniture in my room combined.
I ran the numbers on my phone: a full year of my pay here buys exactly one wall of the building I watched go up.
The lunchbox is still eighty bucks. The tower is still ours to build and not to live in.
en.editorNote: For the lunch break you spend on a job site scrolling rental listings, or for anyone who tells you to just go live in a shipping container
variations: A year of my wages buys one wall of this tower, and I watched that wall go up myself.
The sofa in the sales gallery costs more than everything I own, and we're the ones who built the room it sits in.

items.sourceNote: 威登工程整理組合屋法規與用途，提到工地宿舍、臨時辦公室的使用年限約15至20年；改寫為原創的租屋物件式諧擬

zh-tw.content:
工地貨櫃屋分租，三坪，附冷氣一台（會滴水，習慣就好）
租金：看你會不會綁鋼筋，會的話還能再談
採光：白天非常好，因為那面外牆還沒封起來
保全：二十四小時有人在巡，只是他巡的是鋼筋不是你
生活機能：走三分鐘到工地大門，走四十分鐘到有店家的路口
公設：飲水機一台、微波爐一台、藍白拖無限供應
可看屋時間：只要你還在這個案子上，任何時候都行
唯一缺點：這棟蓋完，這間就會被吊走，你也要走
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合外派、駐點、跟著案子搬的人自嘲時發；也適合回覆那種寫得天花亂墜的租屋廣告
variations: 全世界最誠實的租屋廣告，就是那種會寫「這間房子的期限跟你的工作一樣長」的。
我住過最便宜的地方，租金是用我會不會綁鋼筋來算的。

en.content:
Site container unit for rent. Roughly 100 sq ft. Air conditioning included (it drips, you'll adjust).
Rent: depends on whether you can tie rebar. If you can, we can talk.
Natural light: excellent during the day, because that exterior wall isn't closed up yet.
Security: someone patrols around the clock, though what he's checking on is the rebar, not you.
Neighborhood: three minutes to the site gate, forty minutes to a road with actual shops.
Amenities: one water cooler, one microwave, an unlimited supply of blue-and-white sandals.
Viewings: any time at all, as long as you're still on this job.
Only drawback: when the tower is finished, this unit gets craned away, and so do you.
en.editorNote: For anyone who moves wherever the job moves, or as a reply to a rental ad that oversells everything
variations: The most honest rental ad in the world is the one that says the lease lasts exactly as long as your job does.
The cheapest place I ever lived priced the rent by whether I could tie rebar.

items.sourceNote: 公視新聞網報導內政部租金統計，全台逾8成行政區未調漲、新北市中位數1.3萬最高；改寫為原創情境

zh-tw.content:
續約通知一年來一張，格式沒變，字體沒變，只有那個數字往上挪一格。
房東早幾年還肯給理由，說物價在漲、說隔壁那間租得比這裡高；後來理由也省了，紙推過來，讓數字自己講話。
新聞那天寫，全國有八成以上的行政區房租沒有動，我把整篇讀完，收進手機裡，沒有拿給他看。
我住的這裡大概就是剩下的那兩成，而且它每年都很準時。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合續約通知寄來、被加租的那個晚上發；也適合傳給每年都在跟房東拉鋸的朋友
variations: 統計說八成的地方都沒漲，我住的那兩成，剛好每年都準時。
房東到後來連理由都懶得編了，直接讓那個數字自己說話。

en.content:
The renewal notice comes once a year in the same format and the same font, and only the number moves up a notch.
Early on the landlord still offered reasons: prices are up, the unit next door goes for more. Eventually he skipped the reasons and slid the page across the table to let the number talk.
The report that week said rents held flat in over eighty percent of the country's districts. I read the whole thing, put my phone away, and never showed it to him.
I must be living in the other twenty percent, and it is punctual every year.
en.editorNote: For the evening the renewal notice arrives with a higher number, or for the friend who negotiates with a landlord every single year
variations: Eighty percent of districts saw no increase. I live in the other twenty, apparently, and it's punctual.
He eventually stopped bothering with a reason and just let the number do the talking.

items.sourceNote: ETtoday報導2026上半年全台租金中位數8600元、微漲1.2%，新北平均1.3萬最貴；改寫為原創情境

zh-tw.content:
新聞說今年上半年全台租金中位數是八千六，我讀到這行的時候，正在算這個月要匯出去的一萬四。
那個數字我相信，只是很想看看八千六租得到的房間長什麼樣，窗戶朝哪一邊，報導從頭到尾沒有附照片。
補貼審過的那天我開心了一整晚，兩個月後房東說要調整，調的幅度剛好把那筆錢接走。
現在我每個月盯著兩個數字，一個是政府發給我的，一個是被拿走的，它們長得越來越像。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合看到租金統計新聞、覺得自己被平均掉的時候發；也適合傳給剛領到租金補貼的朋友
variations: 所謂中位數，就是一個我從來沒住過、但每年都會在新聞上看到的價錢。
補貼下來的那筆錢我只摸到兩個月，第三個月它就轉手了。

en.content:
The report says the national median rent this half-year is about 8,600. I read that line while working out the 14,000 I owe this month.
I believe the number. I would just like to see what 8,600 actually rents, and which way that room's window faces. The article ran no photo.
The night my subsidy was approved I was happy for hours. Two months later the landlord mentioned an adjustment, and the adjustment happened to be the exact size of the subsidy.
Now I watch two figures every month, one that the government sends me and one that leaves, and they look more alike all the time.
en.editorNote: For when a rent statistic in the news makes you feel averaged out of existence, or for a friend whose housing subsidy just came through
variations: A median is a price I have never once paid but read about every year.
I held on to that subsidy for two months. In the third it changed hands.

items.sourceNote: 信義房屋房訊知識整理租約到期前的續租與點交注意事項，提到到期前一個月宜先與房東確認；取其「到期前的提醒」情境，改寫為原創的房東手寫便條

zh-tw.content:
貼在我鐵門上的便條，藍色原子筆，房東的字跡：
到期日：九月三十號，麻煩你自己記一下
位子：地下室機車位 B12，柱子後面那格
倒數：三十四天，我從月曆上數的
要帶走的東西：鑰匙兩把、掛在牆上那頂安全帽、角落那個裝雨衣的箱子
最後一句：那台車真的不騎了就跟我說，別讓它在下面長灰
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合租約快到期、房東突然貼紙條給你的那天發；也適合傳給正在數日子準備搬家的朋友
variations: 房東的字比我的租約好懂，一張便條就把我的九月講完了。
最後那句「別讓它在下面長灰」，聽起來比整份合約都像在關心我。

en.content:
A note taped to my metal door, blue ballpoint, my landlord's handwriting:
Move-out date: September 30th, please keep track of it yourself
Spot: basement motorcycle bay B12, the one tucked behind the pillar
Countdown: thirty-four days, I counted them off the calendar
Things to take with you: both keys, that helmet on the wall hook, the box of rain gear in the corner
Last line: if you really aren't riding that bike anymore, tell me, don't let it sit down there collecting dust
en.editorNote: For the day a note about your lease ending shows up on your door, or for a friend already counting down to moving day
variations: My landlord's handwriting explains my September better than my lease does.
That last line about the bike collecting dust was the warmest sentence in the whole tenancy.

items.sourceNote: 自由財經報導租賃條例修法方向，房東調漲租金須於租期屆滿半年前告知；取其「提前半年通知」的制度細節，改寫為原創情境

zh-tw.content:
四月就收到今年的續約通知，那時候距離九月底還很遠，我拿在手上有點反應不過來。
新法規定房東要漲租得提前半年講，所以這張紙來得又早又準時。
翻到背面最下面有一行小字，說地下室機車位從續約起另計，一個月三百。
那格位子空了兩年沒人收過錢，一張提早半年寄來的紙，讓它忽然變成有價的東西。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合續約通知提早半年寄來、你卻只感覺到壓力提早半年開始的時候發
variations: 半年前就要先告知，聽起來很體貼，實際上是給我半年時間慢慢認命。
那行小字才是重點：空了兩年的機車位，從續約那天開始要收錢。

en.content:
The renewal letter reached me in April, when the end of September was still impossibly far off, and I stood holding it without knowing what to do with it.
The new rule gives landlords six months' lead time before they raise the rent, so the page arrived early and precisely on schedule.
On the back, in small print at the bottom, it said the basement motorcycle bay would be billed separately from renewal onward, three hundred a month.
Nobody had charged for that bay in two years. One page mailed six months ahead turned it into something worth money.
en.editorNote: For when the renewal notice arrives half a year early and all it buys you is half a year of dread
variations: Six months' notice sounds considerate until you realize it's six months to get used to the idea.
The small print was the real message: a bay nobody charged for suddenly has a price.

items.sourceNote: TWProbe房產觀測站整理地下室車位的自用、出租與稅務條件；取其「地下室車位權責模糊」的背景，改寫為原創對話

zh-tw.content:
「你貼在我門上那張紙我看到了，月底就到，對吧。」
「對，怕你忘記，我特地寫大一點。」
「那地下室機車位呢？也是同一天？」
「機車位那張我沒寫日期，你的車要放到哪天都行。」
「所以房子要收回去，車可以繼續放？」
「車不會問我熱水器什麼時候修。」
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合房東貼了到期紙條、你卻先想到那台車該停哪的時候發；也適合傳給機車比房子還難安置的朋友
variations: 房子有到期日，機車沒有，因為機車不會問熱水器什麼時候修。
同一個地下室，我的租約有終點，我的車沒有。

en.content:
"I saw the note you taped to my door. End of the month, right?"
"Right. I wrote it big so you wouldn't forget."
"What about the basement motorcycle bay? Same day?"
"I didn't put a date on that one. Your bike can stay down there as long as it likes."
"So the apartment goes back to you, and the bike gets to stay?"
"The bike never asks me when the water heater is getting fixed."
en.editorNote: For when the eviction note lands and your first worry is where the bike goes, or for a friend whose vehicle is harder to rehome than they are
variations: The apartment has an end date, the bike doesn't, because the bike never asks about the water heater.
Same basement, and only one of us has a deadline.

items.sourceNote: 內政部說明租賃條例修法三大方向，包含保障租期與續約租金漲幅；取其「租期有制度、生活沒有」的落差，改寫為原創情境

zh-tw.content:
社區公告欄上那張紙早就泛黃，四個角用膠帶壓著，寫的日子是三年前的中秋。
我自己的租約寫在冰箱側面，一張電費單的背面，用磁鐵壓住。
上面只有四個字跟一個數字：還剩幾天。每個月拿筆改一次，數字愈改愈小。
房東沒提過，我也沒提，兩個人都在等對方先開口。
zh-tw.editorNote: 適合租約剩不到兩個月、你和房東都在裝沒事的那段日子發
variations: 我的到期日寫在電費單背面，用冰箱磁鐵壓著，比合約還常被我看到。
那個數字每個月被我改小一次，改到最後誰都沒先開口。

en.content:
The notice on the community board has gone yellow, all four corners under tape, and the date on it is a Mid-Autumn from three years ago.
My own lease date lives on the side of the fridge, on the back of an electricity bill, held up by a magnet.
It says four words and one number: days left. Once a month I cross out the number and write a smaller one.
The landlord has never brought it up. Neither have I. We are both waiting for the other one to speak first.
en.editorNote: For the last stretch of a lease when both you and your landlord are pretending nothing is about to happen
variations: My move-out date lives on the back of a power bill under a fridge magnet, and I see it more than I ever see the lease.
The number gets smaller every month and neither of us mentions it.
